scripts.text:
[Wounded]
Wow! Thanks a lot!
I don't know how this happened to our ship
but we should go to see the captain.
scripts.translation:
[傷員]
哇！太感謝你了！
我也不知道我們的船怎麼會變成這樣，
不過我們得去找船長看看。

scripts.text:
[Wounded]
... ohh, it seems my body is too injured.
Maybe you can go without me?
scripts.translation:
[傷員]
...唉，看來我傷得太重了。
你能不能先一個人過去？

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Information -!^000000
NPC Quest Received.
^4d4dffQuestinfo Shortcut is Alt + U^000000
You can check your quest status there anytime.
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 資訊 -!^000000
已接取 NPC 任務。
^4d4dff任務日誌快捷鍵為 Alt + U^000000
你隨時都可以在那裡檢視任務狀態。

scripts.text:
[Wounded]
Luckily the water has not entered the ship.
I will wait here, you should go see the captain.
scripts.translation:
[傷員]
幸好海水沒有灌進船裡。
我就在這裡等著，你去找船長吧。

scripts.text:
[Wounded]
I'm fine! I'm fine!
Don't worry about me, you should really go to the captain!
scripts.translation:
[傷員]
我沒事！真的沒事！
別擔心我，快去找船長吧！

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Information -!^000000
^4d4dffQuestinfo Shortcut is Alt + U^000000
You can check your quest status there anytime.
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 資訊 -!^000000
^4d4dff任務日誌快捷鍵為 Alt + U^000000
你隨時都可以在那裡檢視任務狀態。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
There are still people in the cabins?!
At least you are safe.
Are you alright?
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
船艙裡還有人嗎？！
至少你平安無事。
你沒受傷吧？

scripts.text: I'm alright, but others need help.
scripts.translation: 我沒事，但還有人需要幫助。

scripts.text: I think I am the last?
scripts.translation: 我想...我是最後一個了？

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
There are more people left?
I will send a rescue team to them.
Thank you for your report.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
還有人沒出來嗎？
我會派救援隊去救他們。
謝謝你來報告。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Alright, that's good.
The storm came unexpectedly but I never thought it would hit us that hard.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
那就好。
風暴來得很突然，我沒想到它會來得這麼猛烈。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
At least most people made it to safety.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
至少大多數人都平安脫險了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Look at the trees there, ^4d4dfffollow them to the southwest^000000 to find a new ship.
The ship will take you to ^4d4dffIzlude^000000, our original destination.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
看那邊的樹，^4d4dff沿著它們往西南方向走^000000，就能找到一艘新船。
那艘船會帶你前往^4d4dff依斯魯得^000000，也就是我們原本要去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Ah! Speaking of it, those ^4d4dffPorings^000000 on this island drop several materials we could use for repairs.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
對了，說到這個，島上的那些^4d4dff波利^000000會掉落幾種修船用的材料。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
^4d4dffKill the Porings and bring 2 Lumbers to the southern crew^000000.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
^4d4dff擊敗波利，再把 2 根木材送給南邊的船員^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
It is a hard task, but you look tough enough.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
這任務可不輕鬆，不過看你身手不錯，應該能勝任。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Speaking of Porings, you have to equip your gears.
You should have a ^4d4dffweapon and an armor^000000 equipped.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
說到波利，你得先把裝備穿戴好。
^4d4dff至少要裝備武器和防具^000000。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffYou can equip gear or use items by simply double clicking them.
The item window can be opened by pressing Alt + E or using the menu button.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff雙擊物品即可裝備或使用。
按 Alt + E 或點選選單按鈕可以開啟物品視窗。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffEquipped Items can be seen by pressing Alt + Q.
Either double click or drag & drop to equip or unequip them.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff按 Alt + Q 可以檢視已裝備的物品。
雙擊或拖放物品即可裝備或卸下。^000000

scripts.text:
[Captain Carlock]
Did you check all your equipment?
^4d4dffSkill distribution^000000 should be done.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
裝備都檢查過了嗎？
^4d4dff技能點應該已經分配好了^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carlock]
For a smooth battle, you have to distribute your abilities properly.
^4d4dffIf you want to increase your strength, you need to raise Str^000000. ^4d4dffIf you want to increase your hit, you must raise Dex^000000.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
想要戰鬥順利，就得合理分配能力值。
^4d4dff想提升力量，就提高 STR^000000；^4d4dff想提高命中率，就提高 DEX^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
^4d4dffThe Ship^000000 is anchored in the southwest. It will take you to Izlude.
Don't forget to ^4d4dffget some Lumber^000000 for the ship.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
^4d4dff船^000000停泊在西南方，會帶你前往依斯魯得。
別忘了^4d4dff收集一些木材^000000帶上船。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Don't forget to raise your ^4d4dffskills^000000.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
別忘了提升你的^4d4dff技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Everything is ready to sail over to Izlude.
The ship is located at the south-western part of the island.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
前往依斯魯得的準備工作都完成了。
船停在島嶼的西南邊。

scripts.text:
! - Information -!
^4d4dffYou get a stats bonus for every level you raise.
The status window can be opened and closed with the shortcut Alt + A^000000.
scripts.translation:
! - 資訊 -!
^4d4dff每升一級，你都會獲得屬性點。
按快捷鍵 Alt + A 可以開啟或關閉屬性視窗。^000000

scripts.text:
! - Information -!
^4d4dffPlease properly allocate the stats you need to battle^000000.
scripts.translation:
! - 資訊 -!
^4d4dff請合理分配屬性點，為戰鬥做好準備^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Kill Porings and bring the Lumber to the crew.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
擊敗波利，把木材交給船員。
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Had a good dream?
Soon, we will get to Izlude. And you can talk to other people like you just talked to me.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
睡得好嗎？
我們很快就到依斯魯得了。到時你也可以像剛才和我交談那樣，跟其他人聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
I think that guy over there lost his memory. I gave him a new name.
Lumin.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
我覺得那邊那個人失憶了，所以給他起了個新名字。
盧敏。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Many youngsters visit the ^4d4dffRune-Midgarts Kingdom^000000 to chase their dreams.
Izlude is a satellite city of Prontera, the capital of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
許多年輕人來到^4d4dff盧恩·米德加茲王國^000000追尋夢想。
依斯魯得是普隆德拉的衛星城，而普隆德拉正是盧恩·米德加茲王國的首都。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Izlude always welcomes young adventurers like you who have just started their journey through the world.
You are one of them, of course.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
依斯魯得總是歡迎像你這樣剛踏上旅途的年輕冒險者。
當然，你也是其中之一。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
I would like to tell you more stories, but it's time to get ready for arrival.
There is an academy in Izlude for newcomers like yourself.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
我還想多給你講些故事，不過現在該準備靠岸了。
依斯魯得有一所專為你這樣的新人設立的學院。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Let me give you more details later. See you back at the harbor deck.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
之後我再詳細告訴你。我們在港口甲板見。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
To get off this ship, you should enter the ^4d4dffShining Portal^000000 over there.
All transportation is made through the portals.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
想離開這艘船，就進入那邊的^4d4dff閃耀傳送門^000000。
所有交通都要通過傳送門。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Yes.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
嗯。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Oh boy.
What a cute reaction.
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
哎呀。
這反應也太可愛了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.....
Should I introduce myself?
scripts.translation: 要不要自我介紹一下？

scripts.text: My name is ~!
scripts.translation: 我叫~！

scripts.text: - Lu just walked away with a cynical look on his face.
scripts.translation: - 盧一臉不屑地走開了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Looks like... he has a shy personality.
When you go to Izlude, will you check on him?
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
看來...他性格挺靦腆的。
你到了依斯魯得後，能去看看他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
From now on I'll be sailing the ship around the island.
Let's go, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[船長 卡洛克]
從現在起，我要駕船繞島航行。
我們出發吧？

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
These Porings stole my materials to repair the ship. Can you help me to get them back?
There are plenty of Porings on this island.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
這些波利偷走了我修船用的材料。能幫我把它們找回來嗎？
島上有很多波利。

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
I would really appreciate it if you help me.
I am not allowed to set foot on this island.
That's why I ask for your help~
scripts.translation:
[水手]
要是你肯幫忙，我就感激不盡了。
我不能踏上這座島，
所以才拜託你幫忙~

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Unbelievable, perfect! Any chance you want to join my crew?
Enough talking!!
Come on, we're ready to set sail!
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
太棒了，真是難以置信！你有沒有興趣加入我的船員？
好了，不說了！！
快上船，我們要出發了！
真的非常感謝！

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
If you want to sail with us to Izlude, jump on board!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
想和我們一起去依斯魯得的話，就上船吧！

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Oh, and take these ^4d4dffMagnifiers^000000.
When you hunt monsters you can find ^4d4dffunidentified items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
對了，這些^4d4dff放大鏡^000000拿去用。
打怪時可能會找到^4d4dff未鑑定的物品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Using a Magnifier will identify the item.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
使用放大鏡就能鑑定物品。

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Maybe you already have some unidentified items from your fights with those Porings?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
你和那些波利戰鬥時，應該已經撿到未鑑定的物品了吧？

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
The ship is heading to Izlude soon~!
I'll let you know when we set sail~!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
船很快就要開往依斯魯得了~！
出發時我會通知你~！

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Oh, {0}!
Why are you here at the wharf?
I guess you are doing well at the academy.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
哦，{0}！
你怎麼會在碼頭？
看來你在學院過得不錯。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I'm going to be docking and reparing the ship here for a while.
I will be taking the same route I tried before.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我要在這裡停靠一陣子，修理船隻。
之後還是走我之前嘗試的那條航線。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hmm? You must be a student of the Criatura Academy?
Were you on my ship?
Hmm I can't remember.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯？你是克里阿圖拉學院的學生？
你之前在我的船上嗎？
嗯...我想不起來了。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Well, anything is fine.
Shall I go easy on you since you said you were a student of the Academy?
I am still the captain of the ship, regardless.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯，怎樣都無所謂。
既然你說自己是學院的學生，我就對你手下留情吧？
不過，我畢竟還是這艘船的船長。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I plan on taking off as soon as the repairs are complete.
The route will open with ^4d4dffPharos Lighthouse^000000 by then.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
船一修好，我就馬上出發。
到那時，通往^4d4dff發樂斯燈塔^000000的航線也會開通。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
This is Izlude.
The best city for you to take wings to your dreams.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
這裡就是依斯魯得。
是最適合讓你放飛夢想的城市。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Although I don't have any particular feelings for you,
I've seen a lot of young people like you, while operating the ship.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
雖然我跟你沒什麼特別交情，
但開船這些年，我見過不少像你這樣的年輕人。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
There were those among them who succeeded and failed and went back after being unable to adjust.
I want you to have a successful start with this place.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
有人成功了，有人失敗了，也有人因為無法適應而離開。
希望你能在這裡有個順利的開始。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Did you know this?
Izlude has a new Institute for budding adventurers like you!
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
你知道嗎？
依斯魯得新設了一所學院，專門培養像你這樣的新手冒險者！

scripts.text: You mean the Academy?
scripts.translation: 你是說那所學院嗎？

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Yes! It's called the ^4d4dffRoyal Criatura Academy^000000.
Founded by the Rune-Midgarts lineage to help out new adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
沒錯！它叫^4d4dff皇家克里阿圖拉學院^000000。
由盧恩·米德加茲王室創立，專門幫助新手冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
A friend of mine works there, so I'll give you the introduction to him.
He could make a lot of things easier for you.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我有個朋友在學院工作，我可以介紹你們認識。
有他幫忙，你會省事不少。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
He usually talks to new adventurers near the entrance of the academy.
Go and meet him there.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他通常會在學院入口附近接待新冒險者。
去那裡找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
I will mark his spot on the map so go to see him.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他叫^4d4dff洪^000000。
我會在地圖上標出他的位置，你去找他吧。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
The ^4d4dffMini map can be seen on the right top of the screen.
You can zoom in with +, zoom out with -. The waypoint from the NPC will be marked on it. ^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff小地圖在螢幕右上角。
按 + 放大，按 - 縮小。NPC 標記的導航點也會顯示在上面。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Received a Quest from ^4d4dffCaptain Carocc.
The quest content can be checked from the quest window.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
已接取^4d4dff船長卡洛克釋出的任務。
可以在任務視窗中檢視任務內容。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Quest window can be opened by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + u^000000 keys together.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
同時按下^4d4dffAlt + U^000000即可開啟任務視窗。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says 'Hun'.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你還不熟悉地圖，可以點選這裡的<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>。
沒錯，就是寫著“洪”的那一處。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffThe icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means a link to navigation directions.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff對話中的圖示<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>表示可以檢視導航指引。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
If you press info after selecting a task in the objectives^4d4dff,
an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with the navigation help.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
在目標列表中選中任務後，按下資訊^4d4dff，
就會顯示指向目標地點的箭頭和導航指引。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy
I hope it can help you for your future.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
總之，我的朋友會幫你辦理學院入學手續。
希望這能助你一臂之力。

scripts.text: I know who you're talking about.
scripts.translation: 我知道你說的是誰。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Then there's no worry.
He'll introduce you to the academy.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那就不用擔心了。
他會帶你瞭解學院。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
OK. I will show you the direction. You try it again.
By the way, did I tell you his name? His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好，我給你指一下方向。你再試試看。
對了，我告訴你他的名字了嗎？他叫^4d4dff洪^000000。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff Mini map can be seen on the right top of the screen.
You can zoom in with +, zoom out with -. The waypoint from the NPC will be marked on it. ^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff小地圖在螢幕右上角。
按 + 放大，按 - 縮小。NPC 標記的導航點也會顯示在上面。^000000

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says [Hun].
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你還不熟悉地圖，可以點選這裡的<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>。
沒錯，就是寫著[洪]的那一處。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff the icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means
a link to navigation directions.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff對話中的圖示 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 表示導航指引連結。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
If you press info after selecting a task in the objectives^4d4dff,
an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with navigation help
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
在目標列表中選擇任務後，按下“資訊”^4d4dff，
螢幕便會顯示指向目標地點的箭頭和導航提示。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy
I hope it will help you out in your journey
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
總之，我的朋友會幫你辦理學院註冊。
希望這對你的冒險有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you want, you can step forward to the world right away.
However, I recommend you visit the Academy first.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你願意，現在就能踏上旅程。
不過，我建議你先去學院看看。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
The world is a lonely place to be alone.
The Academy has people you can make as lifetime companions.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
一個人在外闖蕩難免孤單。
學院裡有許多人，或許會成為你一生的夥伴。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
My friend Hun will be around the academy entrance.
If you don't know the way I'll point it out to you again.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我的朋友洪會在學院入口附近。
要是你不認得路，我可以再給你指一次。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says ''Hun''.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你還不熟悉地圖，可以點選這裡的<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>。
沒錯，就是寫著“洪”的那一處。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff the icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means
a link to navigation directions.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff對話中的圖示 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 表示導航指引連結。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
If you press info after selecting a task in the objectives^4d4dff,
an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with navigation help.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
在目標列表中選中任務後，按下“資訊”^4d4dff，
螢幕便會顯示指向目標地點的箭頭和導航提示。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy.
I hope it will help you out in your journey.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
總之，我的朋友會幫你辦理學院註冊。
希望這對你的冒險有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Oh, {0}!
Still being dilligent?
I've been busy, also.
I was reparing the ship.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
哦，{0}！
還這麼勤奮啊？
我也忙得很，
一直在修船。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I'll be taking off as soon as the repairs are complete.
At that time, the sailing route to ^4d4dffPharos lighthouse ^000000will be opened.
Be excited for it.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
船修好後我就馬上出發。
屆時，前往^4d4dff發樂斯燈塔^000000的航線就會開通。
敬請期待吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hello?
Is it your first time on Izlude?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
你好？
你是第一次來依斯魯得嗎？

scripts.text: Hello?
scripts.translation: 你好？

scripts.text: Let me get on the ship!
scripts.translation: 讓我上船！

scripts.text: I don't know what to do.
scripts.translation: 我不知道該怎麼辦。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
You look strong and able!
I like able people like you!
Always be healthy and strong as you are now.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
你看起來身強體壯，也很能幹！
我喜歡你這樣能幹的人！
要一直保持健康強壯啊。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I usually travel to ^4d4dffPharos Lighthouse^000000.
But I'm resting up due to some problems.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我平時會去^4d4dff發樂斯燈塔^000000。
不過最近出了點問題，暫時在這裡休息。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If it's Alberta or Byalan Island, talk to the next sailor.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你要去艾爾貝塔或拜蘭島，請找下一位水手。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hmm? You said you didn't know what to do.
Since you're at Izlude, why don't you visit ^4d4dffCriatura Academy^000000?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯？你說不知道該做什麼。
既然來到依斯魯得，何不去^4d4dff克里阿圖拉學院^000000看看？

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Izlude has the Institute for budding adventurers like you
A friend of mine works there, so I'll give you the introduction to him.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
依斯魯得有一所專門培養新手冒險者的學院。
我有個朋友在那裡工作，可以介紹你們認識。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
He ususally talks to new adventurers near the entrance of an academy.
Go and meet him personally.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他通常會在學院入口附近接待新冒險者。
親自去見見他吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
I will mark his location on the map so go to see him.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他叫^4d4dff洪^000000。
我會在地圖上標出他的位置，你去找他吧。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff Mini map can be seen on the right top of the screen.
You can zoom in with +, zoom out with -. The waypoint from the NPC will be marked on it. ^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff小地圖位於螢幕右上角。
按 + 放大，按 - 縮小。NPC 標記的導航點也會顯示在上面。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Received a Quest from ^4d4dffCaptain Carocc.
Contents of your Quest can be monitored on the Quest information window.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
已接取^4d4dff船長卡洛克釋出的任務。
可以在任務資訊視窗中檢視任務內容。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Quest window can be opened by pressing the ^4d4dffAlt + u^000000 key.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
按下^4d4dffAlt + U^000000即可開啟任務視窗。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says [Hun].
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你還不熟悉地圖，可以點選這裡的<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>。
沒錯，就是寫著[洪]的那一處。

^4d4dff the icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means

scripts.translation:

^4d4dff對話中的圖示 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 表示導航指引連結。

If you press info after selecting a task in the objectives^4d4dff,
an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with navigation help
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
在目標列表中選中任務後，按下“資訊”^4d4dff，
螢幕便會顯示指向目標地點的箭頭和導航提示。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy
I hope it will help you out in your journey
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
總之，我的朋友會幫你辦理學院註冊。
希望這對你的冒險有所幫助。

scripts.text: I know who you're talking about.
scripts.translation: 我知道你說的是誰。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Then there's no worry.
He'll introduce you to the academy.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那就放心了。
他會帶你瞭解學院。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
OK. I will show you the direction. You try it again.
By the way, did I tell you his name? His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好，我給你指一下方向，你再試試看。
對了，我告訴你他的名字了嗎？他叫^4d4dff洪^000000。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff Mini map can be seen on the right top of the screen.
You can zoom in with +, zoom out with -. The waypoint from the NPC will be marked on it. ^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff小地圖位於螢幕右上角。
按 + 放大，按 - 縮小。NPC 標記的導航點也會顯示在上面。^000000

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says [Hun].
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你還不熟悉地圖，可以點選這裡的<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>。
沒錯，就是寫著[洪]的那一處。

!- Information -!
^4d4dff the icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means

scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff對話中的圖示 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 表示導航指引連結。

If you press info after selecting a task in the objectives^4d4dff,
an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with navigation help
scripts.translation:

在目標列表中選中任務後，按下“資訊”^4d4dff，
螢幕便會顯示指向目標地點的箭頭和導航提示。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy
I hope it will help you out in your journey
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
總之，我的朋友會幫你辦理學院註冊。
希望這對你的冒險有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Ah, it's you.
This guy has also decided to register at Criatura Academy.
This might be a good destiny for you. Hope you and him can be good friends.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
啊，是你。
這位也決定去克里阿圖拉學院註冊了。
說不定這是緣分呢。希望你們能成為好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you want, you can step forward to the world right away.
However, I recommend you visit the Academy first.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你願意，現在就能踏上旅程。
不過，我建議你先去學院看看。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
The world is a lonely place to be alone.
The Academy has people you could make into lifetime companions.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
一個人在外闖蕩難免孤單。
學院裡有許多人，或許會成為你一生的夥伴。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
My friend <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> will be around the academy entrance.
If you don't know the way I'll point it out to you again.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我的朋友 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 會在學院入口附近。
要是不認得路，我可以再給你指一次。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
then, Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那麼，祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Oh, We meet again.
Do you by any chance need a ship?
I usually travel to the port in Paros.
If you need to go to Paros later, come see me.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
哦，又見面了。
你是需要搭船嗎？
我平時會去帕羅斯港。
以後要是想去帕羅斯，就來找我。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
It's been a while!
Looking at your expression, you must be doing well.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好久不見！
看你的神情，最近過得不錯吧。

scripts.text: Take me to Pharos Lighthouse
scripts.translation: 前往發樂斯燈塔

scripts.text: To Alberta
scripts.translation: 前往艾爾貝塔

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Do you want to go to Pharos Lighthouse on the southern coast of Morocc?
The fee is 2800 zeny. I have a crew that needs payment so this fee is non-negotiable.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
要去摩洛克南岸的發樂斯燈塔嗎？
船費是 2800 Zeny。我得付船員薪水，費用可不能討價還價。

scripts.text: To Pharos Lighthouse!
scripts.translation: 去發樂斯燈塔！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Let us travel with the wing in our hair.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
讓我們迎風啟航吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Sorry but you are short of the boarding fee.
I need 2800z to operate.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
抱歉，你的船費不夠。
運營這艘船需要 2800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
OK.
Do you know this, by the way?
^4d4dffThere's a Rogue hideout at Pharos Lighthouse^000000.
You already knew this?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好。
對了，你知道嗎？
^4d4dff發樂斯燈塔有盜賊的藏身處^000000。
你早就知道了？

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I thought you knew that I only go to Pharos?
Ask the sailor over there, he's the one that goes there frequently.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我還以為你知道我只去發樂斯燈塔呢？
去問問那邊的水手吧，他經常去那裡。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
There are plenty of other ships that travel to Alberta and Byalan Islands.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
還有很多船會開往艾爾貝塔和拜蘭島。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hmm. I'm content with the well being of you and other adventurers who passed me by.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯。看到你和其他曾與我同行的冒險者都平安無事，我就放心了。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Lumin must be doing well too.
I wonder why you feel like my own child even though we've only met from the sea.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
盧敏應該也過得不錯吧。
我們明明只在海上見過，卻不知為何讓我覺得你像自己的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I am Carocc, the caption of this ship.
Do you need a ship?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我是卡洛克，這艘船的船長。
你需要搭船嗎？

scripts.text: Pharos Lighthouse - 2800z
scripts.translation: 發樂斯燈塔 - 2800 Zeny

scripts.text: Don't need it.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Let us travel with the wind in our hair.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
讓我們迎風啟航吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Sorry but you are short of the boarding fee.
I need 2800z to operate.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
抱歉，你的船費不夠。
運營這艘船需要 2800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Then use it next time.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那就下次再來吧。

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Continue the quest after organizing the inventory.
scripts.translation:
背包已滿，無法繼續任務。
整理好背包後再繼續吧。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Oh.. you must be the adventurer Carocc was talking about.
I don't know where your homeland is but Midgard is a good place to start your life's journey.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
哦...你就是卡洛克提到的那位冒險者吧。
我不知道你的故鄉在哪裡，不過米德加爾特很適合作為人生旅程的起點。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
It's a good sight to see new adventurers start their journey.
You must be tired. Need a drink?
scripts.translation:
[洪]
看到新冒險者踏上旅程，真讓人高興。
你一定累了吧？要喝點什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hun]
You can open the Item window by clicking on the 'item' icon on top left portion of the screen.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
點選螢幕左上角的“物品”圖示，就能開啟物品視窗。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
The items are automatically catagorized by 'consumables' 'equipment' 'etcetera' and 'personal' suitable for each use.
It will do the automatic sorting per indiviaul useage to
scripts.translation:
[洪]
物品會根據用途自動分為“消耗品”“裝備”“其他”和“個人”類別。
系統還會按照各類物品的用途自動排序...

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Either ^4d4dffdouble click on the item^000000 you intend to use
or drag it onto^4d4dff the equipment window and use it^000000
scripts.translation:
[洪]
^4d4dff雙擊要使用的物品^000000，
或者將其拖到^4d4dff裝備視窗中使用或裝備^000000。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffItems can be used or equipped with simply double-clicking.
Item window can be opened with shortcut key Alt+E
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff雙擊物品即可使用或裝備。
按 Alt + E 可以開啟物品視窗。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff Equipped items can be checked with Alt+ Q
Items can also be dragged onto the location where you wish to equip it.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff按 Alt + Q 可以檢視已裝備的物品。
也可以將物品拖到想要裝備的位置。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
For detailed info on individual items^4d4dff, right click ^000000on that item.
You can check the detailed info on the item.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
要檢視物品的詳細資訊，^4d4dff右鍵點選^000000該物品即可。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffRight-clicking on the item icon^4d4dff  brings up detailed info on the item.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff右鍵點選物品圖示^4d4dff，即可檢視物品的詳細資訊。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffWhen you select other players, you can trade, party up with them with the community window that pops up.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff選中其他玩家後，會彈出社交視窗，你可以通過它與對方交易或組隊。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Ok now ^4d4dffdrink the apple juice that I gave you^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
好了，現在^4d4dff把我給你的蘋果汁喝掉吧^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Hey there.
Rest up for a bit.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
你好啊。
先休息一會兒吧。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
It's joyous to see new adventurers starting out.
You want something to drink while you are resting?
scripts.translation:
[洪]
看到新冒險者踏上旅程，真讓人高興。
休息時想喝點什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Right clicking on the item icon ^4d4dffon the basic item window at the upper left corner brings up the detailed info on the item
scripts.translation:
[洪]
在左上角的基礎物品視窗中，右鍵點選物品圖示^4d4dff，即可檢視物品的詳細資訊。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
The items are automatically catagorized by 'consumables' 'equipment' 'etcetera' and 'personal' suitable for each use.
It will do the automatic sorting per indiviaul useage to
scripts.translation:
[洪]
物品會根據用途自動分為“消耗品”“裝備”“其他”和“個人”類別。
系統還會按照各類物品的用途自動排序...

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Either ^4d4dffdouble click on the item^000000 you intend to use
or drag it onto^4d4dff the equipment window and use it^000000
scripts.translation:
[洪]
^4d4dff雙擊要使用的物品^000000，
或者將物品拖到^4d4dff裝備視窗中使用或裝備^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
For detailed info on individual items^4d4dff, right-click ^000000on the item.
You can check the detailed info on the item.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
要檢視單件物品的詳細資訊，^4d4dff請右鍵點選^000000該物品。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Right clicking on the item icon ^4d4dffbrings up the detailed info on the item
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff右鍵點選物品圖示即可檢視詳細資訊。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
When you select on other players^4d4dff you can trade, party up with them with the community window that pops up.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
選中其他玩家後，^4d4dff會彈出社交視窗，你可以與對方交易或組隊。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Ok now ^4d4dffdrink the apple juice that I gave you^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
好了，現在^4d4dff把我給你的蘋果汁喝掉吧^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Consume the apple juice that I gave you in your inventory.
Then we'll talk.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
開啟背包，喝掉我給你的蘋果汁。
然後我們再聊。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
How's the taste?
Pretty good-taste of sweet and sour, right? It might not be much but it also has healing properties.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
味道怎麼樣？
酸酸甜甜的，很不錯吧？雖然不多，但也有恢復效果。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
I want to give you more but that was the last of it
Anyways here's some potions. They'll come in handy when you start fighting.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
我還想多給你一些，可那已經是最後一瓶了。
總之，這裡有些藥水，開始戰鬥後會派上用場。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Criatura Academy is a good place to build up experience for the future.
And I'm not just saying this because I work here.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
克里阿圖拉學院很適合為未來積累經驗。
我可不是因為在這裡工作才這麼說的。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
I'm for real... haha
scripts.translation:
[洪]
我說真的...哈哈。

How's the taste?
Pretty good-taste of sweet and sour, right? It might not be much but it also has healing properties.

scripts.text:
[Hun]
What do you plan to do from now on?
Have you found a place to stay?
scripts.translation:
[洪]
接下來你打算做什麼？
找到住的地方了嗎？

scripts.text: I need help with that
scripts.translation: 這方面我需要幫忙。

scripts.text: Anything will do really.
scripts.translation: 什麼都行。

scripts.text: Don't worry.
scripts.translation: 不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
But still, though.
It's tough to be out alone in a new place.
That's why Criatura Academy is there.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
不過話說回來，
一個人在陌生的地方闖蕩確實不容易。
這就是克里阿圖拉學院存在的意義。

Even though I'm just a work-hand here, I could show you around.
scripts.translation:

我雖然只是這裡的工作人員，但可以帶你四處看看。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
If you follow this road up to north, you can see
<NAVI>[the Academy building]<INFO>iz_ac01,100,39</INFO></NAVI>.
Anybody can enroll, so take advantage of it.

沿著這條路往北走，就能看到
<NAVI>[學院建築]<INFO>iz_ac01,100,39</INFO></NAVI>。
任何人都能入學，好好利用這個機會吧。

Sorry to interrupt.
But ^4d4dffif you need location info, please ask me.^000000
scripts.translation:

抱歉打擾了。
^4d4dff如果你需要查詢地點，請來問我。^000000

If you need help, feel free to visit Criatura Academy any time.

你倒是挺樂觀的。
需要幫忙的話，隨時都可以來克里阿圖拉學院。

When you go through this way to the north, you'll find
<NAVI>[the academy building]<INFO>iz_ac01,100,39</INFO></NAVI>.

入學沒有門檻，也不用交學費，對你會很有幫助。

<NAVI>[學院建築]<INFO>iz_ac01,100,39</INFO></NAVI>。

If there are more adventurers like you, the future will be brighter.

要是有更多像你這樣的冒險者，未來一定會更光明。

scripts.translation:
[洪]
皇家克里阿圖拉學院旨在幫助初出茅廬的冒險者邁出旅程的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Although I'm but a work-hand here, it makes me happy to see students graduate here and become fine members of society.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
我雖然只是這裡的工作人員，但看到學生畢業後成為社會棟梁，還是很高興的。

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the invenory being full.
Please try it again after re-organizing your items.
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
背包已滿，無法繼續任務。
整理好物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Hi, how are you?
I am in charge of navigation directions for Izlude's key locations
I wish to propose a simple game along with the navigation, would that be ok?
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
你好，最近怎麼樣？
我負責依斯魯得主要地點的導航指引。
我想結合導航帶你玩個小遊戲，可以嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, let's play!
scripts.translation: 好啊，來玩吧！

scripts.text: I already know them all.
scripts.translation: 我都知道了。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
First of all, how to check the mini-map.
You can check your location through the mini-map at the top right of the screen
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
先來看看怎麼檢視小地圖。
你可以通過螢幕右上角的小地圖確認自己的位置。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
If you receive information on a town or a city, a waypoint ^4d4dff+^000000 can be marked on the map.
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
獲得城鎮或城市的相關資訊後，地圖上就能標出導航點^4d4dff+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Press ^4d4dff[Ctrl] and [ ~ ] on your keyboard and you can see the world map^000000.
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
同時按下鍵盤上的^4d4dff[Ctrl]和[ ~ ]，就能檢視世界地圖^000000。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Through the ^4d4dffworld map you can check the location of you, your party members and the level of monsters in the area.^000000
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
通過^4d4dff世界地圖，可以檢視自己和隊友的位置，以及所在區域的魔物等級。^000000

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
This is useful info to remember.
Now then, should we play a simple game?
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
記住這些資訊會很有用。
那麼，我們來玩個小遊戲吧？

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
I will ^4d4dffmark three specific locations on the mini-map.^000000
Please ^4d4dffvisit those locations ^000000using the waypoints as reference.
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
我會在小地圖上^4d4dff標出三個指定地點^000000。
請參考導航點，^4d4dff前往這些地點^000000。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Think of it as a treasure hunt and go.
I've hidden some useful items there.
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
把它當成尋寶遊戲，出發吧！
我在那些地方藏了一些實用物品。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Vist me again after going by all three locations.
I will check up on it.
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
三個地點都跑過一遍後，再回來找我。
我會確認你的進度。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Ah, there' somebody who started out right before you!
If you don't hurry that person will take all the items!
So, run!
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
啊，有人比你早一步出發了！
不快點的話，東西就要被他全拿走了！
快跑吧！

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Do you need information on all the locations of Izlude?
By clicking on the introduced ^B9062F[base camp name]^000000, I will offer you guidance so follow the ^B9062FRed Arrows^000000.
scripts.translation:
[諮詢人員]
想了解依斯魯得的所有地點嗎？
點選介紹中的^B9062F[基地名稱]^000000後，我會為你指路。跟著^B9062F紅色箭頭^000000走就行。

scripts.text: Where's the hidden treasure?

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Yo.
Sorry pal I got here first.
Should've used a Fly wing like I did.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
喲。

[盧敏]
這些翅膀為什麼能讓人瞬間移動？
大概是因為它們來自克瑞米吧...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]

scripts.translation:

正如船長所說，眼見為實。這個世界充滿了謎團。

scripts.text:
Seems like Lumin beat you again.
Better get to the next location before Lumin does.

趕在他前面到達下一個地點吧。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text: Are you kidding me?!

scripts.text: Where's the treasure?

[Lumin]

You and I can be friends.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
不會吧...
一天之內遇見三次，一定是命運安排的。
我們可以做朋友。

scripts.text: Or Frenemies!

Take care.

scripts.text:
[{0}]

[{0}]
你到底有沒有在聽我說話？！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Of course.
I already packed it.
There were Red Potion hidden here.
scripts.translation:

當然有啊。
我已經裝起來了。
這裡原本藏著紅色藥水。

scripts.text: So can I have some?

scripts.text:

That's not fair, I was here first so they're mine.
You better get to the next stop faster if you want the prize.
scripts.translation:

這不公平，是我先到的，所以東西歸我。

Well, then.....

那就...

This guy...

scripts.translation:

普隆德拉野外。
普隆德拉城就在北邊。

scripts.text: Except for the simple signboard, nothing can be found here.
scripts.translation: 除了這塊簡易告示牌，什麼也沒找到。

scripts.text: Where's the treasure?

scripts.text:

Yo.
Sorry but I am quicker than you.
There were Fly Wings here..
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
喲。
抱歉，我比你快了一步。
這裡本來有蒼蠅翅膀...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
In fact, I don't like Fly's wings.
Flies are so dirty.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
說真的，我不喜歡蒼蠅翅膀。
蒼蠅太髒了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
By the way, why is one of the convenient transportations fly wing shaped?
Perhaps you know?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
對了，為什麼有一種方便的交通道具長得像蒼蠅翅膀？
你知道原因嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
...you don't know.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
...你不知道啊。

scripts.text:
Defeated by Lumin again.
Keep calm and find the next location.
scripts.translation:
又輸給盧敏了。
冷靜下來，繼續找下一個地點吧。

...Hello

scripts.text: Are you kidding me?!

You and I can be friends.

scripts.text:
==== Information ====
Prontera Field.
The city of Prontera is located to the north.
scripts.translation:
==== 資訊 ====
普隆德拉野外。
普隆德拉城就在北邊。

scripts.text:
==== Information ====
Prontera Field.
The city of Prontera is located to the north.
scripts.translation:
==== 資訊 ====
普隆德拉野外。
普隆德拉城就在北邊。

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
背包已滿，無法繼續任務。
整理好物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Are you a student?
Do you have any problem in your body?
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
你是學院的學生嗎？
身體有什麼不舒服嗎？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
This is the dispensary of the Royal Criatura Academy.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
這裡是皇家克里阿圖拉學院的醫務室。
有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Are you injured?
Even the emergency treatment didn't work for you?
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
你受傷了嗎？
連緊急治療也沒能治好你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Is that good enough?
Have you recovered?
If you are sane, go to bed and rest before you go.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
這樣可以了嗎？
恢復了嗎？
沒事的話，出發前先上床休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
I feel sorry for you but...
I can only give my free healing service to those under base level 20.
You don't look like you're going to die anyways.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
我也很同情你，不過...
免費治療只提供給基礎等級未滿 20 級的人。
而且你看起來也不像命在旦夕。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Just take a rest here until you've recovered.
There are lots of vacant beds!
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
就在這裡好好休息，直到恢復為止。
還有很多空床位呢！

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You already know about First Aid.
We both are busy. Don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
你已經學會緊急治療了。
大家都很忙，別來打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You are commendable!
First Aid is a skill that transfers SP to HP during emergency situations.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
做得不錯！
緊急治療是在危急時將 SP 轉換為 HP 的技能。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Recovery ratio is very minimal...
It can help you avoid dying but won't give you much HP.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
恢復量非常有限...
雖然能幫你保住性命，但回覆不了多少 HP。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Press ^4d4dffALT + S^000000 to open your Skill window to see your skills.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
按下^4d4dffALT + S^000000開啟技能視窗，就能檢視已學會的技能。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
If you press ^4d4dffF12^000000...
The shortcut window will open up with nine small compartments to register your skills to.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
按下^4d4dffF12^000000...
就會開啟快捷欄視窗，裡面有九個欄位可以登記技能。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Dragging the right hand corner at the shortcut window, you can open up more skill shortcut pages.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
拖動快捷欄視窗的右下角，就能展開更多技能快捷欄頁面。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
It is a simple use.. ^4d4dffEach slot responds to individual keys from F1 to F9^000000.
Needed skills or items can be immediately used after registering on the corresponding slots.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
用法很簡單。^4d4dff每個欄位分別對應 F1 到 F9^000000。
將需要的技能或物品登記到對應欄位後，就能快速使用。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
You can register needed items or skills at ^4d4dffshortcut slots by dragging the icons.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
將需要的物品或技能圖示拖到^4d4dff快捷欄位即可登記。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff The registered items and equipment at^4d4dff the slots can be immediately used or armed by pressing the reponding F1 - F9 keys.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff登記在欄位中的物品和裝備^4d4dff，按下對應的 F1 至 F9 鍵即可使用或裝備。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
By setting the ^4d4dffshortcut keys as you want, you can use the responding shortcut key.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
你可以按自己的喜好設定^4d4dff快捷鍵，之後按下對應按鍵即可使用。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffyou may register the frequently using items and skills, and use them at your convenience.
scripts.translation:
!- 資訊 -!
^4d4dff你可以登記常用的物品和技能，使用起來更方便。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Now open the skill window and register [First Aid] as shortcut key, then use it.
You will find it is more covenient to use this way.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
現在開啟技能視窗，把[緊急治療]設為快捷技能，然後使用它。
這樣操作是不是方便多了？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Have you investigated the growing plants in the field?
^4d4dff Red Plant, Blue Plant, Green Plant, White Plant^000000etc..
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
你調查過野外生長的植物嗎？
^4d4dff紅草、藍草、綠草、白草^000000等等。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You can get different colored herbs from the various plants.
Processing herbs turns to be a various useful potions.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
不同的植物會產出不同顏色的藥草。
加工藥草還能製成各種有用的藥水。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Now, shall we collect the Red Herb with your hands?
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
現在要親手採一株紅色藥草嗎？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
A ^4d4dffRed Plant is growing near the academy building.^000000.
I secretly planted it for today.
Go and get ^4d4dff1 Red Herb^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
^4d4dff學院建築附近長著一株紅草。^000000
我特意為今天種下了它。
去採集^4d4dff 1 株紅色藥草^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You got it.
^4d4dffYou could eat this herb and get the benefit of it immediately but it will be more efficient if you make it into a potion.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
拿到了。
^4d4dff直接吃掉藥草就能立即獲得效果，不過把它製成藥水會更有效。^000000

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Herbs vary their virtues according to their color.
^4d4dffGreen Herbs^000000 detox you.
^4d4dffBlue Herbs^000000 recover your SP.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
不同顏色的藥草有不同功效。
^4d4dff綠色藥草^000000可以解毒。
^4d4dff藍色藥草^000000可以恢復 SP。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Any other?
Well, HP is recovering like this red herb.
This like this... Make a nectar and put it into a bottle....
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
還想知道別的嗎？
嗯，紅色藥草可以恢復 HP。
像這樣...把藥草製成藥液，再裝進瓶子裡...

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
This becomes the recovering potion possible to take anywhere, anytime.
I will give it to you as souvenir.
And also give you the recipe to make potions easily.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
這樣就能製成隨時隨地都可以使用的恢復藥水。
我送你一瓶留作紀念。
再給你一份簡單的藥水製作配方。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
This is the book for the simple combination of potion use.
You can make it easily by ^4d4dffusing the combination kit or cooking tool^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
這是一本介紹簡單藥水合成方法的手冊。
使用^4d4dff組合專用工具或烹飪工具^000000就能輕鬆製作。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Not only potions but also other easily attainable things can be turned to various tools. Please make use of them.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
除了藥水，許多容易取得的材料也能製成各種工具。記得善加利用。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
For your trial to make it, I gave you a Red Herb and one Apple,
How about making it with the combination kit?
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
為了讓你試著製作，我給了你一株紅色藥草和一個蘋果。
要不要用組合專用工具試著做做看？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Read the combination kit by ^4d4dffright-clicking^000000, and ^4d4dffclick the book shaped icon^000000 which will open up the explanation window.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
^4d4dff右鍵點選^000000組合專用工具，再^4d4dff點選書本形狀的圖示^000000，說明視窗就會開啟。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Why don't you learn about the virtues of herbs?
Bring one Red Herb by beating the growing Red Herb near the academy building.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
想了解藥草的功效嗎？
去擊敗學院建築附近的紅草，帶回一株紅色藥草吧。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You can find it near the entrance of the academy.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
在學院入口附近就能找到它。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
I already let you know about the basic medical botany.
By the way, there is something called a ^4d4dffShining Plant^000000 here on Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
基礎的藥用植物知識我已經告訴你了。
對了，米德加爾特還有一種叫^4d4dff光芒草^000000的植物。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Nobody knows which herb comes out from this plant.
Once I got the fruit of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
沒人知道它會長出什麼藥草。
我以前還得到過天地樹果實呢。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
And, in the Alberta merchant guild, there is an old man making potions.
You can ask him for help.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
艾爾貝塔的商人公會裡有位老人會製作藥水。
你可以去找他幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
^4d4dffAlchemist^000000 or ^4d4dffBiochemist^000000 or the higher class job ^4d4dffGeneticist^000000 are all good at creating potions.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
^4d4dff鍊金術士^000000、^4d4dff生物化學家^000000，以及更高階的職業^4d4dff基因學家^000000都擅長製作藥水。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
If you want to have a well-made potion, it may be a good idea to ask for a specialist.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
想做出品質上乘的藥水，找專家幫忙會比較好。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
I see...
For emergency situations, in case you've fainted and want to be brought back here, I will save your current location.
scripts.translation:
[治療師]
我知道了...
為了以防萬一，如果你昏倒後想回到這裡，我可以替你記錄當前位置。

scripts.text:
Your inventory is too full so you can't continue this quest.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
背包太滿，無法繼續任務。
整理好物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Hey there Turtle
You are really slow.
This Red Plant is no longer useful for you.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
嘿，烏龜！
你也太慢了吧。
這株紅草對你已經沒用了。

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？

scripts.text: Who're you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
You heard me.
Aren't you here to collect the Red Plant for the Academy Therapist.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
我說得還不夠清楚嗎？
你不是來替學院的治療師採紅草的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
But, But something weird just happened.
It happened right before my eyes.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
可是、可是剛才發生了件怪事。
那一幕我可是親眼看見的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Did you lose your memory?
If the captain hears about it, he'll cry.
It is still ok as long as I remember you.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
你失憶了嗎？
要是船長聽說了，肯定會哭的。
不過，只要我還記得你就行。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Lumin.
.......
How about being happy?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
盧敏。
...
開心點怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Anyway, let me explain it to you, I have just cut all the leaves of this Red Plant.
You can't collect the Red Plant anymore.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
總之，我解釋給你聽：我剛把這株紅草的葉子全剪掉了。
現在你沒法再採它了。

scripts.text: Ok so give me a ^ff0000Red Herb^000000
scripts.translation: 那就給我一株^ff0000紅色藥草^000000

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
OK... then...
I don't even need it anyways. I already know all about basic medical botany.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
好吧...那就...
反正我也不需要。我已經學會所有基礎藥用植物知識了。

scripts.text: Then, why did you do it?
scripts.translation: 那你為什麼要這麼做？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I didn't do it!
I was just standing here.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
不是我乾的！
我剛才只是站在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Here take this Red Herb.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
來，拿著這株紅色藥草。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Ah... see it's growing back.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
啊...你看，它又長出來了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I guess you should go back to the Therapist.
He's probably waiting for you..
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
我想你該回去找治療師了。
他應該還在等你呢...

scripts.text:
He seems to think of something deeply.
Disregard it.
scripts.translation:
他似乎在認真思考。
先別打擾他。

scripts.text:
[Criatura Student]
.......
scripts.translation:
[克里亞圖拉學院學生]
...

scripts.text: This student looks familiar...
scripts.translation: 這個學生看起來有點眼熟...

scripts.text:
[Criatura Student]
.......
scripts.translation:
[克里亞圖拉學院學生]
...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
snoring... snoring...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
呼嚕...呼嚕...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
snoring... snoring...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
呼嚕...呼嚕...

scripts.text:
- A man is lying here
- he's barely breathing.
scripts.translation:
- 這裡躺著一個男人。
- 他呼吸微弱。

scripts.text: - Is this maybe...?!
scripts.translation: - 這難道是...？！

scripts.text:
- an accident...
- yes, this is a murder!
- There's a murderer here!
scripts.translation:
- 是意外...
- 不對，這是謀殺！
- 這裡有兇手！

scripts.text:
- I swear on some old person's grave
- I will solve this case!
scripts.translation:
- 我對著某位老人的墳墓發誓
- 一定會偵破此案！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Yawn. Who are you making so much noise next to me...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
哈啊。誰在我旁邊吵吵嚷嚷的...

scripts.text: You aren't dead?
scripts.translation: 你沒死？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Dead?! Who....?
me? Pu ha ha ha!!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
死了？！誰...？
我嗎？噗哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Sorry for laughing. Ha ha ha!
I was just taking a nap because the weather is good.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
抱歉，我笑了。哈哈哈！
天氣這麼好，我只是打了個盹。

scripts.text: But you weren't breathing...
scripts.translation: 可是你剛才都沒呼吸...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Ahh...... that?
Right it makes sense that you misunderstood.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
啊...那個啊？
這麼說來，難怪你會誤會。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I used the skill<^ff0000Play Dead^000000> because I didn't want to be disturbed by monsters or someone else.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
我用了<^ff0000裝死^000000>技能，這樣魔物或其他人就不會來打擾我。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I never thought someone would think of me as an actual dead body.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
我還真沒想到會有人把我當成屍體。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Oh, I see... you are a new novice who just has arrived here?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
哦，原來如此...你是剛到這裡的初心者吧？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I guess it is unexpected and surprising but do you want to learn <^ff0000Play Dead^000000>?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
這確實有點出乎意料。你想學<^ff0000裝死^000000>嗎？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I am sure that it will help you. How do you think about it?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
我保證這技能對你有幫助。你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I am sorry but I am busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我現在有事。

scripts.text: I want to learn it!
scripts.translation: 我想學！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Really ? If you are busy then fine by me.
I should keep sleeping.
yawning...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
真的？你要是忙的話，那就算了。
我還是繼續睡吧。
打哈欠...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
You made a right decision!
I want to teach you for good.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
你做了個明智的決定！
我一定會好好教你的。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
A novice does not know the potential power of himself nor how strong the enemy is.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
初心者往往不瞭解自己的潛力，也不清楚敵人有多強。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
There is a studious type of novice who studies well..but i guess we are not.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
有些初心者很愛鑽研...不過我想我們都不是那種人。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Just take prompt action.
And sometimes you'll be defeated by stong enemies...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
遇到狀況就果斷行動。
不過，有時也會被強敵打敗...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Huh? You're right this is my story.
I was getting sick of being defeated.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
嗯？你說得沒錯，這說的就是我。
我都快受夠一次次被打敗了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
One day, a good idea came to my mind. If I pretend to be dead when I find a strong enemy...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
有一天，我靈機一動：遇到強敵時，乾脆假裝自己已經死了...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I was faced with the risk of death, because I was not good at pretending to be dead.
Even when I look back at that time. it is still thrilling...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
因為我不擅長裝死，好幾次都險些喪命。
現在回想起來，還是讓人心驚膽戰...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
let's continue to talk
So ever since then, Playing Dead started working out for me!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
接著說吧。
從那以後，我的裝死戰術就越來越管用了！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
And then...
I could not hold a breath for a long time.
That was a problem!
Clever monsters were checking out my breath!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
後來...
我沒法長時間屏住呼吸。
這可麻煩了！
機靈的魔物會察覺到我的呼吸！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
So I had to train myself to hold my breath for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
所以我只好訓練自己，儘可能長時間地屏住呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Sounds complicated.. but it is quite simple.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
聽起來很複雜...其實很簡單。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
If you feel like you can not beat the enemy, when a strong one appears, just fall down on the ground and pretend to be dead.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
如果遇到強敵，覺得自己打不過，就倒在地上裝死吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I will put you on a brief test whether you hold you breathe or not.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
我來簡單測試一下你能不能屏住呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Hold a breath for 20 seconds, then talk to me later. I won't admit you if you talk to me before that time is over!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
屏住呼吸 20 秒，之後再來找我。在時間到之前來找我的話，我可不會讓你通過！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Start!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
開始！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
What? You aren't able to hold your breath for even 20 seconds?
You can't learn this skill until you are able to hold it!
scripts.translation:
[教官 阿戈斯]
什麼？你連20秒都撐不住？
你得先學會屏住呼吸，才能學這招！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Hold breath for 20 seconds again!
Then talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
再屏住呼吸 20 秒！
然後再來找我。

scripts.text: - Learned the <^ff0000Play Dead^000000>skill.

[Instructor Argos]
Okay, good job.
If you have strong patience like that, it will save you. There will be no monsters that can hurt you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
很好，幹得不錯。
只要有這樣的耐心，就能在危急時救自己一命，讓魔物拿你沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
The <^ff0000Play Dead^000000> skill is in your skill list which you can open by pressing <Alt + S>, Please do not forget to use it, it will save you when you are in a danger.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
<^ff0000裝死^000000>技能已加入技能列表，按<Alt + S>即可開啟。遇到危險時別忘了使用，它能救你一命。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
If you grow up and get another job, then you do not need this skill so do not spare it! Wse it when you need to and don't hesitate.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
等你成長並轉職後，就用不上這技能了。需要時儘管用，別猶豫！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I need to get some sleep, do not wake me up. Yawn.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 阿爾戈斯]
我得睡一會兒，別吵醒我。哈啊...

scripts.translation:

要小心保管，之後不會再次發放。

scripts.text:

It is your first step to be an adventurer that you have made a visit to us.
scripts.translation:
[接待員]
來這裡拜訪，就是你成為冒險者的第一步。

scripts.text:

On our next meeting, I anticipate you will grow up a bit more.
scripts.translation:

希望下次見面時，你已經又成長了一些。

scripts.text:

One who is not a Novice can't attend the educational course.
scripts.translation:
[接待員]
非初心者不能參加教育課程。

scripts.text:
[Receptionist]
However, a part of the educational course except the character cultivation can be freely attended. So, you may look around the Academy and neighboring places.
scripts.translation:
[接待員]
不過，除了角色培養之外，其他教育課程都可以自由參加。你可以去學院和附近轉轉。

- 喂，稍等一下！！
- 你的背包物品太多了
- 已經無法再領取物品
- 請先整理一下背包
- 然後再試一次 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Are you ready to learn about abnormal statuses? I promise that I won't trick you anymore. I am a ''trainer'' after all right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
準備好了解異常狀態了嗎？我保證不再捉弄你了。畢竟我可是個“導師”，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
First of all, I'll tell you about <^FF0000Poison^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
首先，我來給你講講<^FF0000中毒^000000>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As you already experienced, when you are poisoned, your body turns purple and you lose a little HP every second.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
就像你剛才體驗到的那樣，中毒後身體會變成紫色，而且每秒都會損失少量 HP。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You can't lose HP forever so you won't die from poison.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
HP 不會一直減少，所以中毒不會致命。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Experiencing is believing! I will put you in a poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
實踐出真知！我現在就讓你進入中毒狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
See what happens to you in the poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
看看你處於中毒狀態時會有什麼反應。

scripts.text: You are- <^FF0000Poisoned^000000>.
scripts.translation: 你現在處於<^FF0000中毒^000000>狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Did you see what is the poisoned status? After a certain period of time, you could be detoxicated, but if you're being attached, it is dangerous to expect being detoxicated naturally.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
看清中毒狀態的效果了嗎？過一段時間後，毒素可能會自行消退；但如果這時還在持續受攻擊，就別指望它會自然消退了。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Refer to the detoxicants such as <^0022FFGreen Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
Next, I'll tell you about<^FF0000 Stun^000000.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
接下來，我來給你講講<^FF0000 眩暈^000000>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
While in the Stun status, stars will circle around your head and you can't move basically you'll be ''defenseless''.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
眩暈時，你的頭頂會有星星打轉，而且基本無法移動，完全處於“毫無防備”的狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As you are defenseless, you can't move, use skills, and use items.
So, it is impossible to recover from it by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
毫無防備時，你無法移動、使用技能或物品，
因此沒辦法自行解除狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
The exceptional case is you can recover from it by the skill called <^0022FFGentle Touch-Cure^000000> if you are a Sura.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
有個例外：如果你是修羅，可以使用<^0022FF點穴-快^000000>技能解除眩暈。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You can recover with skills such as the Priest's <^0022FFRecovery ^000000> or the Arch Bishop's <^0022FFLauda Ramus^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
也可以使用牧師的<^0022FF恢復^000000>或大主教的<^0022FF折枝讚頌^000000>等技能解除。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in the Stun status!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
讓我演示一下眩暈狀態的效果！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it?
Didn't you feel oppressed since you couldn't move?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
怎麼樣？
動彈不得的感覺很難受吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Imagine that you are in that status and monsters are rushing to you...
Believe me it'll happen.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
想像一下，你動彈不得時，魔物正朝你衝來...
相信我，真有可能發生。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
This time, I will teach you about <^FF0000Sleep^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
接下來，我要教你關於<^FF0000睡眠^000000>的知識。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Sleep status, you fall asleep with a <Zzz> popped up over your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
進入睡眠狀態時，你會睡著，頭上還會冒出一個<Zzz>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Same as the Stun status, you are defenseless, but the difference is you can recover from the enemy's attack.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
和眩暈時一樣，你會毫無防備；不同的是，受到敵人攻擊後你就會醒來。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But in Sleep status, the possibility to be hit by ''Critical'' attacks from enemy's attack is increased, you are in danger and exposed a severe damage.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不過，睡眠狀態下更容易受到敵人的暴擊，處境會很危險，也可能遭受重創。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
For your reference, recovery by yourself is impossible and is only possible with the <^0022FF Recovery ^000000>skill of a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
提醒你一下，睡眠狀態無法自行解除，只能靠牧師的<^0022FF恢復^000000>技能解除。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in the Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
讓我演示一下睡眠狀態的效果。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it? It isn't fun to imagine being asleep in front of a dangerous enemy is it?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
怎麼樣？想像一下在危險的敵人面前睡著，不太好受吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Sleep is good for recovery but not necessarily good while you're in the middle of a battle.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
睡眠有助於恢復，但在激烈的戰鬥中可不是什麼好事。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Lastly, I will teach you about  <^FF0000 Silence ^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
最後，我來講講<^FF0000沉默^000000>狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Silence status,  you can't use any magic skills and a <...> will appear above your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
進入沉默狀態後，你無法使用任何魔法技能，頭頂還會出現一個<...>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But all attacks are not impossible. Normal attacks can still be done while silenced.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不過，沉默並不會讓你無法攻擊，仍然可以進行普通攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In the silence status, you can merely still physically attack or recover by using potions.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
沉默狀態下，你只能進行物理攻擊，或者使用藥水恢復。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's possible to recover with the items such as<^0022FF Green Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
讓我演示一下睡眠狀態的效果。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's frustrating to not be able to use your skills right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不能使用技能，是不是很令人著急？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Especially, when you are a high class depending upon the skills rather than physical attacks or in Sleep status during the battle, you will be damaged severely.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
尤其是依賴技能而非普通攻擊的高階職業，或在戰鬥中陷入睡眠時，都會因此遭受重創。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In addtion, there are other statuses like Darkness, Frozen, Curse, Stone, Confusion etc, but I can let you experience all of them.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
此外還有黑暗、冰凍、詛咒、石化、混亂等狀態，我也可以讓你逐一體驗。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I hope this was helpful for you to experience some of the things that you will see out in the world.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
希望這次體驗能幫你提前熟悉今後冒險中會遇到的狀況。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Whenever you want to experience an abnormal status, please come to me.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
想體驗其他異常狀態時，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As an apology for the lunchbox matter, I will give you a small gift.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
之前便當盒的事是我不好，就送你一份小禮物賠罪吧。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Wish you have good luck in your adventures!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
祝你冒險順利！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Hey, you there!
By any chance, are you a training beginner?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
嘿，你！
你是剛來學院的新手訓練生嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I'm Trainer Mainz; and I'm in charge of education at this Academy.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我是教官美因茨，負責這所學院的教學工作。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Which course?
It is not important so I will let you know later.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
選哪門課程？
現在還不重要，之後我再告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You must be very exhausted after having to read and learn so much right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
讀了這麼多、學了這麼多，一定很累吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Of course, you are... Oh, you poor thing.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
當然，你是...哎，真可憐。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
There's a person who can help you when you need it.
Do you know who is it?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你需要幫助時，有個人能幫你。
猜猜是誰？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
That's me!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
就是我！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
What does that mean?
It means I have prepared a special gift just for your exhausted self!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你問這是什麼意思？
我特地為疲憊的你準備了一份禮物！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
A lunchbox for you!!! Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
給你準備了便當！！！哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Since I'm not the one who made it don't worry.
My beloved wife prepared it. So, just be my guest and enjoy!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
放心，不是我做的。
這是我親愛的妻子準備的。來，別客氣，儘管享用！

scripts.text: Don't take it.
scripts.translation: 別拿了。

scripts.text: Take it.
scripts.translation: 拿來吧。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You don't want to have this lunchbox? I guess it's your loss then.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你不想要這個便當？那可就虧大了。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Should I just take it for myself then?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
那我就自己留下了？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Yes... You made a right decision.
Please keep in mind that I really wanted to have it but since you look exhausted I offered it to you first!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
沒錯...你做了個明智的決定。
可別忘了，我其實很想吃；不過看你這麼累，才先讓給你！

scripts.text: - You open the lunchbox and there is some type of food inside -
scripts.translation: - 你開啟便當盒，發現裡面裝著某種食物 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Wahahahat! Don't hesitate and just take it!
It will refresh you from your fatigue!
Eat it~~ Eat it~~
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哇哈哈！別猶豫，快吃吧！
吃了就能消除疲勞！
吃吧~~快吃~~

scripts.text: - Since you're tired and starved you're obliged to take the box -
scripts.translation: - 你又累又餓，只好收下便當盒 -

scripts.text: - You eat the food and suddenly feel a sharp pain in your stomach. Your vision seems to be blurry too -
scripts.translation: - 你吃下食物後，胃裡突然一陣劇痛，視線也開始模糊 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Oh... what happened to you?
You don't look too good!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哎呀...你怎麼了？
臉色看起來不太好！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Oh, man...
I think you've been poisoned.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
糟了...
我想你是中毒了。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I will give you an antidote. You might get better if you take it.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我給你一劑解毒藥，服下後應該會好些。

scripts.text: - You reluctantly take the antidote -
scripts.translation: - 你不情願地服下了解毒藥 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Well, how the heck were you poisoned?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你到底是怎麼中毒的？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
By the way, I heard that there's a ghost wandering around the Royal Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
對了，我聽說皇家克里阿圖拉學院裡有幽靈出沒。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I think the ghost must have poisoned you.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我看一定是那個幽靈給你下了毒。

scripts.text:
- You roll your eyes at Mainz -
- Mainz turns his head as if he doesn't notice -
scripts.translation:
- 你朝美因茨翻了個白眼 -
- 美因茨轉過頭，裝作沒看見 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Ehem! Anyway, I am sorry.
Please understand there is no malice.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
咳咳！總之，抱歉。
請相信我沒有惡意。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
All of these are for you...
Want to know what I mean?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我做這一切都是為了你好...
想知道為什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
There are various kinds of monsters on the Midgard continent. And some of them can poison you or put you in abnormal conditions.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
米德加爾特大陸上有各種各樣的魔物，有些會讓你中毒或陷入其他異常狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Usually, anybody is too embarrassed to admit being poisoned without knowing.  I just did it on purpose to let you have the experience in case it happens out in the real world.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
通常，誰也不願承認自己不知不覺就中毒了。我故意讓你體驗一次，以後在真正的冒險中遇到時，你就知道該怎麼辦了。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Understand that I didn't intend to pass my wife's lunchbox as if it was a present. It was just another lesson from the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
別誤會，我不是把妻子做的便當當作禮物糊弄你。這只是克里阿圖拉學院安排的另一堂課。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As an apology, I would like to inform you of several abnormal statuses you might experience in the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
為了賠罪，我來給你介紹幾種在米德加爾特大陸上可能遇到的異常狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Don't decline it! Being ready to learn so speak to me again.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
別拒絕啊！準備好學習之後，再來找我聊聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Are you here for an explanation about the abnormal statuses? What makes you anxious?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你是來了解異常狀態的嗎？有什麼不明白的？

scripts.text: I have no questions.
scripts.translation: 我沒有其他問題了。

scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
讓我演示一下睡眠狀態的效果。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it? It isn't fun to imagine being asleep in front of a dangerous enemy is it?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
怎麼樣？想像一下在危險的敵人面前睡著，不太好受吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Sleep is good for recovery but not necessarily good while you're in the middle of a battle.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
睡眠有助於恢復，但在激烈的戰鬥中可不是什麼好事。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
What else are you anxious about?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
還有什麼讓你擔心的狀態嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I will teach you about  <^FF0000 Silence ^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
最後，我來講講<^FF0000 沉默 ^000000>狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Silence status,  you can't use any magic skills and a <...> will appear above your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
進入沉默狀態後，你無法使用任何魔法技能，頭頂還會出現一個<...>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But all attacks are not impossible. Normal attacks can still be done while silenced.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不過，沉默並不會讓你無法攻擊，仍然可以進行普通攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In the silence status, you can merely still physically attack or recover by using potions.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
沉默狀態下，你只能進行物理攻擊，或者使用藥水恢復。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's possible to recover with the items such as<^0022FF Green Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
讓我演示一下睡眠狀態的效果。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's frustrating to not be able to use your skills right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不能使用技能，是不是很讓人著急？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Especially, when you are a high class depending upon the skills rather than physical attacks or in Sleep status during the battle, you will be damaged severely.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
尤其是依賴技能而非普通攻擊的高階職業，或在戰鬥中陷入睡眠時，都會因此遭受重創。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Do you have any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
If you don't have any more questions, would you please have my lunchbox on behalf of me?
No?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
如果沒有別的問題了，能不能替我把這份便當吃掉？
不願意嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Haaaaa...
What should I do with this lunchbox?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哈啊...
這份便當該怎麼辦呢？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Ahaaa~~ sticking at the dispensary.
Playing hooky is cool and awesome.
while XXXXXX, but what are you?
Are you the same kind of XXXXX?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
啊哈~~躲在醫務室裡。
逃課可真爽啊。
不過，XXXXXX，你又是什麼人？
你也和XXXXX一樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Ahaaa~~ sticking at the dispensary.
Playing hooky is cool and awesome.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
啊哈~~躲在醫務室裡。
逃課可真爽啊。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Hmmm... you look like you have some talent.
Being in a good mood, shall I show you something newfangled?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
嗯...你看起來還挺有天賦的。
我心情不錯，要不要讓你見識點新玩意兒？

scripts.text: Newfangled?
scripts.translation: 新玩意兒？

scripts.text: Who are you..?
scripts.translation: 你是誰...？

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: Who are you..?
scripts.translation: 你是誰...？

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
I may look ordinary to you but I have a newfangled talent.
Not my fault, if you are shocked at seeing it.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
在你看來，我或許很普通，但我可是有一項新潮本領。
看了之後要是嚇一跳，可別怪我沒提醒你。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
OK. Where should I start?
First, Bash!
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
好，我從哪兒開始呢？
先來一招狂擊！

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Hehehe.. Surprised?
I'm just pretending...
It's not a real punch.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
嘿嘿...嚇到了吧？
我只是在裝模作樣...
這又不是真的打你。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Looks like you were surprised!
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
看來你被嚇到了！

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Just keep calm
and have a potion
But that's not the last of it.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
冷靜點，喝瓶藥水就好。
不過，好戲還在後頭。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
I have stolen one thread of your hair.
I don't believe in Voodooism.
Regard it as your luck.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
我拔了你一根頭髮。
我可不信什麼巫術。
就當它能給你帶來好運吧。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
The last one is a flame, to say the least!
How about it? Newfangled.
Idling away too long,
All the skills learnt over your shoulder could be used.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
最後再來個火焰，夠厲害吧！
怎麼樣，很新潮吧？
閒逛太久，
平時學的那些技能也該派上用場了。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Ugh, all my SP is gone...
and wasted... I am tired.
I am going back to rest.
So long, Bye-bye~~ Don't bother me anymore.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
唉，我的 SP 都耗光了...
還白白浪費了...我累了。
我回去休息了。
再見，拜拜~~別再來煩我了。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
What? You, disturbing me.
Get away from me kid you're botherin' me.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
幹什麼？別來煩我。
離我遠點，小鬼，吵死了。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Me? I'm Novice.
What? Strange? You seein' me for the first time?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
我？我也是初心者。
怎麼，很奇怪嗎？你以前沒見過我？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
If I look shabby, you should go find a mirror.
You and I are wearing the same thing pal.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
嫌我看起來邋遢？那你該照照鏡子。
朋友，咱倆穿的可是同一套衣服。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
I'm what you call a Novice of all Novices.
A Jack of all trades but a master of none.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
我是初心者中的初心者。
樣樣都會一點，樣樣都不精。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
If you don't graduate from school and hang around and only mimic other's lifesstyles you'll end up like me.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
要是你不畢業，整天待在這兒，只會模仿別人的生活，最後就會變成我這樣。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Genius and idiot has a paper thin difference.
Those of versatility but of no special capability, that is the Super Novice.
That's what everyone calls us.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
天才和笨蛋只有一線之隔。
什麼都會一點，卻沒有一項特別拿手的，這就是超級初心者。
大家都這麼稱呼我們。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
A rose by any other name...
I am what I am. A Super Novice!
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
名字叫什麼都一樣...
我就是我，超級初心者！

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
What? You, disturbing me.
Get away from me kid you're botherin' me.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
幹什麼？別來煩我。
離我遠點，小鬼，吵死了。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
You, talking like this, why don't you go and change your job already instead of hanging around here?
Hmm, did you want to be like me maybe?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
看你這麼能說，幹嘛不乾脆轉職，還在這兒閒逛？
嗯...你該不會也想成為我這樣的人吧？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Aha~ If you want all the different skills...
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
啊哈~你要是想學會各種各樣的技能...

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
If you do like I do, then you will be a great Super Novice.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
照我這樣做，你也能成為了不起的超級初心者。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Hmmm. Dirty mouth!
When I was at your age,
If I recklessly spoke like you, I was dragged to the backside mountain, and then...
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
哼，嘴真臭！
我像你這麼大的時候，
要敢像你這樣亂說話，就會被拖去後山，然後...

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
OK... that's enough..
Now I am in a good mood?
When I am using good words,
go away silently, yes?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
好了...夠了...
我現在心情正好。
難得我好好跟你說話，
你就安靜地走開，聽見了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Are you idling around at school?
I don't need to tell you about it.
If you are loafing around here,
Once grown up, you will be a man like me.
Scary, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
你在學校裡閒逛呢？
這還用我多說嗎？
要是你一直在這兒遊手好閒，
長大後就會變成我這樣的男人。
很可怕吧？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
I know, I know, before we are found by a teacher or even worse the principal.
Go away, gooooooawaaaaaayyyyyyyyy~
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
我知道，我知道，趁還沒被老師發現，更別說校長了。
快走，快快快走吧~

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Well,
What am I doing?
I became like this, in the blink of an eye.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
嗯，
我這是在做什麼？
轉眼間，我竟然變成了這樣。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
By nature, I had a great dream...
Haaaa~~ Because I dreamt of too many things to do?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
我天生就有個遠大的夢想...
哈啊~~是不是因為想做的事情太多了？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Yes, yes, take your way...
I am the Novice of pride and loneliness.
I can enjoy myself.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
好，好，隨你便...
我可是個驕傲又孤獨的初心者。
一個人也能自得其樂。

scripts.text: - Quest cannot be continued due to your overfilled inventory. -
scripts.translation: - 你的背包已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
How are you doing with your basic studies?
You need to learn about the shop information.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
基礎課程學得怎麼樣了？
接下來該瞭解一下商店了。

scripts.text: I'm doing fine myself!
scripts.translation: 我自己能應付！

scripts.text: Ok I'll listen!
scripts.translation: 好啊，我聽聽！

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
If you listen carefully, I will give you a souvenir.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
認真聽完的話，我會送你一份紀念品。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
Wise choise.
Midgard has many shops and many variety of currencies.
So you need to listen to me well to use them accordingly.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
選得明智。
米德加爾特有很多商店，使用的貨幣也各不相同。
聽我仔細說明，才能知道該怎麼使用。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
Let's start.
[Shop Helper Leonie]
Anything else?
scripts.translation:

我們開始吧。

我們開始吧。
你想了解什麼？

Let's start.
scripts.translation:

Ok 1 ^0000ffRed Potion^000000.

scripts.translation:

好的，第一樣是^0000ff紅色藥水^000000。
之後你就可以在野外或迷宮中使用。
作為獎勵，我送你幾片^ff0000蒼蠅翅膀^000000。

scripts.text:

Go to the shop and buy one ^0000ffRed Potion^000000 and bring it back.

scripts.translation:

去商店買一瓶^0000ff紅色藥水^000000帶回來。
身上的錢夠吧？

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
If not, go hunt monsters in the vicnity and then when you sell their loot you should make enough money.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
錢不夠的話，就去附近打魔物，把掉落物賣掉，應該就能湊夠了。

scripts.text: I will do it.
scripts.translation: 我這就去。

scripts.text: Question about the shop.

Let's go into the next lesson.
Hurry back.

我們接著上下一課吧。
快去快回。

You will acquire many items in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
我們繼續下一課。
今後在冒險途中，
你的背包裡會漸漸裝滿各種物品。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
Among those items, there will be ones that you can't drop or trade, these are for quests. These are important items but often times you will also find them to be a burden.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
其中有些是任務物品，不能丟棄或交易。雖然很重要，但有時也會佔著背包，讓人覺得礙事。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
In those times, sell what you can to shops in order to decrease your inventory.
I'll give you an example.
Go to a shop to unload it.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
遇到這種情況，可以把能賣的東西賣給商店，騰出背包空間。
我來舉個例子。
去商店處理掉這件物品吧。

scripts.text: I don't want to do it.
scripts.translation: 我不想賣。

scripts.text: I will do it.
scripts.translation: 我這就去。

scripts.translation: 我想問問商店的事。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
Stingy person!
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
真小氣！

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
About shop variety.
You can buy these items everywhere in the world.
Go sell one ^ff0000Poor Can^000000 that I gave you to the shop.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
再說說商店裡的商品。
這類東西在世界各地的商店都能買到。
把我給你的^ff0000報廢罐頭^000000賣給商店吧。

scripts.text:

[Shop Helper Leonie]
Anything else?

scripts.text: [Shop Helper Leonie]
scripts.translation: [店鋪助手 萊奧妮]

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
You went and sold the ^ff0000Poor Can^000000.
Good work, here's the reward for it.
The things I haven't told you, you will learn throughout your travels.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
你已經把^ff0000報廢罐頭^000000賣掉了。
做得好，這是給你的獎勵。
剩下的知識，你可以在冒險途中慢慢學會。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
You are now in trial period.
Go sell the Poor Can and come back after selling it.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
你現在還在試用考核期。
把報廢罐頭賣掉，再回來找我。

scripts.text: I will do it.
scripts.translation: 我這就去。

Go sell one ^ff0000Poor Can^000000 that I gave you to the shop.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
再說說商店裡的商品。
這類東西在世界各地的商店都能買到。
把我給你的^ff0000報廢罐頭^000000賣給商店吧。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
Anything else?
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 沒有

scripts.text: Yes, there are lot.
scripts.translation: 是的，有很多。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
Goodbye.
The things I haven't told you, you will learn throughout your travels.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
再見。
剩下的知識，你可以在冒險途中慢慢學會。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
What would you like to know?

[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
你想了解什麼？
