scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
You can buy weapons and armor at various armory merchants in each town.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
你可以在各個城鎮的武器店購買武器和防具。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
Healing potions and movement consummables can be found at Tool Shops.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
治療藥水和移動類消耗品可以在道具店買到。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
You'll also find merchants selling items for refining.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
還有商人會出售裝備精煉材料。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
So when you go into a town, try figuring out what shops there are for your benefit.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
到了城鎮後，不妨找找有哪些商店，看看哪些對你有用。

scripts.text: [Shop Helper Leonie]
scripts.translation: [店鋪助手 萊奧妮]

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
Kafras and most NPC merchants use ^ff0000Zeny^000000 but Malangdo and some of the Ash Vacuum worlds use different types of currency.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
卡普拉和大多數 NPC 商人都使用^ff0000Zeny^000000；馬蘭島和異世界的部分地區則使用其他貨幣。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
They are ^ff0000Silvervine Fruit^000000, ^ff0000Splendide Coins^000000, they can be bought at Cash Shop or acquired through quests. The fruits and coins that are collected this way.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
它們分別是^ff0000獼猴桃果實^000000和^ff0000輝煌領域金幣^000000，可以在商城購買，也能通過任務獲得。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
They can be exchanged with unique equipments or gears.
So, if you have plans to venture out to these areas, be sure to collect them.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
這些貨幣可以兌換特殊裝備。
如果你打算去這些地區冒險，記得先收集一些。

scripts.text: [Shop Helper Leonie]
scripts.translation: [店鋪助手 萊奧妮]

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
The icon on the right side called Cash Shop, if you click on it, whether you're in a town, dungeon, or field, you can still buy items anywhere you want.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
點選右側的商城圖示後，無論你身在城鎮、迷宮還是野外，都能隨時購買物品。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
The cash you need to buy the items can be charged on the website.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
購買商城物品所需的點數可以在官網充值。

scripts.text: [Shop Helper Leonie]
scripts.translation: [店鋪助手 萊奧妮]

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
Let's do a simple tutorial.
Go to the shop and buy one ^0000ffRed Potion^000000 and bring it back.
You have that much money, right?
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
來做個簡單的練習吧。
去商店買一瓶^0000ff紅色藥水^000000帶回來。
錢夠吧？

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
If not, go hunt monsters in the vicnity and then when you sell their loot you should make enough money.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
錢不夠的話，就去附近打魔物，把掉落物賣掉，應該就能湊夠了。

scripts.text: That's too tedious.
scripts.translation: 太麻煩了

scripts.text: I will do it.
scripts.translation: 我這就去。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
Are you that lazy?
I am watching!
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
你有這麼懶嗎？
我可看著呢！

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
Let's go into the next lesson.
Hurry back.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
我們繼續下一課。
快去快回。

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]
That's a relief that you know enough.
If you have more questions, please ask me again.
scripts.translation:
[店鋪助手 萊奧妮]
看來你已經懂得不少了，真讓人放心。
還有問題的話，隨時再來問我。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Are you a new student? Ask me anything if you have questions about atttribute. I am an attribute expert.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
你是新來的學生嗎？對屬性有疑問的話儘管問我，我可是屬性專家。

scripts.text: What are attributes?
scripts.translation: 什麼是屬性？

scripts.text: Harmony of attributes
scripts.translation: 屬性相剋

scripts.text: Experience of attribute
scripts.translation: 體驗屬性剋制

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
All materials in the world have their own attributes.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
世上的一切事物都有各自的屬性。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
There are many types of attributes. There are 4 elemental attributes ^0D6EF2Water^000000, ^006600Wind^000000, ^FF0000Fire^000000, ^B97246Earth^000000.

[Attribute Expert]
There are more uncommon ones like... Neutral, Poison, Holy, Dark, Angel, Undead.
There are more types than you think right?
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
還有一些較少見的屬性...無屬性、毒、神聖、暗、不死。
屬性種類比你想像的還多吧？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
All right, here's the question which attribute do we belong to?
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
好了，考考你：我們屬於什麼屬性？

scripts.text: Water
scripts.translation: 水

scripts.text: Wind
scripts.translation: 風

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 火

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 地

scripts.text: Neutral
scripts.translation: 無屬性

scripts.text: Poison
scripts.translation: 毒

scripts.text: Holy
scripts.translation: 神聖

scripts.text: Dark
scripts.translation: 暗

scripts.text: Angel
scripts.translation: 天使

scripts.text: Undead
scripts.translation: 不死

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Correct! You are good. Yes we belong to the Neutral attribute.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
答對了！你很聰明嘛。沒錯，我們屬於無屬性。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Do you think so?
We belong to the Neutral.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
你覺得呢？
我們屬於無屬性。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Then, why do we need attributes? Maybe you know the answer... right?
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
那麼，我們為什麼會有屬性呢？你應該知道答案吧？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Everything needs to balance with something srong and something weak. So ^3131FFbalance and harmony^000000 comes along all the time.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
萬物之間都有強弱之分，因此^3131FF平衡與相剋^000000始終存在。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Balance and harmony is strongly related to your power as well. So remember well.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
屬性平衡與相剋關係，也會深深影響你的戰鬥力。記住這一點。

scripts.text: Water
scripts.translation: 水

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 火

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 地

scripts.text: Wind
scripts.translation: 風

scripts.text: Etc...
scripts.translation: 其他...

scripts.text: I already know
scripts.translation: 我已經知道了

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^0D6EF2Water^000000 is stronger than ^FF0000Fire^000000, so they give bonus damage to anything with Fire attribute!
But it is weak to ^006600Wind^000000.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
^0D6EF2水^000000剋制^FF0000火^000000，因此攻擊火屬性魔物時會造成額外傷害！
不過，水屬性會被^006600風^000000剋制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Examples of monsters with the Water Attribute are Poring and Roda Frog... have you heard of those monsters?
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
波利和羅達蛙就是水屬性魔物。
你聽說過它們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^FF0000Fire^000000 is stronger than ^B97246Earth^000000, so they give bonus damage to anything with Earth attribute!
Examples of monsters with the Fire Attribute are Drops and Picky.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
^FF0000火^000000剋制^B97246地^000000，因此攻擊地屬性魔物時會造成額外傷害！
土波利和小雞就是火屬性魔物。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Examples of monsters with the Fire Attribute are Drops and Picky.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
土波利和小雞就是火屬性魔物。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^B97246Earth^000000 is stronger than  ^006600Wind^000000, so they give bonus damage to anything with Wind attribute!
But it is weak to ^FF0000Fire^000000.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
^B97246地^000000剋制^006600風^000000，因此攻擊風屬性魔物時會造成額外傷害！
不過，地屬性會被^FF0000火^000000剋制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Examples of monsters with the Earth Attribute are Pupa and Fabre.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
蟲蛹和綠棉蟲就是地屬性魔物。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^006600Wind^000000 is stronger than ^0D6EF2Water^000000, so they give bonus damage to anything with Water attribute!
But it is weak to ^B97246Earth^000000.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
^006600風^000000剋制^0D6EF2水^000000，因此攻擊水屬性魔物時會造成額外傷害！
不過，風屬性會被^B97246地^000000剋制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Examples of monsters with the Wind Attribute are ChonChon and Hornet.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
蒼蠅和蜂兵就是風屬性魔物。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^3131FFPoison^000000 is stronger than Fire, Wind, and Earth, but weak at Undead attribute.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
^3131FF毒^000000剋制火、風和地屬性，但會被不死屬性剋制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
It is important.. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
這很重要...對吧？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Do you want to experience an attribute?
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
想親自體驗一下屬性相剋嗎？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
All right, do you see those ^3131FFFire Eggs^000000 over there?
Go over there and smack one of them.
Don't worry about destroying it either.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
好，你看到那邊的^3131FF火蛋^000000了嗎？
過去打它一下吧。
不用擔心會把它打壞。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
How is it? Have you ever attacked to Fire Eggs?
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
感覺怎麼樣？以前打過火蛋嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 沒有

scripts.text: I want to quit.
scripts.translation: 我想結束了。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
How much damage did you give?
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
你造成了多少傷害？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Oh man, {0}! Are you even trying?
You're barely hitting it.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
哎呀，{0}！你有認真打嗎？
你幾乎沒對它造成傷害。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
You are good I guess...
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
看來你還挺厲害的...

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
But wait that's impossible.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
等等，這不可能。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
All right. Class is over.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
好了，下課。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
I am not sure if you remember monsters with ^FF0000Fire^000000 are weak against ^0D6EF2Water^000000.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
不知道你還記不記得，^FF0000火^000000屬性魔物會被^0D6EF2水^000000屬性剋制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
I will give the ^0D6EF2Water^000000 attribute to you as a present.
If you attack the Fire Eggs again you should do more damage now.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
我把^0D6EF2水^000000屬性當作禮物送給你。
現在再去攻擊火蛋，應該能造成更多傷害。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
There is only one more chance!
Hurry up, the attribute magic will be gone if you take more time thanks for joining to my class.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
只剩最後一次機會！
快點，再磨蹭下去屬性魔法就要消失了。謝謝你來上課！

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Go and smack those eggs over there.
The egg of an ant is strong so don't worry about destroying them too much.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
去打那邊的蛋吧。
螞蟻蛋很堅固，不用怕把它們打壞。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
There is nothing I can do. But I will help you anytime if you need.
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
我幫不了你更多。不過，你隨時可以來找我求助。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Magic basically consists of different attribute attacks. There is another way of giving the attribute to your weapon by using skill or item. You will learn more the longer you play. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
魔法基本上都是屬性攻擊。也可以通過技能或道具改變武器的屬性。玩得越久，你就會懂得越多。祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Are you getting interested in the depth of the different attributes?
scripts.translation:
[屬性專家]
你開始對各種屬性的奧妙感興趣了嗎？

scripts.text:
Why are you carrying so much stuff?
Put them down and come back.
scripts.translation: 行李帶得太多了。先放下一些東西再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
What an alluring smell!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
這香氣真誘人！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Various dishes to stimulate the five senses. Oh, its heaven!
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
各式料理，刺激你的五感...啊，簡直是天堂！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
It's not an accident that you came here!
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
你能來到這裡絕非偶然！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
What's your name stranger?
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
陌生人，你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
I am Dacquoise, the pupil of the legendary chef of Rune-Midgarts, ^0000cdCharles Orleans^000000.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
我是達克瓦茲，盧恩·米德加茲王國傳奇主廚^0000cd查爾斯·奧爾良^000000的弟子。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
And we are also club members of Sir Orleans' ^0000cdfan club- Loverleans^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
我們也是奧爾良爵士^0000cd粉絲俱樂部“戀奧爾良”^000000的成員呢！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Orlean belongs to all of us!
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
奧爾良爵士可是屬於大家的！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Ah, what do all the fools of the land eat?
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
啊，俗人都吃些什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Fruits? Of course you can eat it raw, but isn't it art when you see the red strawberries laying on top of a creampie?
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
水果？當然可以直接吃，不過看到紅豔豔的草莓鋪在奶油派上，不覺得像一件藝術品嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Bread? Of course you can eat it plain, but can you resist the fantastic harmony of meat and cheese and vegetables in a perfect sandwich?
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
麵包？當然可以直接吃，但你能抵擋完美三明治中肉、乳酪與蔬菜交織出的絕妙滋味嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
I like the steamed horse feet of Minourus!
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
我喜歡吃清蒸米洛斯馬蹄！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
If you eat a dedicated meal, you can ^0000cdraise a specific stats^000000 and additionally, ^0000cdrecover your health^000000, so what's the reason not to cook?
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
吃一頓精心烹製的料理，既能^0000cd提升特定屬性^000000，還能^0000cd恢復體力^000000。這樣你還有什麼理由不下廚？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
You, do you want to know more about cooking?
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
你想進一步瞭解烹飪嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Will you exeprience the various spectrums of cooking?
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
想親自體驗各種料理的魅力嗎？

scripts.text: I'm not interested, excuse me...
scripts.translation: 我沒興趣，告辭了...

scripts.text: Wow! I want to know more!
scripts.translation: 哇！我想多瞭解一些！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Really? Okay then... come back whenever you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
真的？好吧...改變主意的話，隨時歡迎再來。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
I have a hunch that you will come back again!
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
我有預感，你還會再回來的！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Don't forget to pound your chest if you choke on sweet potato!
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
吃紅薯噎住的話，記得捶捶胸口哦！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Ok, we will be kind guides to the journey of cooking!!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
好！我們會帶你踏上精彩的烹飪之旅！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
It's ok with me, asking me everthing you want to know.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
當然可以，想知道什麼儘管問我。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Kindness is our spice~
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
親切就是我們的調味料~

scripts.text: Cooking Benefits
scripts.translation: 烹飪的好處

scripts.text: Cooking Methods
scripts.translation: 烹飪方法

scripts.text: Actually, I have to go...
scripts.translation: 其實，我得走了...

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Aha! You want to know about the benefits of cooking? Cooked meals have two benefits!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
啊哈！想知道烹飪有什麼好處嗎？料理有兩大益處！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
First, ^0000cdincreased stats!^000000 Baaam!!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
第一，^0000cd提升屬性！^000000砰！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Cooking is divided into 6 catagories. Each will raise up ^0000cdStr, Agi, Vit, Int, Dex, Luk^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
料理分為六類，分別提升^0000cd力量、敏捷、體質、智力、靈巧和幸運^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
The amount of the stat increase changes depending on the level of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
屬性提升幅度會隨料理等級而變化。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
And the next benefit? Babam!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
第二個好處呢？鏘鏘！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
^0000cdHP and SP recovery^000000 effect!
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
^0000cd恢復 HP 和 SP^000000！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
This also differs with cooking levels, and some only recover HP.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
恢復量也會隨料理等級而變化，有些料理只能恢復 HP。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
How is it? Sounds yummy right?
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
怎麼樣？聽起來很誘人吧？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Your level is too low to experience the effects right now. If you level up more you will experience and cry for the effect of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
你現在等級太低，還無法體驗這些效果。再升幾級就能親自感受烹飪的妙處，到時候你一定會感動得哭出來。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Prepare lace handkerchief.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
記得準備一條蕾絲手帕。

scripts.text: How can I cook?
scripts.translation: 怎麼烹飪？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
There you go! Now you seem interested!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
這就對了！看來你很感興趣嘛！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
But haste is waste in cooking! Proper cooking requires preparation.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
不過，烹飪急不得！想做出好料理，準備工作可不能少。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Only the one who is well prepared can enter the world of cooking!
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
只有準備充分的人，才能踏入烹飪的世界！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Preparation, it's not hard!
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
準備起來並不難！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Preparation can also be split into two stages.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
沒錯，準備工作可以分成兩個階段。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Right, cooking needs some preparation. This can also be divided into two catagories.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
烹飪確實需要事先準備，而且可以分成兩類。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
What is this? What a waste of time!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
這是什麼啊？真浪費時間！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
I thought we were going to get more members!
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
我還以為我們要招募更多成員呢！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Never show up again!!
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
以後別再出現了！！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
First, you need a ^0000cdCookbook.^000000
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
首先，你需要一本^0000cd食譜^000000。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Let's say you have a mountain of ingredients, but you don't know what to do with them?
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
假設你手頭有一大堆食材，卻不知道該怎麼處理呢？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
That's when you open the Cookbook.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
這時候就該翻開食譜了。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You need a Cookbook to know how to prepare the ingredients for cooking.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
你得先有食譜，才能知道該如何準備烹飪食材。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
So how can I get these Cookbooks?
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
那要怎麼獲得食譜呢？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Cookbook can be earned ^0000cdthrough Quest^000000s or can be found by hunting ^0000cdmonster^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
食譜可以通過^0000cd任務^000000獲得，也可能從狩獵^0000cd魔物^000000時掉落。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
After getting the Cookbook, next preperation is!
The ^0000cdingredients!^000000.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
拿到食譜後，接下來要準備的就是——
^0000cd食材！^000000

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
You can't cook without ingredients! Even a novice knows that!
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
沒有食材怎麼烹飪！連初心者都知道吧！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
You can get ingredients by beating or smashing ^0000cdmonster^000000 or you can buy them from a ^0000cdCooking Ingredient Merchant^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
你可以通過狩獵^0000cd魔物^000000取得食材，也可以向^0000cd烹飪食材商人^000000購買。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Cooking requires some preparation but the benefits are well worth it.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
烹飪需要一些準備，但這些付出絕對值得。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
And one thing to remember, there is ^0000cda potential to fail in cooking^000000.  Be careful as it depends on your cookwares and cooking level.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
還有一點要記住：^0000cd烹飪有失敗的可能^000000。成功率會受到廚具和烹飪等級影響，要多加小心。

scripts.text: I want to cook!
scripts.translation: 我想學烹飪！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
That's the spirit! Let's cook for real!
Get prepared and come back!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
就是要有這股幹勁！那就正式開始烹飪吧！
準備好後再回來！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
We are not responsible even if it fails!
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
失敗了我們可不負責哦！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Did you bring them all?
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
東西都帶齊了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes! I did!
scripts.translation: 是的，都帶齊了！

scripts.text: No, I gave up.
scripts.translation: 沒有，我放棄了。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
I used my valuable time to introduce the cooking world to you.
Then you just give up?
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
我可是花了寶貴時間給你介紹烹飪的世界。
你居然就這麼放棄了？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
You have insulted us!
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
你這是在侮辱我們！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Come back again, if you want to learn later~ I guess...
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
以後想學的話再來吧~大概吧...

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Can I have a look?
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
我看看，可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You brough what I need! Okay, then I will cook for you as I promised.
Time to move like greased lightning!!!!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
你把我要的東西都帶來了！好，那我就兌現承諾，為你做料理。
我這就飛快地開工！！！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Go hunting after eating this. You will feel your power enhanced.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
吃完這個再去打獵吧，你會覺得自己變強了。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you really want to cook, go and see ^0000ffSir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera castle^000000!!
Kya... Sir Orleans!!
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
真想學烹飪的話，就去普隆德拉王宮地下室找^0000ff查爾斯·奧爾良爵士^000000！！
呀...奧爾良爵士！！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You brough what I need! Okay, then I will cook for you as I promised.
Time to move like greased lightning!!!!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
你把我要的東西都帶來了！好，那我就兌現承諾，為你做料理。
我這就飛快地開工！！！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Try this. It will make you run like you are a flying bee.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
嚐嚐這個。吃了之後，你會跑得像飛翔的蜜蜂一樣快。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you really want to cook, go and see ^0000ffSir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera castle^000000!! You must be attracted by him!!
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
真想學烹飪的話，就去普隆德拉王宮地下室找^0000ff查爾斯·奧爾良爵士^000000吧！你一定會被他迷住的！！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You brough what I need! Okay, then I will cook for you as I promised.
Time to move like greased lightning!!!!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
你把我要的東西都帶來了！好，那我就兌現承諾，為你做料理。
我這就飛快地開工！！！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Can you feel unknown power coursing through your veins? You're eating it!
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
能感覺到一股神秘力量在血管裡奔湧嗎？你吃下去的正是這股力量！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you are really curious about the cooking, go seek Sir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera Castle.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
真想了解烹飪的話，就去普隆德拉王宮地下室找查爾斯·奧爾良爵士吧。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You brough what I need! Okay, then I will cook for you as I promised.
Time to move like greased lightning!!!!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
你把我要的東西都帶來了！好，那我就兌現承諾，為你做料理。
我這就飛快地開工！！！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
If you eat this. You will never miss your target!
In fact, never miss the target for level 1!
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
吃了這個，你就不會打偏了！
至少在 1 級時，絕不會打偏！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Go and see Sir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera castle!!
You can learn real cooking from him!
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
去普隆德拉王宮地下室找查爾斯·奧爾良爵士吧！！
你可以向他學習真正的烹飪！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
What do you want me to do without ingredients? Go and get them myself?
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
沒有食材你還想讓我做什麼？難道要我自己去找嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You came back to me again because you want to cook, right?
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
你又回來了，想學烹飪，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
So what do you want to cook?
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
那你想做什麼料理？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Oh? That kid is back again. {0} right? So what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
哦，那個孩子又回來了。是{0}吧？這次想做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Are you ready? Then making is believing! Let's cook!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
準備好了嗎？光說不練可不行，來做料理吧！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
For this demonstration the duration of the cooking will be shortened.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
這次只是演示，烹飪時間會縮短。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
The cooking we are about to show you requires a recipe and cooking equipment but it is difficult for novices so I will cook for you.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
接下來要示範的料理需要食譜和廚具，對初心者來說有些難，所以這次由我來做給你看。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Why are you saying you will make them?
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
為什麼要由你來做？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ah, Why not?
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
咦？為什麼不行？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
I am the leader of this flame cooking trio chefs!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
我可是火焰料理三人組的隊長！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
What?!! When was that decided?
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
什麼？！！這是誰決定的？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Is there anyone who is older than me?
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
你們誰比我年紀大？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Age! There is nothing I can do with it.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
年紀！這我也沒辦法啊。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Just because you're one year older, you want to automatically be rejected. Anyone have an objection?
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
就因為你大一歲，就想自封為頭兒？有人反對嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Quiet!
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
安靜！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
So what do you want to make? Int and Luk meals would have no benefit to you, so I prepared the other 4 foods.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
你想做哪一種？智力和幸運料理對你沒什麼用，所以我準備了另外四種。

scripts.text: Fragrant Herb Mix
scripts.translation: 香草什錦

scripts.text: Crunchy Salad
scripts.translation: 脆爽沙拉

scripts.text: Mixed Shabu Shabu
scripts.translation: 什錦涮涮鍋

scripts.text: Golden Apple Roast
scripts.translation: 金蘋果烤肉

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
^0000cdFragrant Herb Mix^000000. It increases ^0000cdStr^000000.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
^0000cd香草什錦^000000可以提升^0000cd力量^000000。

scripts.text:
[Equazu]
It's usually eaten by people of strength.
scripts.translation:
[埃誇祖]
力量型的人通常會吃這道料理。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ingredients- ^0000cd1 Clover, 1 Green Herb, 1 Red Herb^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
食材：^0000cd1 株三葉草、1 株綠色藥草、1 株紅色藥草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Clover and the Red Herb are dropped by Lunatic or Fabre monsters wandering everywhere on the field outside Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
依斯魯得島外的野地裡，瘋兔或綠棉蟲會掉落三葉草和紅色藥草。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Green Herbs are dropped by Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
綠棉蟲會掉落綠色藥草。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
We can cook once you bring all the ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
你把食材帶齊後，我們就能開火了。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Crunchy Salad. This I really like. You know your cooking.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
脆爽沙拉啊，我最喜歡這道菜了。看來你很懂吃嘛。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Crunchy Salad increases ^0000cdAgi^000000. Good for fast attacks and avoiding damage from monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
脆爽沙拉能提升^0000cd敏捷^000000，適合想加快攻擊速度或躲避魔物攻擊的人。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ingredients are ^0000cd1 Apple & 2 Carrots^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
食材：^0000cd1 個蘋果和 2 根胡蘿蔔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Apples are dropped by Porings bouncing around the field outside of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
依斯魯得島外的野地裡，波利會掉落蘋果。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Carrots are given by Lunatics.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
瘋兔會掉落胡蘿蔔。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you bring all the ingredients we can cook.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
你把食材帶齊後，我們就能開火了！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Scary ^0000cdAnything ShabuShabu!^000000 This raises ^0000cdVit^000000. Even a small portion makes you full.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
^0000cd驚人的什錦涮涮鍋！^000000可以提升^0000cd體質^000000。即使只吃一點，也會很有飽足感。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
If you eat this, you can feel less pain from monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
吃了它，被魔物攻擊時就不會那麼痛了。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ingredients are ^0000cd1 Jellopy, 1 Fluff, 1 Feather^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
食材：^0000cd1 個傑勒比結晶、1 團絨毛和 1 根羽毛^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Jellopy are dropped by Porings bouncing around the field of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
依斯魯得的野地裡，波利會掉落傑勒比結晶。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Fluff can be received from Fabre or Lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
絨毛可以從綠棉蟲或瘋兔身上獲得。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Feathers are dropped by Lunatics or Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
瘋兔或綠棉蟲會掉落羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
When you bring all the ingredients I'll make them for you.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
把所有食材帶齊，我就做給你吃。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
^0000cdGolden Apple Toast~^000000 shiny golden glaze...  It tastes as good as it looks.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
^0000cd金蘋果吐司~^000000金黃的糖衣閃閃發亮...味道和賣相一樣棒。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
This raises ^0000cdDex^000000. It is mainly enjoyed by Archers who want to increase his attacking power or by people to increase their hit rate.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
這能提升^0000cd靈巧^000000。弓箭手想提高攻擊力，或任何想提升命中率的人，都會喜歡這道料理。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ingredients are-^0000cd 1 Apple & 1 Clover^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
食材：^0000cd1 個蘋果和 1 株三葉草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Apple can be found in Porings in the field outside of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
依斯魯得島外的野地裡，波利會掉落蘋果。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Clovers are dropped by Lunatics or Fabre in the field outside Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
瘋兔或綠棉蟲會在依斯魯得島外的野地裡掉落三葉草。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
When you bring all the ingredients I'll make them for you.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
把所有食材帶齊，我就做給你吃。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
I am Dacquoise, the pupil of the legendary chef of Rune-Midgarts, ^0000cdCharles Orleans^000000.
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
我是達克瓦茲，盧恩·米德加茲王國傳奇主廚^0000cd查爾斯·奧爾良^000000的弟子。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Steaks not only increase stats but also recover both your HP and SP.
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
牛排不但能提升屬性，還能同時恢復 HP 和 SP。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you really want to cook, go and see^0000cd Sir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera castle^000000!! You must be attracted by him!!
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
真想學烹飪的話，就去普隆德拉王宮地下室找^0000cd查爾斯·奧爾良爵士^000000吧！！你一定會被他迷住的！！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Looks like you're no longer a beginner. Are you cooking these days?
scripts.translation:
[達克瓦茲]
看來你已經不是新手了。最近有在做料理嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
If not why don't we start?
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
如果還沒有，不如現在開始吧？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Steaks not only increase stats but also recover both your HP and SP.
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
牛排不但能提升屬性，還能同時恢復 HP 和 SP。

scripts.text:
[Flame Cook Trio Chefs]
If you really want to cook, go and meet ^0000cdSir. Charles Olreans at the basement of the Prontera castle^000000! You must be attracted by him.
scripts.translation:
[火焰料理三人組]
真想學烹飪的話，就去普隆德拉王宮地下室見見^0000cd查爾斯·奧爾良爵士^000000吧！你一定會被他迷住的。

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
背包已滿，無法繼續任務。
整理好物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Are you interested in the beginner's guild?
I am selling Combination books and kits.
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
對初心者公會感興趣嗎？
我這裡有賣組合書和組合專用工具。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
To the Criatura students below level 20, a special sale is going on. Hope you to buy a lot!!!
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
基礎等級未滿 20 級的克里阿圖拉學院學生可以享受特價。歡迎多買一些！！！

scripts.text: Novice Combination Book
scripts.translation: 新手物品組合書

scripts.text: Combination Kit
scripts.translation: 組合專用工具

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Have you been treated by the Therapist?
At the medical botany class, you may receive a guild book.
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
治療師幫你治療過了嗎？
上完藥用植物學課程後，可以領取公會組合書。

scripts.text: Ah... is that so?
scripts.translation: 啊...是這樣嗎？

scripts.text: I lost it.
scripts.translation: 我弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Later, buy a lot of the guild combination kits~~~
I am selling them at a jaw dropping price to students below base level 20.
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
之後記得多買些公會組合專用工具哦~~~
基礎等級未滿 20 級的學生可以享受超低價。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Say what?
A book costs you 1000z.
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
什麼？
一本書要 1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
You mean the combination book.
A book costs you 1000z.
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
你是說組合書吧？
一本要 1000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 購買

scripts.text: Don't buy.
scripts.translation: 不買

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Use it next time.
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
下次再用吧。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Here you are.
This book is for the beginners. But it will allow you combine the useful tools together, if you use it correctly.
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
給你。
這是給初心者用的書。只要使用得當，就能用它組合出實用工具。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
The book price is 1000 zeny.
You seem to be short of zeny.
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
這本書售價 1000 Zeny。
看來你的 Zeny 不夠。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Breaking news! Special sale for you only!
One combination kit only for 30z!
How many do you need?
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
特大新聞！只給你的特別優惠！
組合專用工具一套只要 30 Zeny！
你要幾套？

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
No sales today.
One combination kit costs you 500z.
Tell me how many pieces you need?
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
今天沒有特價。
組合專用工具一套要 500 Zeny。
告訴我你要幾套？

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Well, you don't need to buy it now.
Use it next time.
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
嗯，你現在不必買。
下次再用吧。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
How many pieces do you need?
You can buy up to 99 at once.
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
你要幾套？
一次最多可以買 99 套。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
{0} combination kits will cost you {1}.... zeny.
You look short of money for that amount.
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
{0} 套組合專用工具要 {1}... Zeny。
看來你的錢不夠買這麼多。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
{0} combination kits will cost you {1}.... zeny.
Thank you. Come back again.
scripts.translation:
[奎裡]
{0} 套組合專用工具要 {1}... Zeny。
謝謝惠顧，歡迎再來。

scripts.text:
- You have too many items.
- Clear inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
- 你帶的物品太多了。
- 清理一下背包再試試。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
You shouldn't be like this, you are high enough to change your job.
I won't stop you even if you stay still...
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
你不該一直待在這裡，你的等級已經足夠轉職了。
不過你要是繼續原地踏步...我也不會攔著你...

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Try to talk to ^ff0000each job instructor^000000 on the 2nd floor of the Academy if you aren't sure what job you want still.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
如果你還沒決定想轉哪個職業，可以去學院二樓和^ff0000各職業導師^000000聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Welcome!
I am ^ff0000Battle Instructor Subino^000000.
I ^ff0000provice a simple request^000000 to help you to grow up as good a soldier as fast as you can, so look around.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
歡迎！
我是^ff0000戰鬥指導員蘇比諾^000000。
為了幫你儘快成長為優秀的戰士，我會發布^ff0000一些簡單的委託^000000，四處看看吧。

scripts.text: Check requests
scripts.translation: 檢視委託

scripts.text: Warp me to the Field
scripts.translation: 送我去野外

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: The most delicious in the world (1~3)
scripts.translation: 世上最美味的東西（1～3）

scripts.text: Carrots are delicious (1~3)
scripts.translation: 胡蘿蔔真好吃（1～3）

scripts.text: Fabre rolling clothes (4~6)
scripts.translation: 綠棉蟲絨衣（4～6）

scripts.text: Barrier!! (4~6)
Stop.
scripts.translation: 停

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Poring^000000s are very cute monsters when you see them.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
^ff0000波利^000000看起來都是非常可愛的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
They drop Jellopy which are regarded as a main cooking material in Criatura Academy so we always need to hunt Porings.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
波利會掉落傑勒比結晶，這是克里阿圖拉學院常用的烹飪材料，所以我們總得去狩獵波利。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Lunatic^000000s are very cute animal that live near Prontera.
Tender...Soft...Very cute... It is very cute........
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
^ff0000瘋兔^000000是生活在普隆德拉附近的可愛動物。
軟綿綿...軟乎乎...超可愛...可愛極了...

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
It always bring ^ff0000Carrot^000000s with it, so it is easy to get a delicious carrot by hunting them.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
瘋兔總帶著^ff0000胡蘿蔔^000000，狩獵它們就能輕鬆獲得美味的胡蘿蔔。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
A carrot has lots of fibrous cells and contains vitamin A and carotin so it is good for eyes!
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
胡蘿蔔富含膳食纖維，還含有維生素 A 和胡蘿蔔素，對眼睛很有好處！

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Fabre^000000 is the most common bug which is usually seen in Rune-Midgarts Kingdom..
It is a worm but it is very popular because it looks cute.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
^ff0000綠棉蟲^000000是盧恩·米德加茲王國最常見的蟲子。
雖然是隻蟲子，卻因為長得可愛而很受歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Most of the clothes provided by Criatura Academy are made from ^ff0000Fluff^000000 from Fabres. It makes very strong and warm fabric.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
克里阿圖拉學院的大部分制服，都是用綠棉蟲掉落的^ff0000絨毛^000000製成的。用它織出的布料既結實又保暖。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Pupa^000000 is the intermediate stage of a Fabre before transforming into a Creamy.
The process of a larva turning into a buttefly is mysterious.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
^ff0000蟲蛹^000000是綠棉蟲變成克瑞米之前的階段。
幼蟲蛻變成蝴蝶的過程真是奇妙。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
As a Fabre transforms to a Creamy I hope that all Novices turn to be great adventurers! So ^ff0000Chrysalis^000000.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
就像綠棉蟲會變成克瑞米，我也希望所有初心者都能成長為優秀的冒險者！所以，來一場^ff0000蛻變^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Hornet^000000s are a group of bees that live near Prontera under control of the Queen bee Mistress.
Not aggressive... They only attack with their stingers when they are in danger.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
^ff0000蜂兵^000000是生活在普隆德拉附近、受蜂后妖后統領的蜂群。
它們通常不會主動攻擊，只有感到危險時才會用毒針反擊。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
There is a study about using the poison extracted from their stingers to make an antidote in Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
克里阿圖拉學院正在研究如何利用蜂兵毒針中的毒液製作解毒劑。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
You don't seem to be interested.
Come back again if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
看來你不感興趣。
改變主意的話，歡迎再來。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Ok, I'll send you to the West field of Izlude.
Be sure you know how to get back.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
好，我送你去依斯魯得西部野外。
記得先弄清楚該怎麼回來。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
You don't seem to be interested.
Come back again if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
看來你不感興趣。
改變主意的話，歡迎再來。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
You didn't register with the ^ff0000Criatura Academy^000000 yet?
It requires a simple procedure so go and register.
You can register at the ^ff0000information center of academy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
你還沒在^ff0000克里阿圖拉學院^000000註冊嗎？
手續很簡單，去辦一下就好。
可以在^ff0000學院諮詢中心^000000註冊。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
You don't seem to need my help.
You'd better look around somewhere else or go to the wider world.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
看來你不需要我的幫助。
不妨去別處看看，或是踏上更廣闊的世界。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Visit the ^ff0000support of the class guild (Lv. 10~20) or check out the Eden Group (Lv. 15~100)^000000.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
前往^ff0000職業公會支援處（等級 10～20）或樂園團（等級 15～100）^000000。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Ask the staff of each job on the second floor about the location of each class guild^000000 and you will find the ^ff0000Eden Group Headquarters^000000 where you can find easy hunt quests.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
^ff0000向二樓各職業的導師打聽職業公會的位置^000000，之後就能找到^ff0000樂園團總部^000000，那裡有簡單的狩獵委託。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
It is ^ff0000displayed in the map of right screen^000000, so search for it.
If you do not know, then you should get a help from a ^ff0000Town Guide^000000.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
位置^ff0000會顯示在螢幕右側的小地圖上^000000，仔細找找吧。
找不到的話，可以向^ff0000城鎮嚮導^000000求助。

scripts.text: Take quest.
scripts.translation: 接取委託

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停

Come back again if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
看來你不感興趣。
改變主意的話，歡迎再來。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
{0}s {1} in ^ff0000West field of Prontera^000000.
{2}s are difficult to catch for a Novice... But if you gather more Novices, you can do it.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
{0}只{1}出現在^ff0000普隆德拉西部野外^000000。
{2}對初心者來說很難對付...多找幾個初心者組隊就能完成。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
{0} {1} at the ^ff0000West field of Izlude^000000.
{2} ^ff0000{3} {4}s^000000 and bring ^ff0000{5} {6}^000000.

[Battle Instructor Subino]
{0} ^ff0000{1} {2}s^000000 and bring ^ff0000{3} {4}^000000.

End Conversation

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Will you really give up on the quest?
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
你確定要放棄這項委託嗎？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: Give up for sure.
scripts.translation: 確定放棄

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
You can challenge the quest as long as you need my help so come to me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
有需要我幫忙的委託，隨時都可以來找我。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
You don't have enough ^ff0000{0}^000000.
Do better!
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
你的^ff0000{0}^000000不夠。
再加把勁！

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: Give up on the quest.
scripts.translation: 放棄委託

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Will you really give up on the quest?
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
你確定要放棄這項委託嗎？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: Yes, give up.
scripts.translation: 是，放棄。

[Battle Instructor Subino]
You can challenge the quest as long as you need my help so come to me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
有需要我幫忙的委託，隨時都可以來找我。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Wow..!!
Well done!!
scripts.translation:
[戰鬥指導員 蘇比諾]
哇...！！
幹得漂亮！！

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Any questions about getting a monster to become a pet?
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
想知道如何把魔物馴養成寵物嗎？

scripts.text: Taming a monster
scripts.translation: 馴服魔物

scripts.text: Hatching the egg
scripts.translation: 孵化寵物蛋

scripts.text: Monitoring pet's status
scripts.translation: 檢視寵物狀態

scripts.text: Feeding
scripts.translation: 餵食

scripts.text: Performances
scripts.translation: 特殊動作

scripts.text: Removing the accessory
scripts.translation: 取下飾品

scripts.text: Transforming back to egg
scripts.translation: 變回寵物蛋

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Only some monsters can become pets and they all have different things to tame them.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
只有部分魔物可以成為寵物，而且每種魔物需要的馴服道具都不一樣。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Each monster that can be tamed requires a specific ^3131FFtaming item^000000.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
每種可馴服的魔物都有對應的^3131FF馴服道具^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
To begin taming,
^3131FFdouble click^000000 the taming item in your inventory and select which monster to tame.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
要馴服魔物，先在背包裡^3131FF雙擊^000000馴服道具，再選擇目標魔物。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Press ^3131FFClick^000000 in the center of the pop-up slot machine to tame the monster..
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
點選彈出的老虎機視窗中央的^3131FF“點選”^000000按鈕，就能嘗試馴服魔物。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
If successful, the monster will be tranformed into an egg!
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
馴服成功後，魔物就會變成寵物蛋！

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Hatching requires you to have a ^3131FF<Pet Incubator>^000000 to awaken a monster in the egg.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
要孵化寵物蛋，必須持有^3131FF<攜帶用孵蛋器>^000000，才能喚醒蛋裡的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Most towns have a ^3131FF<Pet Groomer>^000000 where you can buy the ^3131FF<Pet Incubator>^000000.
Ask the town guide for the location of the Pet Groomer if you can't find them.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
大多數城鎮都有^3131FF<寵物美容師>^000000，能在那裡買到^3131FF<攜帶用孵蛋器>^000000。
找不到的話，可以向城鎮嚮導打聽寵物美容師的位置。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
^3131FFRight-click^000000 on your pet and select ^3131ffCheck the Pet Status^000000 to check on its status. Or you can press ^3131FF<Alt+J>^000000.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
^3131FF右鍵點選^000000寵物，再選擇^3131ff檢視寵物狀態^000000即可檢視狀態。也可以按^3131FF<Alt+J>^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
This will open up the Status Window. Here you can change the pet's ^3131FFname^000000 as well as check their ^3131FFHunter^000000 and ^3131FFIntimacy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
這樣會開啟狀態視窗。在這裡可以更改寵物的^3131FF名字^000000，檢視它的^3131FF飢餓度^000000和^3131FF親密度^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
There are some special pets that gives special skills when their ^3131FFIntimacy^000000 level becomes Loyal. Most pets start off as shy and time and food changes that.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
有些特殊寵物的^3131FF親密度^000000達到“忠誠”後會學會特殊技能。大多數寵物一開始都很怕生，隨著時間推移並餵食，就會逐漸親近你。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
<Pet Food> is normal food for pets but some pets prefer other foods. You should keep enough with you so your pet doesn't get hungry.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
<寵物飼料>是寵物的常見食物，但有些寵物偏愛其他食物。記得隨身帶夠食物，別讓寵物餓著。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Pets will ^3131FFrun away^000000 if they are too full or too hungry. So make sure you check your pets hunger status frequently!
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
寵物太飽或太餓都會^3131FF逃跑^000000。記得經常檢視寵物的飢餓度！

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Some pets will show a special performance when they are in a good mood.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
有些寵物心情好時會做出特別的動作。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Some pets can even wear accessory items.
^3131FF<Pet Groomer>^000000 will sell some pet accessory items but some monsters will also drop pet accessory items as well.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
有些寵物還能佩戴飾品。
^3131FF<寵物美容師>^000000會出售寵物飾品，有些魔物也會掉落。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
I think it is better off experiencing more together than transforming back to the eggs?
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
比起把寵物變回蛋，不如繼續一起冒險、創造更多回憶吧？

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Come back again when you have another question.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
還有問題的話，隨時再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer's Pet]
I am hungry~ Feed me first, then let's walk around~
scripts.translation:
[冒險者的寵物]
我餓了~先餵我吃點東西，再帶我出去逛逛吧~

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Calm down now, here you go!
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
彆著急，給你！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer's Pet]
Phew, it was good. I'm full.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者的寵物]
呼，真好吃。我吃飽了。

scripts.text: A talking monster!
scripts.translation: 會說話的魔物！

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Pets make the best companions for lonely journeys...
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
寵物是孤獨旅途中最好的夥伴...

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Once it was a dangerous monster, now it is my closest friend. This is my ^3131FFpet^000000 which is called as Debbie Ruchi.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
它曾是危險的魔物，如今卻成了我最親密的夥伴。這就是我的^3131FF寵物^000000，名字叫黛比·魯奇。

scripts.text: What is a pet?
scripts.translation: 什麼是寵物？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Adventurer's Pet]
Yawn~ I am bored to death!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者的寵物]
哈欠~我無聊死了！

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Well they're loyal ^3131FFmonster^000000s that stand by your side.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
寵物是忠誠的^3131FF魔物^000000，會一直陪伴在你身邊。

scripts.text: Does it help you fight?
scripts.translation: 它會幫你戰鬥嗎？

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
It doesn't help me battle but it helps by giving me bonus ^3131FFstats^000000 and other bonus effects.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
它不會幫我戰鬥，但能提供額外的^3131FF屬性^000000和其他增益效果。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
All these things are possible when ^3131FFIntimacy^000000 with your pet is very high.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
只要和寵物的^3131FF親密度^000000足夠高，就能獲得這些效果。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Intimacy requires a time commitment and a lot of food. Food is the way to any being's loyalty right? ha ha
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
培養親密度需要花時間，也得準備很多食物。俗話說，想收服誰的心，就先餵飽誰，對吧？哈哈。

scripts.text: How do I get a pet?
scripts.translation: 怎麼才能獲得寵物？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Pets make the best companions for lonely journeys...
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
寵物是孤獨旅途中最好的夥伴...

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Do you need a pet?
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
你想要一隻寵物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Hmm then let's go to the Academy Gardens together!
I'll show you how it's done.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
那我們一起去學院花園吧！
我會教你怎麼做。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Talk to me when you are ready to go to the garden!
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
準備好去花園時，再來找我吧！

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Shall we go to the garden of Criatura Academy?
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
要去克里阿圖拉學院的花園嗎？

scripts.text: Send me now!
scripts.translation: 現在就送我過去！

scripts.text: Stay
scripts.translation: 先不去了

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
All right, come this way.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
好，跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
If you want, I will guide you anytime.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
你需要的話，我隨時都可以帶你過去。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Any questions about the cute pet?
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
關於可愛的寵物，還有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text: Taming a monster
scripts.translation: 馴服魔物

scripts.text: Hatching the egg
scripts.translation: 孵化寵物蛋

scripts.text: Monitoring pet's status
scripts.translation: 檢視寵物狀態

scripts.text: Feeding
scripts.translation: 餵食

scripts.text: Performances
scripts.translation: 特殊動作

scripts.text: Removing the accessory
scripts.translation: 取下飾品

scripts.text: Transforming back to egg
scripts.translation: 變回寵物蛋

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Only some monsters can become pets and they all have different things to tame them.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
只有部分魔物可以成為寵物，而且每種魔物需要的馴服道具都不同。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Each monster that can be tamed requires a specific ^3131FFtaming item^000000.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
每種可馴服的魔物都有對應的^3131FF馴服道具^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
To begin taming,
^3131FFdouble click^000000 the taming item in your inventory and select which monster to tame.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
要馴服魔物，先在背包裡^3131FF雙擊^000000馴服道具，再選擇目標魔物。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Press ^3131FFClick^000000 in the center of the pop-up slot machine to tame the monster..
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
在彈出的老虎機視窗中央按下^3131FF“點選”^000000，嘗試馴服魔物。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
If successful, the monster will be tranformed into an egg!
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
馴服成功後，魔物就會變成寵物蛋！

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Hatching requires you to have a ^3131FF<Pet Incubator>^000000 to awaken a monster in the egg.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
要孵化寵物蛋，必須持有^3131FF<攜帶用孵蛋器>^000000，才能喚醒蛋裡的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Most towns have a ^3131FF<Pet Groomer>^000000 where you can buy the ^3131FF<Pet Incubator>^000000.
Ask the town guide for the location of the Pet Groomer if you can't find them.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
大多數城鎮都有^3131FF<寵物美容師>^000000，能在那裡買到^3131FF<攜帶用孵蛋器>^000000。
找不到的話，可以向城鎮嚮導打聽寵物美容師的位置。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
^3131FFRight-click^000000 on your pet and select ^3131ffCheck the Pet Status^000000 to check on its status. Or you can press ^3131FF<Alt+J>^000000.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
^3131FF右鍵點選^000000寵物，再選擇^3131ff檢視寵物狀態^000000即可檢視狀態。也可以按^3131FF<Alt+J>^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
This will open up the Status Window. Here you can change the pet's ^3131FFname^000000 as well as check their ^3131FFHunter^000000 and ^3131FFIntimacy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
這樣會開啟狀態視窗。在這裡可以更改寵物的^3131FF名字^000000，檢視它的^3131FF飢餓度^000000和^3131FF親密度^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
There are some special pets that gives special skills when their ^3131FFIntimacy^000000 level becomes Loyal. Most pets start off as shy and time and food changes that.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
有些特殊寵物在^3131FF親密度^000000達到“忠誠”後會學會特殊技能。大多數寵物一開始都很怕生，隨著時間推移並餵食，就會逐漸親近你。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
<Pet Food> is normal food for pets but some pets prefer other foods. You should keep enough with you so your pet doesn't get hungry.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
<寵物飼料>是寵物常吃的食物，不過有些寵物偏愛其他食物。記得隨身帶夠食物，別讓寵物餓著。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Pets will ^3131FFrun away^000000 if they are too full or too hungry. So make sure you check your pets hunger status frequently!
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
寵物太飽或太餓都會^3131FF逃跑^000000，記得經常檢視它們的飢餓度！

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Some pets will show a special performance when they are in a good mood.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
有些寵物心情好時會做出特別的動作。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Some pets can even wear accessory items.
^3131FF<Pet Groomer>^000000 will sell some pet accessory items but some monsters will also drop pet accessory items as well.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
有些寵物還能佩戴飾品。
^3131FF<寵物美容師>^000000會出售寵物飾品，有些魔物也會掉落。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
I think it is better off experiencing more together than transforming back to the eggs?
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
比起把寵物變回蛋，不如繼續一起冒險、創造更多回憶吧？

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Come back again when you have another question.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
還有問題的話，隨時再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
You can return to the Academy through the portal to the north.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
從北邊的傳送門就能回到學院。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Would you look at that...Porings growing in the garden of the closed Criatura Academy like little Jelly Babies.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
你看那邊...已經關閉的克里阿圖拉學院花園裡，波利正像小果凍似的長著呢。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Not all monsters in Midgard are our for your blood, just most of them.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
米德加爾特並非所有魔物都想要你的命...只是大多數都想。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Take a look at that, looks like that ^3131FFPoring^000000 has something to say to you
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
你看，那隻^3131FF波利^000000好像有話要對你說。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
If you are confused, Please check the quest status by pressing ^3131FF<Alt+U>^000000 anytime.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
如果不清楚情況，隨時按^3131FF<Alt+U>^000000檢視任務狀態。

scripts.text: How to gain Unripe Apples
scripts.translation: 如何獲得青蘋果

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
You'd want to go to the Dispensary to learn how to make ^3131FFUnripe Apple^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
去醫務室學學怎麼製作^3131FF青蘋果^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
One of the staff there should have a ^3131FFItem compounding book^000000 for novices, ^3131FFHow to make Unripe Apples^000000 is one of the subjects.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
那裡的工作人員應該有初心者用的^3131FF物品合成書^000000，裡面就有^3131FF青蘋果的製作方法^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
So you used the taming item on the Little Porings, then they turned into eggs?
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
你把馴服道具用在寶貝波利身上，它們就變成蛋了？

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Ha ha ha, don't fret my pet.
You just cleared ^3131FFtaming^000000.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
哈哈，別擔心，小傢伙。
你剛通過了^3131FF馴服^000000考驗。

scripts.text: Taming?
scripts.translation: 馴服考驗？

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Yep, it means you are ready to be a friend like me and Debbie Ruchi.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
沒錯，這說明你也能像我和黛比·魯奇一樣，和寵物成為朋友了。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
There are lots of different monsters and tames out there.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
外面有各種各樣的魔物，也有不少可以馴服的夥伴。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
If you successfully tame it you end up with a little egg.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
成功馴服魔物後，就能得到一顆寵物蛋。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
So congratulations again for passing the test, the friendship test!
Ask anytime whenever you have a question about cute pets.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
再次恭喜你通過考驗，成為寵物的朋友！
想了解可愛寵物的話，隨時來問我。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Do you see the shivering poring over there? Go easy on the lil' blighter, okay?
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
看到那隻發抖的波利了嗎？對它溫柔點，別嚇著它，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
If you are confused, Please check the quest status by clicking ^3131FF<Alt+U>^000000 anytime.
scripts.translation:
[老練的冒險者]
如果不清楚情況，隨時點選^3131FF<Alt+U>^000000檢視任務狀態。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
You have too many items to continue the quest.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
你的物品太多，無法繼續任務。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Open inventory with ^3131FFAlt+E^000000 key, if you find unnecessaty items, sell them to ^3131FFmerchant^000000 or put into ^3131FFwarehouse^000000 by using kafra service~.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
按^3131FFAlt+E^000000開啟背包。發現不需要的東西，可以賣給^3131FF商人^000000，或使用卡普拉服務存進^3131FF倉庫^000000~

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Help me novice...
scripts.translation:
[波利]
初心者，幫幫我...

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Dear oh dear...what do we have 'ere?
scripts.translation:
[波利]
哎呀...這是怎麼回事？

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 發生什麼事了？

scripts.text: Ignore him/it?
scripts.translation: 要無視它嗎？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oh dear, oh dear...
scripts.translation:
[波利]
哎呀，哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Wot a sad state of affairs.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
真是太慘了。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
That geeza' ghostring got defeated out in his dungeon and came here to pick on other monsters like me.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
那個混賬幽靈波利在迷宮裡被打敗後，跑來這兒欺負我這樣的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
I'm too low level to stop 'im, you can hear them cheering now...
scripts.translation:
[波利]
我的等級太低，攔不住它。你聽，他們現在又在歡呼了...

scripts.text:
[Ghostring]
Oi you lot! Tell me wot I want to hear!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈波利]
喂，你們這群傢伙！說點我愛聽的！

scripts.text:
[Unskilled Poring]
Ghostring's the strongest in the world!
scripts.translation:
[笨拙的波利]
幽靈波利是世界上最強的！

scripts.text:
[Ghostring]
What kind of monster I am?
scripts.translation:
[幽靈波利]
你們說，我是什麼魔物？

scripts.text:
[Unskilled Poring]
Ghostring's da Boss!
scripts.translation:
[笨拙的波利]
幽靈波利才是老大！

scripts.text:
[Ghostring]
Bwa ha ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[幽靈波利]
哇哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Bleedin' shame...
Little Porings takin' up with a git like that and not bein' cute anymore.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
真丟人...
寶貝波利居然跟那種混賬混在一起，連可愛勁兒都沒了。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
The Little Porings aren't bad'uns, they've just not been to the outside world.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
寶貝波利們其實不壞，只是它們還沒去過外面的世界。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
If this keeps up, all of the Porings in Midgard will be under the sway of Ghostring.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
再這樣下去，米德加爾特所有的波利都會被幽靈波利控制。

scripts.text: Can I help you?
scripts.translation: 我能幫你嗎？

scripts.text: Too bad.
scripts.translation: 真可惜。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oh dear, oh dear.....
scripts.translation:
[波利]
哎呀，哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Now that you mention it sir, I could use some help.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
你這麼一說，先生，我確實需要幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Unskilled Poring]
Wot's Dat? Onna them Poring's talkin' to a huumie.
Shall we beat him up?
scripts.translation:
[笨拙的波利]
那是什麼？有隻波利居然在跟人類說話。
我們要不要揍他一頓？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Blimey!
Help me! Save me!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
天哪！
幫幫我！救命啊！

scripts.text: What can I do to help?
scripts.translation: 我能怎麼幫你？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
I do have a good idea!
Come over here!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
我有個好主意！
跟我來！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
This is ^3131FFunripe apple^000000.
The favorite items for Little Poring to eat.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
這是^3131FF青蘋果^000000。
寶貝波利最愛吃這個。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Maybe you can use it to tempt them away from listenin' to Ghostring.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
也許你可以用它把寶貝波利引開，讓它們不再聽幽靈波利的話。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
^3131FFDouble click the unripe apple^000000 that I gave you and ^3131FFselect^000000 a ^3131FFLittle Poring^000000 that you fancy.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
^3131FF雙擊我給你的青蘋果^000000，再^3131FF選擇^000000你喜歡的^3131FF寶貝波利^000000。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
TThe click the centre of the slot machine.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
然後點選老虎機中央。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
That'll lure them from out of Ghostring's influence.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
這樣就能把它們從幽靈波利的控制中引出來。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Ello' mate. Were you successful? Where are the lil' bleeders?
scripts.translation:
[波利]
嘿，夥計，成功了嗎？那些小傢伙在哪兒？

scripts.text: Show eggs
scripts.translation: 給我看看寵物蛋

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Steady on now guv'na...
What did you do to Unskilled Poring!?!? Novice!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
冷靜點，夥計...
你對笨拙的波利做了什麼？！初心者！！！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I used the unripe apples that you gave me, then they turned into eggs.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我用了你給我的青蘋果，它們就變成蛋了。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oh, guess I didn't expect they'd be turned into pets so easily!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
哦，沒想到這麼容易就能把它們變成寵物！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah, don't worry, I'll make sure to
give them a good home.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，別擔心，我會
給它們找個好歸宿。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
^3131FFDouble click the unripe apple^000000 that I gave you and ^3131FFselect^000000 your preferred ^3131FFLittle Poring^000000.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
^3131FF雙擊我給你的青蘋果^000000，再^3131FF選擇^000000你喜歡的^3131FF寶貝波利^000000。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
The all you have to do is ^3131FFclick ^0000 the middle of the slot machine.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
接著只要^3131FF點選^0000老虎機中央即可。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
It may fail, but keep trying to lure way those Little Porings!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
可能會失敗，但繼續嘗試把那些寶貝波利引過來吧！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Have you ever heard about the changes of a novice from adept adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[波利]
你聽說過從初心者成長為老練冒險者的過程嗎？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Unripe Apples are the item to tame.
It will only work on the Little Porings hopping around.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
青蘋果是用來馴服魔物的道具。
只對四處蹦跳的寶貝波利有效。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
If you're going to make them a cute pet...
You must take care of your Little Poring!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
想讓它們成為可愛的寵物...
就得好好照顧你的寶貝波利！

scripts.text: What?
scripts.translation: 什麼？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Even before that Ghostring came here, the Little Porings were kind of cowardly.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
即使在幽靈波利來這裡之前，寶貝波利就已經有點膽小了。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Since they've never been out in the real world, sort of like human novices.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
它們從沒去過外面的世界，就像人類的初心者一樣。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
You're just starting out on your adventure, right? You will visit many towns and meet many people and encounter the frightful Boss Monsters.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
你才剛開始冒險吧？以後會走訪許多城鎮、結識許多人，還會遇上可怕的頭目魔物。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Won't you consider taking one of these chavs with you?
scripts.translation:
[波利]
要不要帶一隻這樣的可愛小傢伙一起旅行？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
They're smeggin' talkative, but they'll be loyal friends!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
它們雖然話很多，卻會是忠實的夥伴！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
I'd say that the ^31311FAdept adventurer ^000000knows lots of things about pets, so you can ask him about your new Little Poring Friend.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
我想，^31311F老練的冒險者^000000很瞭解寵物。你的新夥伴寶貝波利有什麼問題，都可以去問他。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
By the way, you should have a ^3131FFportable egg incubator ^000000.
It was dropped by a careless ^3131FFPet Groomer^000000 traveling through.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
對了，你應該有一個^3131FF<攜帶用孵蛋器> ^000000。
這是一個路過的粗心^3131FF寵物美容師^000000掉下的。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
I will also give you the Little Poring's favorite ^3131FFapple juice^000000, so make sure that it stays fed all the time!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
我還會送你寶貝波利最愛喝的^3131FF蘋果汁^000000，記得按時餵它！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oi, Little Poring.
I look forward to seeing you once you've explored Midgard!
Cheers mate.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
嘿，寶貝波利。
等你探索完米德加爾特，記得回來找我。保重，夥計。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Take good care of your Little Poring. Ask the adept adventurer if you have any questions about cute pets!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
好好照顧你的寶貝波利。關於可愛寵物的問題，記得去問老練的冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Ghostring]
I am da biggest and da meanest Ghostring!
scripts.translation:
[幽靈波利]
我可是最強、最兇的幽靈波利！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Welcome, Kafra service is always close to your heart
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
歡迎！卡普拉服務始終陪伴在你身邊。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
For those who are using the Kafra service for the first time.
Kafra service offers thorough information rundown~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
第一次使用卡普拉服務嗎？
我們會為你詳細介紹各項服務~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Tell us what you would like to know
about the Kafra service~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
告訴我，你想了解哪些卡普拉服務~！

scripts.text: Saving
scripts.translation: 存檔服務

scripts.text: Storage Service
scripts.translation: 倉庫服務

scripts.text: Teleport Service
scripts.translation: 瞬間移動服務

scripts.text: Use of Pushcart Service
scripts.translation: 手推車使用

scripts.text: Check Other Information
scripts.translation: 檢視其他資訊

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Save service is for when you ^8B4513die in battle^000000 or use an item like ^8B4513Butterfly Wings^000000, you will be sent back to your Save Location.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
如果你在戰鬥中^8B4513倒下^000000，或使用^8B4513蝴蝶翅膀^000000等物品，就會返回你登記的復活點。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Easy to understand~?
You want to try the Save service~?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
很容易懂吧~？
要不要試試存檔服務~？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Don't be afraid of it~!
Save service doesn't swallow you.
If you change your mind, you would better try it definitely~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
別害怕~！
存檔服務不會把你吞掉的。
改變主意的話，最好還是親自試試看~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Well~ then, for now, ^8B4513Izlude Square^000000 where the Criatura Academy is located will be saved as your save point~!.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
那麼~先把克里阿圖拉學院所在的^8B4513依斯魯得廣場^000000設為你的復活點~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Voila~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
完成啦~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
It's already done. Easy huh?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
已經設好了。很簡單吧？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Now, when you use a ^006400Butterfly Wing^000000, it will send you to the last saved location.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
現在使用^006400蝴蝶翅膀^000000，便會返回上次登記的復活點。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Storage service is a place where you can safely store your items.
Your items can be accessed by all characters in your account.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
倉庫服務能幫你安全存放物品。
賬號內的所有角色都能使用倉庫裡的物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
To use the storage, you need to be over Novice Job Level 6 and higher.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
初心者職業等級至少達到 6 級，才能使用倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
For a small fee, most Kafra Employees will let you open your storage.
You can even buy Kafra Cards from the Item Mall to open storage from anywhere!
Do you want to use the storage?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
支付少量費用後，大多數卡普拉職員都能幫你開啟倉庫。
你也可以在道具商城購買卡普拉隨身倉庫使用券，隨時隨地開啟倉庫！
要使用倉庫嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Storage is necessary for you to survive so use it regularly.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
倉庫對冒險很重要，記得經常使用。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
To use the storage, you need to be raised the beginner level 6 and higher.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
初心者等級達到 6 級後，才能使用倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
I'll open the storage~.
Thanks for using~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
這就幫你開啟倉庫~
感謝使用~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Dear customer, you don't have enough money~!
You need 500 zeny to use the storage~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
親愛的顧客，你的錢不夠~！
使用倉庫需要 500 Zeny~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Teleport service is a service that sends you to various locations throughout Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
瞬間移動服務可以把你傳送到米德加爾特各地。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Different Kafra Employees have different teleport locations to send you to so you need to talk to them to find out where they're teleporting to.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
各地卡普拉職員提供的傳送目的地都不同，記得和他們聊聊，確認能去哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Ok, so for educational purposes I'm offering a free teleport service here at the Academy.
Why don't you try it out?~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
為了教學，我在學院提供免費瞬間移動服務。
要不要試試看？~！

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
You afraid of having your cells spliced or something? Don't worry this is perfectly safe~!
This is an essential service~
So, you better get used to it ok?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
怕身體被拆開重組什麼的嗎？別擔心，絕對安全~！
這是項必備服務~
最好早點習慣，知道嗎？

scripts.text: Academy 1st floor Great Hall
scripts.translation: 學院一樓大廳

scripts.text: Academy 2nd floor Principal's Office
scripts.translation: 學院二樓院長辦公室

scripts.text: Izlude southern entrance
scripts.translation: 依斯魯得南入口

scripts.text: Use later
scripts.translation: 稍後再用

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
This will take you to the outside of the Criatura Academy, is that ok?
If you want to come back to the academy, find the entrance to the north of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
要把你傳送到克里阿圖拉學院外面，可以嗎？
想回學院的話，去依斯魯得北邊找入口。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
You afraid of having your cells spliced or something? Don't worry this is perfectly safe~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
怕身體被拆開重組什麼的嗎？別擔心，絕對安全~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
You afraid of having your cells spliced or something? Don't worry this is perfectly safe~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
怕身體被拆開重組什麼的嗎？別擔心，絕對安全~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Pushcart service is used for those who have the job ^8B4513Merchant^000000.
To rent a Pushcart Merchants pay a small zeny fee and that's it.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
手推車服務僅限^8B4513商人^000000職業使用。
商人只需支付少量 Zeny，就能租用手推車。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
If you aren't a Merchant class or if you haven't learned the Cart Skill then you can't use this Kafra service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
不是商人，或沒有學習手推車使用技能的話，就無法使用這項卡普拉服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Among the other services we provide, there is a Customer point service system from Kafra!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
此外，卡普拉還設有顧客積分系統！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Every time you use a Kafra Service you get Special Reserve Points~
You can use these points at the Kafra Headquarters in Aldebaran to trade for certain items.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
每次使用卡普拉服務都能獲得特別儲備積分~
可以到艾爾帕蘭的卡普拉總部兌換特定物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Here, I'll show you how many Special Reserve Points you currently have.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
來看看你目前累積了多少特別儲備積分。

scripts.text: Check Special Reserve Points.
scripts.translation: 檢視特別儲備積分

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Even later~~!!
Please check your accumulated customer points~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
晚點再看也行~~！！
記得檢視你累積的顧客積分~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
{0}, your accummulated points are {1} points.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
{0}，你累積了 {1} 點積分。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
You can exchange your
Special Reserve Points for
rewards at the Kafra Main Office in Al De Baran. Please use our
convenient services to see the benefits of our rewards program.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
你可以在艾爾帕蘭的卡普拉總部，用特別儲備積分兌換獎勵。
善用我們的服務，享受獎勵計劃帶來的好處吧。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Our Kafra service is doing our best to give you the best satisfaction that you deserve as a customer.
Thanks for using us.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
卡普拉會盡力為每位顧客提供最滿意的服務。
感謝使用卡普拉服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
First, you need to complete your^8B4513 registration^000000 at the Academy's front desk.
If you go to the first floor,
there'll be someone
to take your registration.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向導培訓師]
首先，請到學院前臺完成^8B4513註冊^000000。
去一樓找工作人員辦理即可。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
You are the just a beginner.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
你還只是個初學者。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Everything looks new and unfamiliar, doesn't it? Isn't it all exiciting?
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
一切都新鮮又陌生，對吧？是不是很令人興奮？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
What can be a more exciting start than a marriage in your life?
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
人生中還有什麼比結婚更令人期待的開始呢？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Are you in love?
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
你戀愛了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
I am the Wedding Secretary sent here for those people wanting to join their lives to another.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
我是婚禮秘書，專門為想與伴侶共度一生的人提供服務。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Please ask anything you are concerned with about marriage!
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
關於結婚有任何疑問，儘管問我！

scripts.text: How to get married.
scripts.translation: 如何結婚

scripts.text: Benefits of marriage
scripts.translation: 婚姻的好處

scripts.text: Adoption
scripts.translation: 收養

scripts.text: Shut up!
scripts.translation: 閉嘴！

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Concluding the ceremony between two lovers is really the most beautiful and special event in one's life.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
為一對戀人主持婚禮，是人生中最美好、最特別的時刻。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
However, being together requires several procedures.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
不過，想要結為夫妻還得辦理幾項手續。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
First, the two of you wishing to get married have to be at least base level ^0000cd45^000000 or higher, meaning  you should be at the level responsible for your life and your finances.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
首先，想結婚的雙方基礎等級都必須達到^0000cd45^000000級以上，也就是說，你們都已具備獨立生活和理財的能力。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Next, you need to prepare some tokens of appreciation. Men need a ^0000cdTuxedo^000000 Ladies need a ^0000cdWedding Dress^000000 and both need to have ^0000cdDiamond Ring^000000s as the symbol of everlasting love.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
接下來要準備一些信物：男士需要^0000cd燕尾服^000000，女士需要^0000cd結婚禮服^000000，雙方還都要有象徵永恆愛情的^0000cd鑽石戒指^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
You will also need to provide a fee of ^0000cd1 million Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
另外還要支付^0000cd100 萬 Zeny^000000手續費。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Having prepared all of these things, you must create a party with just the two of you and go to the ^0000cdProntera Cathedral^000000.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
準備好這些之後，你們兩人組成一支隊伍，再前往^0000cd普隆德拉大教堂^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
There, another  ^0000cdWedding Secretary^000000 like me is wating for you. When you speak to her, she will give more details of what to do.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
那裡會有另一位^0000cd婚禮秘書^000000等著你們。和她交談，她會告訴你們詳細流程。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
I hope that you will meet a great fiance and enjoy a happy marriage!
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
希望你能遇見一位好伴侶，擁有幸福美滿的婚姻！

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
To say the least, the benefit of marriage is being together forever!
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
婚姻最大的好處，就是兩個人能永遠相伴！

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
After the wedding ceremony, you can enjoy a sweet honeymoon at the ^0000cdJawaii^000000 resort only for you.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
婚禮結束後，你們還能到只屬於兩人的^0000cd爪哇度假村^000000享受甜蜜蜜月。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
And, upon marriage you will both get a ^0000cdspecial skill^000000.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
結婚後，雙方都會獲得一項^0000cd特殊技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Two of these skills are called ^0000cdLoving Touch^000000 and ^0000cdUndying Love^000000 which are used to sacrifice HP or SP and send it to your partner.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
其中兩項技能是^0000cd只呵護妳^000000和^0000cd只為你犧牲^000000，可以消耗自己的 HP 或 SP 轉給伴侶。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
But among them, the skill called ^0000cdRomantic Rendezvous^000000 is the most romantic one, enabling you to summon your partner to you from anywhere in the world.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
其中最浪漫的要數^0000cd浪漫約會^000000，能讓你從世界各地召喚伴侶到身邊。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Aren't these skill great? Don't you want to get married right now?
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
這些技能很棒吧？你們不想馬上結婚嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Being together is wonderful but people without experience of it in the past couldn't understand the full Euphoria of being a parent.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
相伴左右固然美好，但沒有親身體驗過的人，很難體會為人父母的全部喜悅。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Married couple can adopt other characters as their children.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
已婚夫婦可以收養其他角色作為自己的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
^0000cdKids of extended jobs such as Taekwon boy/girl, Gunslinger or Ninja can't be adopted^000000.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
^0000cd跆拳少年/少女、神槍手或忍者等擴充套件職業無法被收養^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
And any prospecting parents need to be at least base level  ^0000cd70^000000, meaning you should be at the level responsible enough to be parents.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
想收養孩子的準父母，基礎等級都必須達到^0000cd70^000000級以上，才算有能力承擔父母的責任。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Having made a family, ^0000cdaSkill to be used among the family^000000 will be earned.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
組建家庭後，你們還能獲得一項^0000cd家族專屬技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
There is another skill enables you to concrete your bond such as being able to summon your child when you miss them or not losing your earned level if you die during battle.
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
還有一項技能能讓家人之間的羈絆更深，比如在想念孩子時召喚孩子，或是在戰鬥中倒下時避免損失等級。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Cute charms coming from your kid is a bonus~
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
還能享受孩子帶來的可愛樂趣呢~

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Your mother didn't teach you right?
Mercy on you. You are ignorant of the beauty of love!!!
scripts.translation:
[婚禮秘書]
你媽媽沒好好教你嗎？
真可憐，竟然不懂愛情有多美好！！！

scripts.text:
[Mom]
Honey~~~
scripts.translation:
[媽媽]
親愛的~~~

scripts.text:
[Dad]
Yep~~

[Mom]
Did you see Etinifni playing at the backyard?
scripts.translation:
[媽媽]
你看到埃蒂尼夫尼在後院玩嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dad]
Nope~~
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
沒看到~~~

scripts.text:
[Mom]
He's out again? Never stays in the house!! Shall I use it?
scripts.translation:
[媽媽]
他又跑出去了？真是一刻也待不住！！要不要用那個把他叫回來？

scripts.text:
[Dad]
Leave him alone~ He may be playing somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
別管他啦~他可能在哪兒玩呢。

scripts.text:
[Mom]
You spoil him too much!
scripts.translation:
[媽媽]
你太寵他了！

scripts.text:
[Mom]
^0000cd[Come to me, honey~]^000000
scripts.translation:
[媽媽]
^0000cd[寶貝，快到我這裡來~]^000000

scripts.text:
[Etinifni]
What's up? Where am I?
scripts.translation:
[埃蒂尼夫尼]
怎麼了？我在哪兒？

scripts.text:
[Mom]
Here!
scripts.translation:
[媽媽]
在這裡！

scripts.text:
[Etinifni]

You should bring ^ff0000'Criatura Hair Coupon'^000000 for changing hair...
scripts.translation:
[水獺 薩姆孫]
來嘛...親愛的～
想換髮型的話，記得帶上^ff0000“克里圖拉美髮券”^000000哦...

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]

You are totally my style. So I am very excited~~
Pick the style from page 1 to 19.
scripts.translation:

親愛的～想換什麼髮型？
你完全就是我的理想型，我都等不及了～～
請從第1頁到第19頁中挑選。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

來嘛...親愛的～這裡可以用美髮券換髮型哦～

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
Oh my!!? You do not want to?
scripts.translation:

哎呀！？您不想換嗎？

scripts.text:

Come on.. Honey~ That is the same style you have.
Do you want to try something new?
scripts.translation:
[水獺 薩姆孫]
來嘛...親愛的～您現在就是這個髮型。
要不要試試別的造型？

scripts.text:

Style ({0})?
It feels like this.. How is it?
scripts.translation:

這個造型（{0}）怎麼樣？
大概就是這種感覺...您覺得如何？

scripts.text: Good.

scripts.text: No.

scripts.text:

Right!
Honey! What about dying hair as well?
Dying hair also included in this service.
scripts.translation:
[水獺 薩姆孫]
沒錯！
親愛的～要不要順便染個頭發？
染髮也包含在這項服務裡哦。

scripts.text: Passionate Red
scripts.translation: 熱情紅

scripts.text: Sweet Yellow
scripts.translation: 甜美黃

scripts.text: Fatal Purple
scripts.translation: 魅惑紫

scripts.text: Glamourous Orange
scripts.translation: 華麗橙

scripts.text: Comfortable Green

scripts.text: Dark Black

No?
Do you need more time? If you want to keep the same color, then select the same one.
scripts.translation:
[水獺 薩姆孫]
不想換嗎？
還需要再考慮一下嗎？如果想保留原來的顏色，就選同一種顏色吧。

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
Relax, it is almost done~
scripts.translation:
[水獺 薩姆孫]
彆著急，馬上就好了～

- Sha sha shak shak shak -
- Chikak, crack, crack.. -
- Snap, snap, snap.. Crack -
scripts.translation:
