- 沙、沙、沙、沙、沙 -
- 咔嚓、咔噠、咔噠... -
- 啪、啪、啪...咔嚓 -

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
Oh my! Oh my! Oh my!
This hair style no.({0}) suits to you looks good~
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[水獺 薩姆孫]
哎呀！哎呀！哎呀！
這款{0}號髮型特別適合您，真好看～
您覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
I want to take care of your style..
But I have no choice to select customers because I belong to here.
scripts.translation:
[水獺 薩姆孫]
我也想好好為您打理一番...
可惜我在這裡工作，沒法挑選顧客。

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
For changing to new style, ^ff0000Alberta or Lighthalzen^000000.
For dying hair, ^ff0000Prontera or Lighthalzen^000000.
scripts.translation:
[水獺 薩姆孫]
想換新發型，請前往^ff0000艾爾貝塔或裡希塔樂鎮^000000。
想染髮，請前往^ff0000普隆德拉或裡希塔樂鎮^000000。

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
Honey~ You don't like it?
Ahem.. Do you want to read style book again?
Take your time and tell me when you decide~ Okay?~
scripts.translation:
[水獺 薩姆孫]
親愛的～不喜歡嗎？
咳...要不要再看看造型手冊？
慢慢挑，決定好了再告訴我，好嗎？～

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
You can receive ^ff0000criatura hair coupon^000000 from ^ff0000academy receptionist for novice at academy front desk or eden group^000000
scripts.translation:
[水獺 薩姆孫]
您可以從^ff0000學院前臺的初心者接待員或樂園團^000000領取^ff0000克里圖拉美髮券^000000。

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
They don't give you for free.. Well..
The equipment you had received when you arrived at academy?
They change ^ff0000egg shell for novice^000000 to coupon?
scripts.translation:
[水獺 薩姆孫]
他們可不會免費送券...嗯...
您抵達學院時拿到的裝備呢？
是不是可以用^ff0000初心者蛋殼帽^000000兌換美髮券？

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
This service has started since I came here. So.. No free service if you have no coupon~
scripts.translation:
[水獺 薩姆孫]
我來到這裡後才開始提供這項服務。所以...沒有美髮券就不能免費使用哦～

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
Oh my!!? Honey, you are not going to change hair?
You look nice now rough style.
scripts.translation:
[水獺 薩姆孫]
哎呀！？親愛的，您不打算換髮型嗎？
您現在這款粗獷的造型也很帥氣呢。

scripts.text:
[Lady]
^3377FF Is the east window enlightened? Pecopeco is singing.^000000
scripts.translation:
[女士]
^3377FF東邊的窗戶亮起來了嗎？大嘴鳥正在唱歌呢。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady]
^3377FF Haven't the kids feeding Picky awaken yet?^000000
scripts.translation:
[女士]
^3377FF餵食小雞皮基的小孩還沒醒嗎？^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady]
^3377FF When are you going to Morocc over the desert?^000000
scripts.translation:
[女士]
^3377FF您打算什麼時候穿越沙漠前往夢羅克？^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady]
... Anonymous...

[Lady]
You have a pretty name... Anonymous... I am attacted by your work.
scripts.translation:
[女士]
您的名字真好聽...匿名者...您的作品讓我著迷。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Cooking is caring!
scripts.translation:
[艾克萊爾]
烹飪就是關懷！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ahh. Hey is Sir. Orleons doing well?
scripts.translation:
[千層酥]
啊，對了，奧爾良先生最近還好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Are you the new Criatura trainee?
Then go look for Dacquoise.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你是新來的克里圖拉學員嗎？
那就去找達克瓦茲吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I also learned from Sir. Charles Orleans.
Everyone became happy from eating my meals.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我也曾向查爾斯·奧爾良先生學習。
大家吃了我做的料理都很開心。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Now it is my pleasure to feed the newbies of the Academy....
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
如今能為學院的新學員們準備料理，是我的榮幸...

scripts.text:
[Hungry Trainee]
Wonder when my order will get taken... it's already been an hour...
Look at the helpers lingering on the side...
scripts.translation:
[飢餓的學員]
不知道什麼時候才有人來點單...都已經等了一個小時了...
看看那些助手，還在旁邊晃來晃去...

scripts.text:
[Scholarship Trainee]
Ugh... this guy...
I already told you eight hundred times! It's buffet style! Ah!
scripts.translation:
[獎學金學員]
唉...這傢伙...
我都跟你說過八百遍了！這是自助餐！真是的！

scripts.text:
[Hungry Trainee]
Buffet? What's that? Can you eat it?
You look down on me because I'm from the country, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[飢餓的學員]
自助餐？那是什麼？能吃嗎？
你是看不起我這個鄉下人吧？

scripts.text:
[Hungry Trainee]
Don't tell me it's not difficult to understand! Explain it to me!
scripts.translation:
[飢餓的學員]
別跟我說這很難懂！快解釋給我聽！

scripts.text:
[Scholarship Trainee]
I've worked at many different places, but this place is the strangest.
scripts.translation:
[獎學金學員]
我在很多地方工作過，這裡卻是最奇怪的。

scripts.text:
[Broke Trainee]
Since the prices have risen I try to get my belly full at every chance I get.
scripts.translation:
[身無分文的學員]
物價漲了以後，我只要有機會就儘量吃個飽。

scripts.text:
[Broke Trainee]
It's been 21 hours since I've been here.
It's a buffet so you can eat without time limit.
scripts.translation:
[身無分文的學員]
我在這裡已經待了21個小時。
這裡是自助餐，想吃多久都行。

scripts.text:
[Broke Trainee]
Eat and digest, eat and digest, heh.
Do you want to join?
scripts.translation:
[身無分文的學員]
吃了消化，消化完再吃，嘿嘿。
要不要一起來？

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Hey, do you know about the gunslinger's own weapon?
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
嘿，你知道神槍手專用的槍械嗎？

scripts.text: Don't know
scripts.translation: 不知道

scripts.text: Know
scripts.translation: 知道

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Cha, yeah right!
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
哈，我就知道你會這麼說！

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
I guessed you were.
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
我就猜你知道。

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Gunslinger handles 5 kinds of guns and each gun has its own character.
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
神槍手能使用五種槍械，每種槍都有各自的特點。

scripts.text: What character?
scripts.translation: 有什麼特點？

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Hahahaha~ I am also taking the lesson, but I don't know the details as I haven't become a gunslinger.
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
哈哈哈～我也在上課，不過還沒成為神槍手，所以不清楚具體情況。

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
I heard that as it was a dangerous weapon they don't let us use them yet!
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
我聽說那種武器很危險，所以現在還不讓我們用！

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
Oh Mr. gunslinger!! Nice.
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
哇，神槍手先生！真帥！

scripts.text:
[Noisy Trainee]
What? Why did you take the other job rather than being a nice gunslinger?
scripts.translation:
[吵鬧的學員]
什麼？這麼帥的神槍手不當，為什麼選了別的職業？

scripts.text: [Quiet Trainee]
scripts.translation: [安靜的學員]

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
Are you coming to take the lesson for gunslinger?
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
你是來上神槍手課程的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
Ms. Lusa really looks pretty.
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
露莎小姐真的好漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
I wish to be a gunslinger, like her.
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
我也想像她一樣成為神槍手。

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
I hope I finish my lessons soon!
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
真希望能快點上完所有課程！

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
Learning is too difficult...
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
學習也太難了...

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
You are a gunslinger? You look great! I want to become a gunslinger......
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
您是神槍手嗎？看起來真帥！我也想成為神槍手...

scripts.text:
[Quiet Trainee]
Desperado is the bullet... Blable... Ranged attack... Physics....
scripts.translation:
[安靜的學員]
“亡命之徒”就是子彈...叭啦叭啦...遠端攻擊...物理攻擊...

scripts.text: You can't hear her clearly because of her small voice.
scripts.translation: 她聲音太小了，聽不清她在說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Trainee]
That man looks too scary.
scripts.translation:
[受驚的學員]
那個人看起來好嚇人。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
A sudden poetic inspiration hit me!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
忽然靈感迸發！

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
^3377FFIn the night of the Byalan Island under the moonlight, sitting alone in Izlude^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
^3377FF月光灑在拜蘭島的夜色中，我獨自坐在依斯魯得。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
^3377FFWearing Tzurugie on my belly, in the deep anxiety,^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
^3377FF腰間佩著日本刀，心中滿是憂慮，^000000

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
^3377FFHearing I made a fortune from somewhere, killing me softly.^000000
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
^3377FF聽說我不知從哪兒發了大財，心裡卻隱隱作痛。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
How about it? It is excellent, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
怎麼樣？寫得不錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
I will ^FF0000transcend ^000000and ^FF00003rd job change^000000. Become a nice Minstrel, I can play with a famous Wanderer like Mr. Igoo.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
我要^FF0000轉生^000000，再完成^FF0000三轉^000000。成為出色的宮廷樂師後，我就能和伊古小姐這樣的知名浪姬舞者一起玩了。

scripts.text: What is transcending?
scripts.translation: 什麼是轉生？

scripts.text: What is the 3rd job change?
scripts.translation: 什麼是三轉？

scripts.text: Who is Igoo?
scripts.translation: 伊古是誰？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
You seem to already know what it is!
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
看來您已經知道了！

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Transcending is great. Very great.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
轉生好極了，真的好極了。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Basically the 2nd job adventurer gains the base level 99 and job level 50, on then can that person transcend.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
簡單來說，二轉冒險者達到基礎等級99級、職業等級50級後，就能轉生。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Once you transcend, you can go back to the base level Novice.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
轉生後，你會重新成為初心者。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
It is very hard to start your adventure again. However, there is a merit to the hardship.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
重新開始冒險確實很辛苦，不過這份辛苦也有回報。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
The most important merit is to learn new skills at a new upgraded level. In my case, I could transfer to not an ordinary Bard but a Minstrel.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
最大的好處，就是能在更高階的職業中學習新技能。就拿我來說，轉生後就能從普通詩人進階為宮廷樂師。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Indeed, be careful as you can only follow the way of the job you chose before transcending.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
沒錯，不過要注意，轉生後只能沿著轉生前選擇的職業路線繼續發展。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
If you are interested in transcending, recommend you visit the Sage castle in ^FF0000Juno^000000. I may be far behind for it.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
如果您有意轉生，建議去^FF0000朱諾^000000的賢者城堡看看。對我來說，那裡還很遙遠呢。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Oh, you know very well, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
哦，看來您很清楚嘛！

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
The 3rd job change is obviously a new job.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
三轉嘛，當然就是轉成全新的職業。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Adventurers with the 2nd job or can be transferred to the 3rd job class once gaining the base level 99 and the job level more than 50.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
二轉冒險者達到基礎等級99級、職業等級超過50級後，就能轉職為三轉職業。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
For example, a Bard like me was an Archer in the beginning. Now I became a Bard. As I am diligently adventuring, I may be able to change jobs to a third job.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
比如我這樣的詩人，最初也是弓箭手。如今我已經成為詩人，只要繼續努力冒險，說不定就能轉職為三轉職業。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Ah, of course, though I don't make transfer, I could be Minstrel as my final target. However, I won't compromise with the reality. Someday I will be the best Minstrel.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
當然，即使現在還沒法轉職，宮廷樂師也是我的終極目標。我絕不會向現實妥協，總有一天要成為最棒的宮廷樂師。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
So, if you transfer, you could first be Novice and be a Bard. But someday I could be Minstrel, couldn't I?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
所以轉生後，你會先成為初心者，再轉職為詩人。總有一天，我也能成為宮廷樂師，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Choice is always on you. Be ambitious, adventurer. Someday I will sing an encouraging song for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
選擇權在你手中。冒險者，懷抱遠大志向吧。總有一天，我會為你唱一首鼓舞人心的歌。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
No! You don't know the most beautiful girl Wanderer Igoo in this era?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
什麼！你竟然不知道當今最美的浪姬舞者伊古？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Haven't you heard about [Volume 1 - Lost Poring] or [Volume 2 : Poring my love]?
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
你沒聽過《第一卷：迷失的波利》或《第二卷：波利，我的愛》嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Then, have you never heard the songs like [It's a Good day for an OCA] or [Baphomet I hardly knew you]
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
那麼，《今天適合開卡片冊》或《巴風特，我幾乎不認識你》這樣的歌，你也沒聽過嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
A beautiful Wanderer from Comodo at the age of 20. Not only Midgard but also wherever her wandering troupe goes, a fan club follows.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
她是來自克魔島、年僅20歲的美麗浪姬舞者。不僅在米德加爾特，只要她的巡演團走到哪裡，粉絲團就會跟到哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
I am ^FF0000Ragie^000000 in charge with the Rune-Midgarts branch head of Igoo's informal fan club! As Igoo has gone to the 2nd world, I am taking a rest for a while. But she will be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
我是^FF0000拉吉埃^000000，負責盧恩-米德加茲分部，也是伊古非正式粉絲團的負責人！伊古去了第二世界，所以我暫時休息一陣子。不過她很快就會回來。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
As I am still a low level of adventurer, I haven't followed her to the 2nd world... See! I will make great efforts and follow her everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
我還是個低等級冒險者，沒能跟著她去第二世界...看著吧！我會努力提升實力，追隨她到天涯海角。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]
Ahaa. No sweat no sweat. It is useless to tell such a story to those ignorant.
scripts.translation:
[拉吉埃]
啊哈，沒什麼，沒什麼。講給這些不懂的人聽也沒用。

scripts.text:
[Ragie]

[露莎]
都明白了嗎？

scripts.text: Ranged attack?
scripts.translation: 遠端攻擊？

scripts.text: Why is ammo expensive?
scripts.translation: 彈藥為什麼這麼貴？

scripts.text: Job Change Test?
scripts.translation: 轉職考核？

scripts.text: Yes~!!
scripts.translation: 明白了～！！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Those low tech barbarians need both Strength and Dexterity in order to fight properly. This isn't true for gunslingers.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
那些落後的野蠻人得靠力量和靈巧才能好好戰鬥，神槍手可不一樣。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Why our dexterity influences both attack power and accuracy! Remember, Talk slowly but think quickly!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
因為靈巧既影響攻擊力，也影響命中率！記住：說話慢一點，思考快一點！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Do y'all see lots of factories around here? Mines? Alchemical labs? All these things take zeny to run and thats how they fund it!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你們看看這附近有多少工廠、礦場和鍊金實驗室？這些都得花錢才能運轉，咱們的子彈錢就是這麼來的！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Some other jobs may think it is safe enough to hand any yonkle the strength to seriously hurt someone.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
有些職業覺得，隨便讓什麼人擁有足以重傷他人的力量也沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
But we have to see that you have grit! Remember, fast is good but accurate is better.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
可我們得先看看你有沒有膽識！記住，速度快固然好，打得準更重要。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all can come back now if you gets any more questions.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
以後還有問題，隨時回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
They tell me Criatura Academy is for the novices not yet decided what job to take.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
聽說克里圖拉學院專門接收還沒決定轉什麼職業的初心者。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
They hired me, gun and all, to show you how to be a gunslinger!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
他們把我連人帶槍一起請來，就是要我教你們怎麼當神槍手！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Would you like me to show you how?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
要我教教你們嗎？

scripts.text: Yes mam!
scripts.translation: 好的，女士！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Hrmm, you didn't look like you had the grit any how.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
嗯，我就覺得你沒那股膽氣。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Hey! What kind of con is this?! You already had a manual!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
喂！這算什麼把戲？！你不是已經有手冊了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Here take this manual, I ain't too good at that there book learnin' but I can answer your questions.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
拿著這本手冊吧。我不太會讀書，不過你有問題儘管問我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
If you need the battle training, visit <NAVI>[Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
需要戰鬥訓練的話，就去找<NAVI>[蘇比諾]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh, sorry! Children cannot become Gunslingers!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦，抱歉！小孩子不能成為神槍手！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Perhaps you should talk to your parents about other professions.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
或許你該和父母商量一下，看看還有哪些職業適合你。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Are you going to learn to shoot as a gunslinger?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你想學射擊，成為神槍手嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wooo doggy! You aren't ready for the big city yet!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哎喲喂！你還沒準備好去大城市闖蕩呢！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Get to ^ff0000Job Level: ^0000ff10^000000 and come back here and I will help ya!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
先升到^ff0000職業等級：^0000ff10^000000，再回來找我，我就幫你！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all ready to take the test to become a gunslinger?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你們準備好參加神槍手轉職考核了嗎？

scripts.text: Wait a moment.
scripts.translation: 等一下。

scripts.text: Send me.
scripts.translation: 送我過去。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
When ya are ready, come to me!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
準備好了就來找我！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Okay then, you should find a^ff0000 Mr. Master Miller^000000 and ask him about the test.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
那好，你去找^ff0000米勒大師^000000，問問他轉職考核的事。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Remember, if you find yourself in a hole, the first thing to do is stop digging!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
記住，發現自己陷進坑裡時，第一件事就是別再往下挖！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all need help with that book?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
那本手冊有什麼不懂的，儘管問我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all need help with that book?
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
那本手冊有什麼不懂的，儘管問我。
[露莎]
還有問題的話，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text: How do I use this book?
scripts.translation: 這本手冊該怎麼用？

scripts.text: I can't find the skill.
scripts.translation: 我找不到那個技能。

scripts.text: I don't have a gun....
scripts.translation: 我沒有槍...

scripts.text: No more questions now.
scripts.translation: 暫時沒問題了。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh.. I think I know what the problem is,
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦...我想我知道問題出在哪兒了。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ta use the guide, first ya need to equip it. ^ff0000To open the equipment window the Shortcut key is Alt + E.^000000
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
要用這本指南，得先把它裝備上。^ff0000按 Alt + E 可以開啟裝備視窗。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Sometimes I forget ta do that too! ^ff0000Drag the item from your inventory to the appropriate slot in the equipment window. Alternatively you can double click the item in inventory.^000000
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
我有時也會忘了這一步！^ff0000把物品從背包拖到裝備視窗對應的欄位裡就行，也可以在背包裡雙擊物品。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Do ya have any other questions?
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
還有別的問題嗎？
[露莎]
有問題的話，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Y'all need ta learn how to use the skill?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
想學怎麼使用這個技能嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
^ff0000To open the skill window use the short cut Alt + S. The skill will be located in the ETC tab.^000000
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
^ff0000按 Alt + S 開啟技能視窗，然後在 ETC 標籤頁裡找到這個技能。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
^ff0000You can then drag the skill to your hot bar for easy use!.^000000
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
^ff0000把技能拖到快捷欄上，用起來就方便多了！^000000

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
... and thats how I learned that When in doubt, let your peco do the thinkin'.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
...我就是這麼學會的：拿不定主意時，就讓你的大嘴鳥替你動腦筋。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Do ya have any other questions?
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
還有別的問題嗎？
[露莎]
有問題的話，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Well, I don't think that you are quite ready to get a shootin iron. So the training book only shows ya skills that don't need guns.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
嗯，我看你們還沒準備好拿槍。所以這本訓練手冊只介紹不需要槍械的技能。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Do ya have any other questions?
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
還有別的問題嗎？
[露莎]
有問題的話，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
If ya need more questions you can always come back ta me.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
有問題的話，隨時可以回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh! Are you just darling, a newly minted gunslinger!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哎呀！新晉神槍手真討人喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Why your shootin iron looks shinier then a silver zeny! Do ya need anything?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
喲，你那把槍亮得都快趕上銀幣了！需要什麼幫忙嗎？

scripts.text: Can you help me get to Einbroch?
scripts.translation: 能送我去艾音布羅克嗎？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Sure, why not? Make sure to spend some time trainin!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
當然行！記得多花點時間練習！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Get over there ya scamp!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
那就出發吧，小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh, I am glad to hear that you are so strong!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦，聽說你這麼厲害，我真替你高興！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ah, still in basic training eh? You're not carelessly using Butterfly Wings, right?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
啊，還在進行基礎訓練呀？你沒隨便用蝴蝶翅膀吧？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Are you going to Einbroch to complete basic training?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你要去艾音布羅克完成基礎訓練嗎？

scripts.text: Can you help me get to Einbroch?
scripts.translation: 能送我去艾音布羅克嗎？

scripts.text: No, I have other things to do.
scripts.translation: 不了，我還有別的事要辦。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Sure, why not? Make sure to spend some time trainin!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
當然行！記得多花點時間練習！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Get over there ya scamp!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
那就出發吧，小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh, is that so? If you wish to go to Einbroch but not take the Airship, come speak to me.
Because you're still training, I will send you there for free.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哦，是嗎？如果你想去艾音布羅克又不打算搭飛空艇，就來找我。
你還在訓練，我可以免費送你過去。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ah you're back, and now wearing lovely Gunslinger clothing! It suits you well, congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
喲，你回來啦，還穿上了帥氣的神槍手服裝！很適合你，恭喜！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
I just received the news from my brother regarding your achievement of completing basic training.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
我剛收到哥哥的訊息，聽說你已經完成基礎訓練了。

scripts.text: Brother?
scripts.translation: 哥哥？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Huh? My brother did not tell you? My brother is the one in charge of Basic Training.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
咦？我哥哥沒告訴你嗎？基礎訓練就是由他負責的。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Louie and Lusa are very similar names, right?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
路易和露莎這兩個名字很像，對吧？

scripts.text: I guess so...
scripts.translation: 我想是吧...

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Ha ha~ Well, our relationship is not really that important.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哈哈～算了，我們是什麼關係也沒那麼重要。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
I have been assigned to conduct Combat Training for the Gunslinger guild.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
我受命負責神槍手公會的戰鬥訓練。

scripts.text: Why you?
scripts.translation: 為什麼是你？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gunslingers are very fond of freedom, so the Guild had limited choices to choose from.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神槍手向來崇尚自由，所以公會能挑的人選不多。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
They suddenly called me to do this. Frankly I think it's a bit absurd.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
他們突然把我叫來負責這事。說實話，我覺得有點莫名其妙。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
But on the basis of there being no previous Combat Training before, I have agreed to help.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
不過，之前一直沒有戰鬥訓練，既然如此，我就答應幫忙了。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
So it was decided that we would use this opporunity to help get rid of some of the monsters near Prontera and Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
於是我們決定借這個機會，清理普隆德拉和依斯魯得島附近的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
It should help the people of those areas that are plagued by the same monsters every day.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
這樣也能幫幫那些每天都受同一批魔物侵擾的居民。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
In accordance with the principles of guilds, the Combat Training is not mandatory.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
公會有公會的規矩，戰鬥訓練並非強制參加。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Once you complete a task, talk to me again to complete to process.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
每完成一項任務，再來找我確認一下就行。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Well that's all! If a task proves to be too difficult you can cancel at any time, so please don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
就這些！任務太難的話，隨時都可以取消，不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Haven't started your basic combat training yet have you? What do you want to know about training?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你還沒開始基礎戰鬥訓練吧？想了解訓練的哪方面？

scripts.text: How long can I train for?
scripts.translation: 訓練能參加到什麼時候？

scripts.text: Where do I receive tasks for training?
scripts.translation: 去哪裡領取訓練任務？

scripts.text: Why do combat training?
scripts.translation: 為什麼要參加戰鬥訓練？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Basic combat training can be performed until Base Level 20.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
基礎戰鬥訓練可以參加到基礎等級20級。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You must've thought that the training would be pretty low because this is still the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你大概以為這只是初級訓練，難度不會太高吧？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Sorry! Did I not mention this?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
抱歉！我沒跟你說過這事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You can choose any task you wish from the requests on my desk near the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
入口附近的桌上放著任務委託，你想接哪個都行。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Right, ah, why? Well, The Gunslinger guild didn't have any combat training in the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
對了，為什麼會有這項訓練呢？神槍手公會一開始可沒有戰鬥訓練。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
So they suddenly asked me to perform combat training for new recruits.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
所以他們突然請我來給新手做戰鬥訓練。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
This training is not mandatory if you do not want to do it.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
不想參加的話，這項訓練也不是強制的。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment A>?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你完成<任務A>了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wow! You did perfectly! I have confirmed the 10 Hornets. Kids will be happy.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇，做得真漂亮！我確認過了，10只蜂兵都處理好了。孩子們會高興的。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 檢視報告後，你獲得了經驗值和一張卡普拉倉庫免費利用券。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment B>?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你完成<任務B>了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment B> too?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你也完成<任務B>了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wow! You did perfect! I have confirmed the 10 Roda Frogs. Tonight I should get a good sleep.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇，幹得漂亮！我確認過了，10只羅達蛙都處理好了。今晚我總算能睡個好覺了。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 檢視報告後，你獲得了經驗值和一張卡普拉倉庫免費利用券。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment C>?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你完成<任務C>了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment C> too?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你也完成<任務C>了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wow! You did perfect! I have confirm the 10 Savage Babes. Students who want to develop specialist pets must be very happy.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇，幹得漂亮！我確認過了，10只小野豬都處理好了。想培養專精寵物的學員一定會很開心。

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 檢視報告後，你獲得了經驗值和一張卡普拉倉庫免費利用券。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment D>?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你完成<任務D>了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You finished <Assignment D> too?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你也完成<任務D>了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Wow! You did perfect! I have confirmed the 10 Rockers. Were they hard to catch?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
哇，幹得漂亮！我確認過了，10只蝗蟲都處理好了。抓起來很費勁吧？

scripts.text: After looking over the report, you receive experience and a Kafra Storage Coupon.
scripts.translation: 檢視報告後，你獲得了經驗值和一張卡普拉倉庫免費利用券。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
I have finished processing your completed tasks. Would you like to cancel any existing tasks?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
我已經處理完你完成的任務了。要取消還沒完成的任務嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Okay, good luck continuing your training!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
好，祝你繼續訓練順利！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Huh? You do not have any assignments to cancel. Are you sure you have them?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
咦？你沒有正在進行、可以取消的任務呀。確定有接任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You still have some assignments, are they too difficult? Do you want to cancel them?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你還有任務沒完成，是不是太難了？要取消嗎？

scripts.text: Cancel Assignment
scripts.translation: 取消任務

scripts.text: Nevermind
scripts.translation: 暫不取消

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Well then, continue to impress!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
那就繼續努力，拿出點本事來！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You are currently doing <Assignment A>.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你正在進行<任務A>。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Hornets are not easy to deal with, huh? Do you want to cancel the assignment?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
蜂兵不太好對付吧？要取消這項任務嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
If you do cancel the assignment, you will be unable to receive the reward you know?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
取消任務的話，就拿不到獎勵了，知道嗎？

scripts.text: Cancel Assignment
scripts.translation: 取消任務

scripts.text: Nevermind
scripts.translation: 暫不取消

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh... Hornets are too tough?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Your Gunslinger basic training is now over.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
你的神槍手基礎訓練到此結束。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]

scripts.translation:
[露莎]

scripts.text: How are you?
scripts.translation: 最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Same old, same old. Every day teaching newbies about Gunslingers. But I love it.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
還是老樣子，每天教新人神槍手的知識。不過我挺喜歡這份工作。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Oh yeah! My brother said he hasn't seen you for a long time. Be sure to take some time to visit him.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
對了！我哥哥說好久沒見到你了，記得抽空去看看他。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Howdy! It's nice to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
嘿！很高興又見到你。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Howdy!
Huh! You seem to have transferred into a different class, why have you come here?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
嘿！
咦，你好像轉成別的職業了，怎麼又來這兒了？

scripts.text: To become a Gunslinger
scripts.translation: 我想成為神槍手

scripts.text: Leave
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Huh? Huh? Where are you going?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
咦？咦？你要去哪兒？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
You cannot have more than one job. But you seem really serious to learn.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
一個人不能同時擁有兩個職業。不過你看起來是真的很想學。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Since this is my job, and because it's no trouble, I will give you a simple explaination!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
反正這是我的工作，也不費事，我就給你簡單講講吧！

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gunslingers is a class with long-range attacks. However, unlike arrows, bullets are expensive. This tends to give beginners some reason for concern.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神槍手擅長遠端攻擊。不過子彈不像箭矢那麼便宜，所以新手常會為彈藥發愁。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Is that enough?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
這樣夠清楚了嗎？

scripts.text: Isn't that a little too simple?
scripts.translation: 這也太簡單了吧？

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Huh, is it? What else do you want to know?
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
咦，是嗎？你還想了解什麼？

scripts.text: Stats
scripts.translation: 屬性

scripts.text: Skills
scripts.translation: 技能

scripts.text: Weapons
scripts.translation: 武器

scripts.text: Nevermind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gunslingers is a long-range attack class, so hand agility (DEX) will be very important.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神槍手是遠端攻擊職業，所以靈巧（DEX）非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
If you want to increase your attack power, then you must strengthen your hands.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
想提高攻擊力，就得提升力量屬性。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gunslinger skills are not like other classes. Each weapon type has skills that can be specifically used with them.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神槍手的技能和其他職業不太一樣，每種武器都有專屬技能。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Like with other classes, there is no standard toward which skills you should learn.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
和其他職業一樣，技能沒有固定的學習路線，按自己的想法選擇就行。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gunslingers have five different kinds of guns.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
神槍手可以使用五種不同的槍械。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Revolvers have low hit rates, but the attack speed is fast.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
左輪手槍命中率較低，但攻擊速度很快。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Rifles are average in their performance, and is typically the weapon of choice for new Gunslingers.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
步槍效能均衡，通常是新手神槍手的首選。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Shotguns have strong attack power, but pretty low attack speeds.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
霰彈槍攻擊力很強，但攻擊速度比較慢。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gatling guns have quite a fast attack speed, but the attack power is low.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
加特林機槍射速很快，但攻擊力較低。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Gernade Launchers can be used for strong ground attacks, but the bullets will be consumed quickly.
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
榴彈發射器可以發動強力的範圍攻擊，不過彈藥消耗得很快。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]

scripts.translation:
[露莎]
呼～希望這些回答能解決你的疑問。我還是頭一回碰到想了解其他職業的人。

scripts.text:
[Lusa]
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[露莎]
保重！

scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
是～～？我、我是學院派來的。

我是神槍手公會的^A2563E銳利的蛇牙^000000。有什麼事？

scripts.text: Exchange Guns
scripts.translation: 交換槍械

scripts.text: Just Saying Hello
scripts.translation: 只是打個招呼

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You seem to be that guy our brother mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
你就是哥哥提到的那個人吧。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You don't need to worry, he said you're doing great!
scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
別擔心，他說你表現得很出色！

scripts.text:

Do you wish to exchange your guild issued weapon?
scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
你想更換公會配發的武器嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Let's first check your gun's condition.
scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
先讓我檢查一下你的槍。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]

scripts.translation:
[銳利的蛇牙]
要繼續的話，得先把武器裝備上。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

It's time to choose your job? How about Taekwon {0}? You may be a nice adult like me.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
是時候選職業了吧？考慮一下跆拳{0}怎麼樣？你也可以像我一樣成為出色的大人。

scripts.text: People following the Taekwon way
scripts.translation: 追隨跆拳之路的人

scripts.text: I want to follow the Taekwon way!!!
scripts.translation: 我要追隨跆拳之路！！！

scripts.text: Good morning! Now it is...
scripts.translation: 早上好！現在正是...

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Do you want to know about taekwon boy/girl? You want to be a cool guy like me right?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
想了解跆拳少年/少女嗎？你也想像我一樣成為帥氣的人吧？

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Make the world wonderful by making a strong body with the right spirit. That's the Taekwondo motto!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
以正確的精神鍛鍊強健的體魄，讓世界變得更美好。這就是跆拳道的座右銘！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Later if you are trained to be a stronger body, you can change your job to ^FF0000Taekwon Master^000000 or a ^FF0000Soul Linker ^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
等你把身體鍛鍊得更強健，就可以轉職為^FF0000拳聖^000000或^FF0000悟靈士^000000。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
It is not an easy way. So I don't like to recommend it to you if you aren't fully prepared. But it is definitely a nice and great way to follow!!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
這條路可不輕鬆，沒做好準備的話，我可不建議你走。不過，只要下定決心，這絕對是一條很棒的路！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Introduction to the class may let you know about what Taekwon in more detail.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
職業介紹能讓你更深入地瞭解跆拳。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
If you are really anxious about Taekown, I would like to recommend you a brief introduction. Will you use it?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
如果你特別想了解跆拳，我可以給你一份簡要介紹。要看看嗎？

scripts.text: After I look around more.
scripts.translation: 我再看看別的。

scripts.text: Yes, let's do this!
scripts.translation: 好，就這麼辦！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Every adventurer may have their own job! Hope you can find what you want!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
每位冒險者都有自己的職業道路！希望你能找到心儀的職業！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Go to the [Misc] tab on Skill Window after equipping the Manual and there you will see some skills.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
裝備手冊後，開啟技能視窗並切換到[其他]標籤頁，就能看到一些技能。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
^FF0000Flying Kick^000000 is the skill to approach rapidly and attack the enemy! It fully contains the typical feature of Taekwon!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
^FF0000飛腳踢^000000可以迅速接近敵人並發動攻擊！這招充分體現了跆拳的特色！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
^FF0000Warm Wind^000000 is the skill to change the feature of attacks. This is the essential skill for ^FF0000Taekwon unable to use weapons^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
^FF0000暖風^000000可以改變攻擊的屬性，是^FF0000無法使用武器的跆拳職業^000000必學的技能。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
While taking the Quest, experience the skills of a Taekwon! You could meet an adept trainer on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
接下任務，親自體驗跆拳技能吧！一樓就有位資深教練。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Want to follow the Taekwon way? Let me see....
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
想走跆拳這條路嗎？我看看...

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Taekwon is the tough way training himself rather than learning from somebody. However, if you want to follow, I will recommend you to a trainer.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
跆拳之道講究自我磨練，而不是依賴別人。不過你要是想加入，我可以給你推薦一位教練。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Training is on you, but he will give you the direction for training. I can take you about there. Want to go now?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
訓練得靠你自己，不過他會為你指點方向。我可以帶你過去，現在就走嗎？

scripts.text: Let me think a little more.
scripts.translation: 讓我再想想。

scripts.text: Let's go!!
scripts.translation: 走吧！！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Choose it with discretion. It is a matter of your future adventure.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
慎重考慮再做決定吧，這關係到你今後的冒險。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
You can find a boy with the same appearance as me, when you get in the town through ^FF0000the west entrance^000000, and continue follow the way ^FF0000to the north^000000 after passing the pub house but just before the archer town.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
從^FF0000西門^000000進城，經過酒館後繼續^FF0000往北走^000000，快到弓箭手之村前，你會看到一個長得和我一模一樣的男孩。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
To follow the Taekwon way, you have to get to job level 10. To be a Taekwon, train yourself until you get to job level 10!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
想走跆拳之道，就得先把職業等級升到10級。努力訓練，成為跆拳吧！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
If you feel difficult in training alone, make a visit to the trainer on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
要是覺得獨自訓練很辛苦，就去一樓找那位教練吧。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Ahahaha.. It is already time? While I am inside... Don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
啊哈哈...已經到時間了嗎？我還在裡面呢...別擔心。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Have a good day!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
祝你今天愉快！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
If you are interested in being a Taekwon making a healthy body with strong sprit, you can learn a lot here.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
如果你想成為跆拳，鍛鍊強健的體魄和堅定的精神，這裡有很多東西可以學。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
What do you think? Are you interested in being a Taekwon? I don't push you to do! But if you do, I may become your trainer.. So..
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
怎麼樣？想成為跆拳嗎？我不會勉強你！不過你要是願意，我可以當你的教練...怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I have interest!
scripts.translation: 我有興趣！

scripts.text: I have interest in you!
scripts.translation: 我對你有興趣！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Is that so!? You are!? Yaho! Now I am a teacher! Now, ask me whatever!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
真的嗎！？你真的願意！？耶！我現在也是老師了！想問什麼儘管問！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Hahaha.. You are interested in me?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
哈哈哈...你是對我有興趣嗎？

scripts.text: Suddenly, you see Arang's foot flying towards you.
scripts.translation: 阿朗突然朝你飛踢過來。

scripts.text: All you see are stars...
scripts.translation: 你眼前直冒金星...

scripts.text:
[Arang]
You look like a naive beginner? If you want to get in the class, come after registering on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
你看起來還是個沒經驗的新人。想參加課程的話，先去一樓登記再回來。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Are you diligently training? Once you are trained well, you could become a Taekwon Master or a Soul Linker.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
你訓練得很努力吧？練得足夠強之後，就能成為拳聖或悟靈士。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
You became a nice Taekwon Master!? Please keep in mind power is followed by responsibility.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
你已經成為出色的拳聖了！？記住，能力越大，責任越大。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Handling spirits is a very delicate job to do, I heard. Excellent! The adventurer led by me has grown up like this.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
聽說操控靈魂是一項非常細緻的工作。太棒了！我帶出來的冒險者已經成長到這一步了。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Ehra! I thought you followed the Taekwon way~~ it is regretful but everyone has their own life, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
哎呀！我還以為你會走跆拳之道呢～～雖然有點遺憾，不過每個人都有自己的路，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
I am propagating the way of Taekwons!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
我正在推廣跆拳之道！

scripts.text:
As I can't recall, I feel the shock that something hit me on my head.
^FF0000I should look for somebody to heal me nearby.^000000.
scripts.translation:
我想不起發生了什麼，只覺得頭上捱了一下。
^FF0000得去附近找人幫我治療。^000000

scripts.text: Why are you carrying so much with you? Unload it somewhere and come back.
scripts.translation: 你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？先找地方存起來再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Emmm. This is?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
嗯...這是？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You were never trained by me.
Then, I have no interest in you.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你沒有接受過我的訓練。
那我也沒什麼可教你的。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
I see you received a complete education in Payon.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
看來你在斐揚接受了完整的訓練。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Then again... you may want to learn more.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
不過...也許你還想再多學一些。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Either way, there is nothing I can teach you.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
不管怎樣，我已經沒什麼能教你的了。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Ah~ You've become a skilled Archer.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
啊～你已經是個熟練的弓箭手了。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
The difference is great now compared to when you were a novice!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
和你還是初心者時相比，進步可真大！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Because of my teachings, you have grown very fast!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
多虧了我的教導，你才能進步這麼快！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Sniff sniff! It is the smell of a novice!
Nice to meet you!!!
What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
嗅嗅！這是初心者的氣息！
見到你真高興！！！
你來這兒做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
I can guess most, but hehehehe~~
Please feel comfortable and tell me everything you want!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
我大概猜得到，嘿嘿嘿～～
放輕鬆，想問什麼儘管說！

scripts.text: I get bored! Play with me!
scripts.translation: 我好無聊！陪我玩！

scripts.text: Tell me about Archers.
scripts.translation: 跟我說說弓箭手吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
What? Bored? Play with you?
You think this is just some kids playground?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
什麼？無聊？要我陪你玩？
你當這兒是小孩子的遊樂場嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
If you are bored, walk around and punch a monster in the face and see what happens.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
無聊的話就出去走走，朝魔物臉上揍一拳，看看會怎樣。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Oh dear~ another sheep here to get a free lesson from me.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
哎呀～又來個想白聽我課的愣頭青。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
The main point of Archers is to use bows to attack enemies quickly from a long distance.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
弓箭手最擅長用弓箭從遠處迅速攻擊敵人。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Only problem is they are physically weak.
But, it doesn't matter if they are trained correctly.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
唯一的缺點是身板比較弱。
不過，只要訓練得當就不是問題。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
What do you want to know about an Archer? I will tell you everything~
With my full explanation~, you can be an excellent one.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
想了解弓箭手的什麼？我都可以告訴你～
聽完我的詳細講解，你也能成為出色的弓箭手。

scripts.text: Archer's stats
scripts.translation: 弓箭手的屬性

scripts.text: Archer's skills
scripts.translation: 弓箭手的技能

scripts.text: I want to become an Archer.
scripts.translation: 我想成為弓箭手

scripts.text: Nevermind
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Are you curious about the Archer's stats?
Do you know the most necessary stats for Archers?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
對弓箭手的屬性感興趣嗎？
你知道弓箭手最需要哪項屬性嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
That is ^0000cdDex^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
那就是^0000cd靈巧（DEX）^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
To raise up the attacking power in other jobs, Str should be raised but Archers vary in accordance with their Dex figures.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
其他職業通常要提升力量（STR）來增加攻擊力，弓箭手則主要靠靈巧（DEX）。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Here is a simple question! What is the name of the stat determining the Archer's attacking power?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
來個簡單的問題！決定弓箭手攻擊力的屬性是什麼？

scripts.text: Dex!
scripts.translation: 靈巧（DEX）！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You are correct~~
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
答對了～～

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
If you want to know more about the role of other stats, ^0000cdopen the status window by pressing ALT+Q.^000000
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
想了解其他屬性的作用，就^0000cd按 Alt + Q 開啟屬性視窗。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
If you are curious about stats except Dex, you can check it out.
If you have a job later, you can reset the stats anyway.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
想了解靈巧以外的屬性，可以自己看看。以後轉職了，反正還能重置屬性。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Hey, just click this and that!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
喏，點這裡，再點那裡就行！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Hmm. You are interested in skills? Then, let's study ^0000cdskill^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
嗯，對技能感興趣？那我們來看看^0000cd技能^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
I thought you would better experience the skill than talking, so I prepared the experience of the archer's skill in a manual.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
光聽我講不如親自試試，所以我把弓箭手技能的體驗內容整理進了手冊。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Archer have a lot of very useful skills.
But regretfully as most of them are skills useful only with arrows and bows, you can't experience them.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
弓箭手有很多實用技能。
可惜大多數技能都得配合弓箭使用，所以沒法在這裡體驗。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
There is a useful skill without a bow... Called ^0000cdImprove Concentration^000000
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
有個實用技能不需要弓箭...叫作^0000cd心神凝聚^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
At the same time, it will reveal hidden enemies nearby.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
它還能同時顯現附近隱匿的敵人。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
If you want to know more anout skill, then open the skill window by pressing the key  ^0000cdALT+S^000000
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
想了解更多技能，就按^0000cdAlt + S^000000開啟技能視窗。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
When you scoll the mouse on the skill icon, there pops up the details about the skill. Please read it.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
把滑鼠停在技能圖示上，就會顯示技能詳情。記得看看。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
To use skills, click the skill icon on the skill window. Then drag and register it on the ^0000cdshortcut window^000000 to use conveniently.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
要使用技能，先點選技能窗口裡的技能圖示，再把它拖到^0000cd快捷欄^000000，使用起來更方便。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Will you go and find a hunting teacher on the 1st floor? if you do not want, then no need.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
要去一樓找狩獵教練嗎？不想去也沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
But he may train you with a lot of useful hunting skills for you.
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[Battle Trainer Subino]^000000<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83,</INFO></NAVI>
You may visit him.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
不過，他能教你不少實用的狩獵技巧。
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[戰鬥訓練師 蘇比諾]^000000<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83,</INFO></NAVI>
你可以去找他。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Do you want to become an^0000cd Archer^000000?
It hasn't been a long time since we met together. But I am sad about saying good bye to you.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你想成為^0000cd弓箭手^000000嗎？
我們才剛認識不久，一想到要和你道別，我還真有點捨不得。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Let me check a little while, before you change your job you have to be at job level 10.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
我先確認一下：轉職前，你的職業等級必須達到10級。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Change conditions satisfied!!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
轉職條件已滿足！！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Do you really want to become an Archer?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你真的想成為弓箭手嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, change me to an Archer.
scripts.translation: 是的，幫我轉職為弓箭手

scripts.text: Let me think of it a little while.
scripts.translation: 讓我再考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
First, let me explain some things to you about the Job Change.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
轉職前，我先跟你說明幾件事。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
An Archer's hometown is ^0000cdPayon^000000; Which has a very long history.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
弓箭手的故鄉是^0000cd斐揚^000000，一座歷史悠久的城鎮。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
When you are feeling fatigued, you can go there.
You will be given a warm hometown welcome.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
累了的話就回去看看吧。
那裡的人會像家人一樣熱情地歡迎你。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
The Archers Guild is located to the ^0000cdNorth of Payon Archer Village^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
弓箭手公會位於^0000cd斐揚弓箭手村北邊^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
I will take you to the gates of Payon.
I would love to accompany you the rest of the way, but you must do this alone.
I'll give you the directions which you must remember.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
我會送你到斐揚城門口。
真想陪你走完剩下的路，不過那段路得由你獨自走。
我告訴你路線，你可要記好了。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Here is where I will send you to.
Once you arrive, you will see the area marked by this ^0000cdRed Circle^000000. Go through there, then...
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
我會把你送到這裡。
到了以後，先找到這個^0000cd紅圈^000000標記的地方，從那裡穿過去...

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You will reach the village of Payon.
Follow the direction of the ^0000cdRed Arrow^000000, you will enter ^0000cdArcher Village^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
穿過去就能到斐揚村。
沿著^0000cd紅色箭頭^000000走，就能進入^0000cd弓箭手村^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Once you get there, make your way to the ^0000cdCircled Area^000000. Here you will find the ^0000cdArcher Job Change Guild^000000.
Got it? Easy to find, right?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
到了之後，前往^0000cd圈出的區域^000000，那裡就是^0000cd弓箭手轉職公會^000000。
記住了嗎？很好找吧？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Due to satellite navigation, you shouldn't worry about getting lost.
However, if you are still worried, you can ask the local ^0000cdGuide^000000 where to go.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
現在有衛星導航，不用擔心迷路。
要是還是不放心，就問問當地的^0000cd嚮導^000000該怎麼走。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You can find me after your visit to the guild.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
拜訪完公會後再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Now then, I wish you success in becoming an Archer. Until next time!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
祝你順利成為弓箭手。回頭見！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Yes, come back and see me after reconsideration.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
好好考慮清楚，再回來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Hmmm. You are a little bit short of Job Level.
Are you coming back after more training?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
嗯，你的職業等級還差一點。
繼續訓練之後再回來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Visit <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Battle Trainer Subino]^000000<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83,</INFO></NAVI>
at Armory on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
去一樓軍械庫找<NAVI>^4D4DFF[戰鬥訓練師 蘇比諾]^000000<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83,</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Really? Then, don't be lazy but get some training.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
是嗎？那就別偷懶，去好好訓練吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Why are you still here? Are you not going to become an Archer?
Are you going to pursue a different job?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你怎麼還在這兒？不打算成為弓箭手了嗎？
還是想選擇別的職業？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Well? How is it being an Archer?
The student has surpassed the teacher, as the saying goes.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
怎麼樣，當弓箭手感覺如何？
俗話說，青出於藍而勝於藍嘛。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You don't seem to be fully registered at the Academy yet.
Hurry and complete your registration.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你好像還沒完成學院的註冊手續。
快去辦好吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Did you directly come here without the entrance application for Critura Academy yet?
You are too in a hurry. Rush to go to the 1st floor for application, and come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你還沒去克里圖拉學院辦入學申請，就直接跑來了嗎？
也太心急了吧。快去一樓申請，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Why are you of a different job snooping around here?
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
你一個其他職業的人，在這裡鬼鬼祟祟地做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Don't snoop around and get out of here!!
scripts.translation:
[馬爾布朗]
別在這裡東張西望，快出去！！

scripts.text: - Quest cannot be continued due to your overfilled inventory. -
scripts.translation: - 背包已滿，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You want to learn about Swordsman?
If you want to take the class you must register.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
想了解劍士嗎？
想參加課程的話，得先登記。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go and register at the counter on the 1st floor!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
去一樓櫃檯登記！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You want to become a swordsman?
Great decision.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
你想成為劍士？
眼光不錯。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Fight on the frontline with large swords,
Bringing victory and with a high defense to protect your comrades.
Simply put, we're the best.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
手持大劍衝鋒陷陣，為同伴抵擋攻擊、守住防線，帶領大家走向勝利。
簡單說，我們就是最強的。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
What do you think?
You want to become a Swordsman here?
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
怎麼樣？
想在這裡成為劍士嗎？

scripts.text: No thanks
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: I want to test Swordsman Skills!
scripts.translation: 我想體驗劍士技能！

scripts.text: Change me right now!
scripts.translation: 現在就幫我轉職！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Since you're not interested in this opportunity,
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
既然你對這個機會沒興趣，

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go hunt Porings and stay
as a novice forever!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
那就繼續去打波利，永遠當初心者吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Calm down, lets's start over.
First, I'll give you a ^FF0000Swordman Manual^000000
Read it carefuly before asking any questions.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
冷靜點，我們重新來過。
先給你一本^FF0000劍士入門手冊^000000。
有問題之前，先仔細讀一讀。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
If you want to become a Swordman,
You should reach over ^006400Base level 10^000000,
And become more than ^006400beginner's skill level 9^000000.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
想成為劍士，
^006400基礎等級必須達到10級^000000，
而且^006400初心者基本技能等級必須達到9級以上^000000。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Get taught here and follow the steps.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
先在這裡接受指導，再按步驟來。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
It seems you have learned enough.
Head over to the Swordsman Guild
to continue your change into a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
看來你已經學得差不多了。
去劍士公會繼續辦理轉職吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The Swordsman Guild is located
to the west of the Izlude Plaza Center.
It should be very easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
劍士公會就在依斯魯得廣場中央的西邊，
很好找。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
If you are equipped with a ^FF0000Swordman Manual^000000
You'll be able to experience the basic skills of the swordsman.
Now let's study the basics of Swordsman skills.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
裝備^FF0000劍士入門手冊^000000後，
就能體驗劍士的基礎技能。
現在來學學這些技能吧。

scripts.text: Swordman key points
scripts.translation: 劍士要點

scripts.text: Heightened Attack and defense.
scripts.translation: 提高攻擊力與防禦力

scripts.text: Related stats
scripts.translation: 相關屬性

scripts.text: Additional Swordman classes?
scripts.translation: 劍士的進階職業？

scripts.text: I learned enough already.
scripts.translation: 我已經學得差不多了

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Swordsman uses strong constitution; shrugs off damage easily from foes and when in a party, is a leader and the protector of others.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
劍士體格強健，能輕鬆扛住敵人的攻擊。在隊伍中，他們既是領袖，也是同伴的守護者。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Swordsman prefer to use spears, two-handed swords or combination sword and shield.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
劍士常用長矛、雙手劍，或一手持劍、一手持盾。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Also the swordsman's vitality is normally high making them able to carry massive amounts of weight.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
劍士的體質通常很高，因此負重能力也很強。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Desired stats are usually ^0000FFStr^000000, ^0000FFAgi^000000, ^0000FFVit^000000, ^0000FFDex^000000
Of course this is all up to you
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
常見的屬性配點是^0000FF力量^000000、^0000FF敏捷^000000、^0000FF體質^000000和^0000FF靈巧^000000。
當然，怎麼分配還是由你決定。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
^0000FFVit^000000 affects ^FF0000HP recovery rate^000000.
^0000FFStr^000000 affects ^FF0000strength and attacking power^000000.
^0000FFDex^000000 increases ^FF0000accuracy of your attack^000000,

[Trainer Adric]
^0000FFAgi^000000 increases ^FF0000attacking speed^000000 and ^FF0000evasion rate^000000,
^0000FFLuk^000000 affects ^FF0000probability of critical^000000.

[Trainer Adric]
After changing to a Swordsman you can change to a ^0000FFKnight^000000 or ^0000FFCrusader^000000.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
轉職為劍士後，可以繼續轉職為^0000FF騎士^000000或^0000FF十字軍^000000。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go raise your strength while figuring out if you're offensive or defensive.
This is something you should do.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
努力提升力量，同時想清楚自己更偏向進攻還是防守。這些都得由你自己決定。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The study material can be retaught by Neals the assitant trainer.
Remember this.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
想複習課程內容，可以找助理訓練師尼爾斯。記住了。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Using the Swordman Manual I gave you train by hunting monsters.
Go to the Battle Instructor Subino on the first floor Armory room.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
拿著我給你的劍士入門手冊去狩獵魔物，好好訓練。
記得去一樓軍械庫找戰鬥訓練師蘇比諾。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Raise your level to ^006400job level 10^000000 and get to ^006400beginner's skill level 9^000000, come back here again.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
把職業等級升到^00640010級^000000，並將^006400初心者基本技能升到9級^000000，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Since you have enough job levels,
you don't need any more lecturing.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
你的職業等級已經夠了，
不用再聽我講課了。

scripts.text: Then I will stop.
scripts.translation: 那我先走了。

scripts.text: But I want to listen more.
scripts.translation: 可我還想多聽一些。

scripts.text: I want to be a Swordsman right away!
scripts.translation: 我想馬上轉職為劍士！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You surpassed the study material to raise your level.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
你的等級已經超過教材涵蓋的進度了。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Impressive.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
真不錯。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
There's nothing else special to teach you.
Everything I taught you if you remember them well, that's all you need.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
沒什麼特別的內容可教你了。
只要把我教的東西都記牢，就足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
If you need additional training,
Go to the Battle Instructor Subino
on the first floor Armory room.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
還需要進一步訓練的話，
就去一樓軍械庫找戰鬥訓練師蘇比諾。

scripts.text: This is very tedious.
scripts.translation: 這也太麻煩了。

scripts.text: I need more training.
scripts.translation: 我還需要更多訓練。

scripts.text: I want to be a Swordsman right away!
scripts.translation: 我想馬上轉職為劍士！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
A simple No would've sufficed.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
直接說“不”就行了。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go to the Battle Instructor Subino on the first floor Armory room.
If you think you're ready, come back here.
You need to change to a Swordsman job soon!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
去一樓軍械庫找戰鬥訓練師蘇比諾。
覺得準備好了就回來找我。
你得儘快轉職為劍士！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
It seems you have learned enough.
Head over to the Swordsman Guild
to continue your transfer to a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
看來你已經學得差不多了。
去劍士公會繼續辦理劍士轉職吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The Swordsman Guild is located
to the west of the Izlude Plaza Center.
It should be very easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
劍士公會就在依斯魯得廣場中央的西邊，
很好找。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

很好找。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You still don't have enough to become a Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
你還沒達到轉職為劍士的條件。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
If you need some battle training find Subino on the first floor Armory of the Academy.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
需要戰鬥訓練的話，就去學院一樓軍械庫找蘇比諾。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
It seems you have learned enough.
Head over to the Swordsman Guild
to continue your change into a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
看來你已經學得差不多了。
去劍士公會繼續辦理轉職吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The Swordsman Guild is located
to the west of the Izlude Plaza Center.
It should be very easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
劍士公會就在依斯魯得廣場中央的西邊，
很好找。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
During this period, you must train really hard.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
這段時間一定要刻苦訓練。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Continue to improve your abilities to change to an amazing job!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
繼續提升實力，轉職成為更出色的職業吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You're already a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
你已經是劍士了！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
There's nothing else special to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
沒什麼特別的內容可教你了。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Hey! You already have a job!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
喂！你已經有職業了！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go away!
scripts.translation:
[訓練師 阿德里克]
走開！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
You want to learn about Swordsman?
If you want to take the class you must register and come back here.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
想了解劍士嗎？
想參加課程的話，先登記，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
As you are at the enough job level, you don't need any more lecturing.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
你的職業等級已經夠了，不用再聽課了。

scripts.text: Then I will stop.
scripts.translation: 那我先走了。

scripts.text: Become a swordsman right away!
scripts.translation: 現在就轉職為劍士！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Before the training starts, you already raised your level.
Impressive.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
訓練還沒開始，你就已經升級了。
真厲害。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
It seems that you have fully grown.
Head to the Swordsman Guild to become a swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
看來你已經訓練有成。
去劍士公會正式轉職為劍士吧！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
The Swordsman Guild is located in Izlude square
From the center, go west.
It should be easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
劍士公會在依斯魯得廣場中央往西的地方。
很好找。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
You are now a swordsman!
There's nothing else special to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
你現在已經是劍士了！
我沒什麼特別的內容可教你了。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
You already have another job!
Go away!
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
你已經轉職成別的職業了！
快走開！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Let's repeat the prerequisite of Swordsmanhood, this is a review study!
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
我們來復習一下成為劍士的條件吧！
