我們再複習一下成為劍士的條件吧！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Ask again anytime.
I'll answer everything!
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
隨時都可以再來問我。
我知無不言！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Let's repeat the prequisite of swordsmanhood,
this is a review study!
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
我們來復習一下成為劍士的條件吧！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Feeble people like you can become a gallant Swordsman soon.
Yes, you can. Be ambitious.
scripts.translation:
[助理訓練師 尼爾斯]
像你這樣弱不禁風的人，也能很快成為英勇的劍士。
沒錯，你一定行！要有志氣。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
I am the one in charge of magic studies in Criatura Academy
^0000FFA genius Mage^000000~!
^0000FFMage Chuck^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
我負責克里圖拉學院的魔法教學，
是位^0000FF天才魔法師^000000～！
我就是^0000FF魔法師查克^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Someone like you who has magic talent but doesn't know how to become a Mage.
For a ^FF0000Novice^000000 like you I'm offering my training.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
你這樣有魔法天賦，卻不知道怎麼成為魔法師的人，
正是我^FF0000初心者^000000訓練課程的物件。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
How about it?
Do you wanna try out my priceless lessons?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
怎麼樣？
想不想聽聽我這無價的課程？

scripts.text: I will learn.
scripts.translation: 我要學。

scripts.text: No thanks!
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you don't listen to me, you'll regret of it.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
不聽我的話，你會後悔的。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
When you change your mind, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
改變主意了就再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Good! If that's your decision, I will do my best.
How much you learn depends on your own effort.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
很好！既然你決定了，我一定盡力教你。
能學到多少，就看你自己有多努力了。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
To become a Mage, you need to be very studious.
Ask me what you want to learn!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
想成為魔法師，就得勤奮好學。
告訴我你想了解什麼吧！

scripts.text: What is a Mage's primary role?
scripts.translation: 魔法師的主要職責是什麼？

scripts.text: What ^8B4513stats^000000 are good for Mage?
scripts.translation: 哪些^8B4513屬性^000000適合魔法師？

scripts.text: What are Mage's ^8B4513skill^000000s?
Can I try some skills?!
scripts.translation: 我可以試試技能嗎？！

scripts.text: I want to ^8B451Cchange job^000000 to Mage!
scripts.translation: 我想^8B451C轉職^000000為魔法師！

scripts.text: I'll get back to you later
scripts.translation: 我晚點再來。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
A Mage's primary role is to use magic to inflict powerful attacks.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
魔法師的主要職責，就是施展魔法發動強力攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
We have low defense but have various attack ^006400skills^000000.
Be careful about the damage you take as a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
我們的防禦力比較低，但擁有各種攻擊^006400技能^000000。
當魔法師可得小心別受傷。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you remember these little things you can become a great Mage.
Walk with pride as you grow in magic power~
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
記住這些小要點，你也能成為出色的魔法師。
隨著魔力增長，昂首挺胸地前進吧～

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
還想了解魔法師的其他事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Doesn't a Mage remind you something solid?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
說到魔法師，你會不會想到某種堅實的東西？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Sheer physical force is for brutes who increase their ^006400STR^000000.
For a ^0000FFgenius Mage^000000 like myself that's a waste.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
只會提升^006400力量^000000、靠蠻力戰鬥的人才需要體格。
對我這樣的^0000FF天才魔法師^000000來說，那簡直是浪費。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Become wise and clever with your^006400 mind power^000000.
This is Mage's primary attribute- ^006400INT^000000, it's what's most important!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
提升^006400智力^000000，讓自己變得睿智又機敏。
這是魔法師最重要的屬性——^006400智力^000000！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you remember these little things you can become a great Mage.
Walk with pride as you grow in magic power~
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
記住這些小要點，你也能成為出色的魔法師。
隨著魔力增長，昂首挺胸地前進吧～

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
還想了解魔法師的其他事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Mages have powerful magical skills.
The basis of these skills are the attributes ^006400<Water, Wind, Earth, Fire>^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
魔法師能施展強力的魔法技能。
這些技能以^006400<水、風、土、火>^000000四種屬性為基礎。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
As each element has its own^006400 range attack magic^000000, these are useful when dealing with many enemies~!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
每種屬性都有自己的^006400範圍攻擊魔法^000000，對付一群敵人時特別好用～！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Ok enough talk.
I will show you my power by offering a demonstration.
You should be honored to be witnessing this!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
好了，不說了。
我來給你展示一下真正的實力。
能親眼見證可要好好珍惜！

scripts.text: [Mage Chuck]
scripts.translation: [魔法師 查克]

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Detecting hidden enemies
^006400Sight^000000 !!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
探測附近隱匿的敵人
^006400火狩^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Deflect all physical attacks
^006400Safety Wall^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
抵擋所有物理攻擊
^006400暗之障壁^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Fire damage premier ~!!!
^006400Fire Ball^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
感受火系傷害的巔峰～！！！
^006400火球術^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Wall of Fire~!!
^006400Fire Wall^000000!!!!

[Mage Chuck]
Want a taste of thunder?
^006400Lightening Bolt^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
想嚐嚐雷電的滋味嗎？
^006400雷擊術^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Get lost in the storm!
^006400Thunder Storm^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
在風暴中迷失吧！
^006400雷暴術^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
What killed the dinosaurs?
The Ice Age!
^006400Frost Diver^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
恐龍是怎麼滅絕的？
冰河時代！
^006400冰凍術^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Doesn't it shake your heart to see my skills?
You won't get hurt so don't worry~!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
看到我的技能，難道不覺得熱血沸騰嗎？
別擔心，你不會受傷的～！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
還想了解魔法師的其他事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
I think you already received a ^FF0000Mage Manual^000000~!
I can't offer you two of them.
One is good enough~!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
我想你已經拿到^FF0000魔法師入門手冊^000000了～！
一本就夠了，我可不能再給你一本。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Try out the skills after equipping the^006400 Mage Manual^000000.
Then hunt with the skills given to you in your skill window.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
裝備^006400魔法師入門手冊^000000後，就能試用這些技能。
再用技能窗口裡學到的技能去狩獵吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
還想了解魔法師的其他事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Right, you must be set with your heart firm on becoming a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
很好～看來你已經下定決心要成為魔法師了。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
OK! Then I'll give you a chance to taste what it is to become a Mage.
Take this ^006400Mage Manual^000000.
I'll let you borrow it!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
好！我就讓你體驗一下成為魔法師的感覺。
拿著這本^006400魔法師入門手冊^000000，我借給你用！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Try out the skills after equipping the^006400 Mage Manual^000000.
Then hunt with the skills given to you in your skill window.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
裝備^006400魔法師入門手冊^000000後，就能試用這些技能。
再用技能窗口裡學到的技能去狩獵吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
It's a valuable item so don't lose it.
If you want to become a genius ^0000FFMage^000000 like me, follow in my path.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
這是貴重物品，別弄丟了。
想成為像我一樣的^0000FF天才魔法師^000000，就跟著我的腳步走吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you want to become a Mage lighten up your inventory load.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
想轉職為魔法師，就先把背包清空一些。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
還想了解魔法師的其他事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Ah~ you want to change to a magician?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
啊～你想轉職為魔法師嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
I seem to have used a great deal of magic sending you before...
Because of too many students like you, I cannot send you again!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
剛才為了把你送過去，我好像耗費了不少魔力...
像你這樣的學生實在太多了，我沒法再送你一次！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you really want to go, then please go speak to the Kafra Staff and use their Teleport Service.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
真想過去的話，就去找卡普拉職員使用傳送服務吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Ah~ you want to change to a magician?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
啊～你想轉職為魔法師嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
To change your job to a magician, you must visit the Magician's Guild.
I can send you close to there, but...
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
要轉職為魔法師，得去魔法師公會。
我可以把你送到附近，不過...

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
You must first reach ^006400Job level 10^000000 and ^006400Basic Skill level 9^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
你得先達到^006400職業等級10級^000000，並將^006400基本技能升到9級^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
You don't seem ready!
If you want to change your job, you must first be ^006400Job level 10^000000 and ^006400Basic Skill level 9^000000.
Then come back and see me!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
你看起來還沒準備好！
想要轉職，必須先達到^006400職業等級10級^000000，並將^006400基本技能升到9級^000000。
達到條件後再回來找我！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
What else do you want to know about magicians?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
關於魔法師，你還想了解什麼？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Ah, it seems that you already have those requirements!
Do you want to change your job immediately?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
啊，看來你已經滿足轉職條件了！
現在就要轉職嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Okay, when you have decided please come back!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
好，決定好了就回來找我！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
What else do you want to know about magicians?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
關於魔法師，你還想了解什麼？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
In that case, I'll use magic to send you near ^8B4513Geffen^000000, where the Magician's Guild is.
It is there that you will be able to become a magician.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
那我用魔法把你送到^8B4513吉芬^000000附近，魔法師公會就在那兒。
你可以在那裡轉職為魔法師。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Once I send you, you will speak to the ^0000FFMage's Guild Guide^000000.
They will be able to assist you further.
Let's go! I'm ready to send you there!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
我送你過去後，記得找^0000FF魔法師公會嚮導^000000。
他會繼續幫你辦理轉職。
走吧！我準備好送你過去了！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Whoosh Whoosh
Ooo... Ooo... Hum... Hmm!
Teleport!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
呼——呼——
哦...哦...嗯...嗯！
傳送！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Yes~ Go meet other teachers then come back.
Of course, Mages are most alluring of them all.~
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
好～先去見見其他老師，再回來找我。
當然，魔法師才是最迷人的職業～

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
You'll choose Mage again I have no doubt about it~~!!
Haha see you later~
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
我敢肯定，你最後還是會選魔法師~~！！
哈哈，回頭見～

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
First you'll have to complete your ^8B4513registration^000000 at the Academy front desk.
If you go to the 1st floor of the academy someone will help you register.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
首先，得去學院前臺完成^8B4513註冊^000000。
到學院一樓就有人能幫你辦理。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
You're no longer the innocent ^8b4513Novice^000000 who doesn't know anything~?
I don't have anything to teach you~!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師 查克]
你已經不是那個什麼都不懂的^8b4513初心者^000000了吧～？
我沒什麼可教你的了～！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
It seems that you've come from Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
看來你是從克里圖拉學院來的。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
You look a little exhausted...
Though.. to become a magician is exhausting in a way...
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
你看起來有點累...
不過，成為魔法師確實也挺耗神的...

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
First off, my task is to guide you to the Mage's guild!
Go straight to the right!
After ^8B4513crossing the bridge^000000, you will see the entrance to ^FF0000Geffen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
我的工作就是帶你去魔法師公會！
一直往右走！
^8B4513過了橋^000000之後，就能看到^FF0000吉芬^000000的入口！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Once there,
You should find our <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Magician's Guild Guide]^000000<INFO>geffen,43,123,</INFO></NAVI>.
Speak to him, he will continue to guide you to the Magician's Guild!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
到了那裡，
你會看到我們的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[魔法師公會嚮導]^000000<INFO>geffen,43,123,</INFO></NAVI>。
和他談談，他會繼續帶你去魔法師公會！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
First off, my task is to guide you to the Mage's guild!
Go straight to the right!
After ^8B4513crossing the bridge^000000, you will see the entrance to ^FF0000Geffen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
我的工作就是帶你去魔法師公會！
一直往右走！
^8B4513過了橋^000000之後，就能看到^FF0000吉芬^000000的入口！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Once there,
You should find our <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Magician's Guild Guide]^000000<INFO>geffen,43,123,</INFO></NAVI>.
Speak to him, he will continue to guide you to the Magician's Guild!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
到了那裡，
你會看到我們的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[魔法師公會嚮導]^000000<INFO>geffen,43,123,</INFO></NAVI>。
和他談談，他會繼續帶你去魔法師公會！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
I am in charge of bringing ^8B4513Criatura Academy^000000 students to the Mage's guild.
These days the academy has a lot of new students so I'm happy to be working.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
我負責帶^8B4513克里圖拉學院^000000的學生去魔法師公會。
最近學院來了很多新生，我也忙得很開心。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Ah, you made it all the way here. Very good for an academy student!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
你居然一路走到了這裡，真不愧是學院的學生！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Before this step-by-step guide, they would get lost and frustrated.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
以前沒有這樣一步步的指引，學生們總會迷路，急得團團轉。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Anyways, let's keep this short.
I will now tell you the route to the Mage's Guild!
The way to go is quite simple...
From here, go toward 11 o'clock, you will see the Mage's Guild.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
總之，長話短說。
我這就告訴你去魔法師公會的路線！
路很簡單...
從這裡朝11點鐘方向走，就能看到公會。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Just go inside, and upstairs a little to find the
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[Mage Guildsman]^000000<INFO>geffen_in,164,124,</INFO></NAVI>
From there, he will assist you in becoming a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
直接進去，再往樓上走一小段，就能找到
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[魔法師公會成員]^000000<INFO>geffen_in,164,124,</INFO></NAVI>。
他會幫你轉職為魔法師。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
The way to go is quite simple...
From here, go toward 11 o'clock, you will see the Mage's Guild.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
路很簡單...
從這裡朝11點鐘方向走，就能看到魔法師公會。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Just go inside, and upstairs a little to find the
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[Mage Guildsman]^000000<INFO>geffen_in,164,124,</INFO></NAVI>
From there, he will assist you in becoming a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
直接進去，再往樓上走一小段，就能找到
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[魔法師公會成員]^000000<INFO>geffen_in,164,124,</INFO></NAVI>。
他會幫你轉職為魔法師。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
I am in charge of bringing ^8B4513Criatura Academy^000000 students to the Mage's guild.
These days the academy has a lot of new students so I'm happy to be working.
scripts.translation:
[魔法師公會嚮導]
我負責帶^8B4513克里圖拉學院^000000的學生去魔法師公會。
最近學院來了很多新生，我也忙得很開心。

scripts.text: - As you are overloaded with so many items, quest can't be proceeded. -
scripts.translation: - 背包超重，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Ehm?
This class only for Novices just starting their adventure.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
嗯？
這門課程只面向剛開始冒險的初心者。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Looking at you, you seem like you need some help. How about going to another place?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
看起來你需要幫忙。要不要我帶你去別處？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~
At a glance, hey, you like the lost baby sheep.. Here the non registered passengers are prohibited.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦～
一看你就像只迷路的小羊羔...這裡不允許未登記的乘客進入。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
If you want to look around this area without physical prohibiton, you would better register first at the info desk at the Academy entrance.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
想在這片區域自由活動的話，最好先去學院入口的資訊臺登記。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Ho Oh~
You look like you're ready to change to a first job.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦～
看起來你已經準備好轉職為一轉職業了。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
How about it? Are you interested in the way of the Merchant? If so, I may be helpful for you.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
怎麼樣？你對商人這條路感興趣嗎？如果有興趣，我可以幫你。

scripts.text: Not interest.
scripts.translation: 沒興趣

scripts.text: Interested.
scripts.translation: 感興趣

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh.. No...
Well, there is no way. Our Criatura Academy put the priority to the adventurer's choice.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦...這樣啊...
好吧，沒辦法。克里圖拉學院會優先尊重冒險者自己的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Good~ Then, I will send you to the town of Alberta. There you can become a merchant.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
很好～那我就送你去艾爾貝塔。在那裡你可以轉職為商人。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Do not go elsewhere, immediately enter the town.
Find the <NAVI>[Forge]<INFO>alberta_in,75 48</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
別到處亂跑，直接進城。
找到<NAVI>[鍛造屋]<INFO>alberta_in,75 48</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: Not yet ready.
scripts.translation: 我還沒準備好

scripts.text: I'm Ready!
scripts.translation: 我準備好了！

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes, I understand. When you are ready, let me see you again.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
嗯，我明白了。準備好後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Good~ Please go to the Forge and find me.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
很好～去鍛造屋找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~
Hey, you like a lost sheep. Do you know why you've come here?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦～
嘿，你看起來像只迷路的小羊。知道自己為什麼來這裡嗎？

scripts.text: Don't Know
scripts.translation: 不知道

scripts.text: Know.
scripts.translation: 知道

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh... you don't?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦...你不知道啊？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~ you seem like a quick learner.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦～你學得挺快嘛。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Well, I should at least give a briefing.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好吧，至少先給你簡單介紹一下。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
I am ^0000ffSalim Hamid^000000 in charge with training the merchant course here at the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
我是^0000ff薩利姆·哈米德^000000，負責克里圖拉學院的商人課程。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
This classroom is for Merchant applicants. In fact, this room is mainly for doing the finacial management of the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
這間教室是給商人課程學員用的。實際上，這裡主要負責學院的財務管理。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Next time, if you want to observe the merchant course, you can visit me, Salim Hamid and register.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
下次想旁聽商人課程的話，來找我薩利姆·哈米德登記就行。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~ You came back. Do you want to experience the Merchant training course? It is a little bit difficult to the average beginner.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦～你回來啦。想體驗商人培訓課程嗎？對一般的新手來說，這課稍微有點難。

scripts.text: No thanks!
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝！

scripts.text: Sign me up!.
scripts.translation: 幫我報名！

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~ though it is a bit hard, it is worth learning. Sadly, there's no other way.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦～雖然有點難，但很值得學。可惜沒有別的辦法。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh, yes... Then, first will you register your name in this student list?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哦，對了...先在這份學員名單上寫下你的名字吧？

scripts.text: Refuse.
scripts.translation: 不了

scripts.text: Put your name on the list.
scripts.translation: 把名字寫在名單上

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Resistance from the beginning? This isn't the way to start training.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
一開始就打退堂鼓？這樣可沒法開始訓練。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Ummm~ Your name is...
^0000ff{0}^000000...... right?

[Salim Hamid]
First to observe the Merchant course, you need to have the Merchant mindset. A trader with less than 100 zeny could not be called a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
想旁聽商人課程，首先要有商人的頭腦。身上連100 Zeny都不到，可算不上商人。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
{0}^000000 come back to me with 100 Zeny in hand before the next class.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
{0}^000000，下次上課前記得帶著100 Zeny來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Of course, that money won't be taken. It is only A test to see your basic mindset to being a Merchant. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
當然，我不會收走這筆錢。這只是測試你有沒有成為商人的基本意識。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Wow, you really came back with 100 zeny in hand. I feel your desire to learn clearly.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哇，你真的帶著100 Zeny回來了。我能感受到你求知的熱情。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now. I will give you a Merchant's manual. Equipped with it. Press Alt + S key and look at the skill window.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好，我給你一本商人入門手冊。裝備上它，再按 Alt + S 開啟技能視窗。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Clicking the [MISC] tab on the skill window, you can see the Merchant manual skills.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
點選技能窗口裡的[雜項]標籤，就能看到商人手冊中的技能。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now~ as we should go to the next course, equip the guide and see the skill, then speak to me again.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
接下來要上下一堂課了。先裝備手冊，看看裡面的技能，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Hohohong.. Test is not easy? Will you give it up now?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
呵呵呵...測試很難嗎？現在要放棄了？

scripts.text: Can't do it.
scripts.translation: 我做不到

scripts.text: Give it up.
scripts.translation: 我放棄

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Will you? 100 zeny isn't hard to get pal.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
真要放棄嗎？朋友，100 Zeny可不難賺。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes, come back to me when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好吧，改變主意後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now, how about attending the class concerning various basic skills which merchants should have for making money.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
接下來上一堂課，學學商人賺錢所需的各種基礎技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
This might be better for you to learn from the steward working on the field next door. Go to him for the Merchant theory course, then return to me.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
隔壁田地裡有位管家，或許他更適合教你。先去上商人理論課，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Haven't you gone to him for the class? Go to the steward next to me and return after completing the Merchant skill theory.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
你還沒去上課嗎？去我旁邊找那位管家，學完商人技能理論後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Have you come after a good lesson from the steward concerning what a Merchant can do?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
你聽完那位管家講商人能做什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
By any chance, {0} do you have mind to learn more about Merchants here?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
對了，{0}，你還想在這裡多瞭解一些商人的知識嗎？

scripts.text: I will look around at more jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想再看看其他職業

scripts.text: Let me do it a little more.
scripts.translation: 我想再學一會兒

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes, your open mind is good for you. As this academy has many other lecturers besides Merchants.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
很好～願意多方瞭解對你有好處。學院裡除了商人課程，還有很多其他講師。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Whenever you feel like learning again, come back to me {0}.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
{0}，什麼時候想繼續學習，都可以回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Is that so? OK, now how about learning the major effects of Merchant's stats? If you are ready, speak to me.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
是嗎？好，那我們來講講商人各項屬性的主要作用。準備好了就跟我說。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Trader's stats are classified as two major series. One is for manufacturing, the other is for battle.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
商人的屬性配點大致分為兩類：一類用於製造，另一類用於戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Of course, these are for farther down in the future. At this moment, you are even short of stats to invest DEX enabling you to hunt a monster.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
這些都是以後的事了。眼下你連打怪所需的靈巧（DEX）都還不夠呢。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
But, there is a big difference between your knowledge of the basic rules and being ignorant of it.
Let's learn about it one by one.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
不過，懂得基本原則和一無所知可大不一樣。
我們一項一項來學吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now, what series do we start with?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
那我們先從哪一類講起？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now, what series do we start with?
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
那我們先從哪一類講起？
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好，這堂課就到這裡。
還想了解商人的話，歡迎再來找我。

scripts.text: Already know it.
scripts.translation: 我已經知道了

scripts.text: Battle Stats.
scripts.translation: 戰鬥屬性

scripts.text: Crafting Stats.
scripts.translation: 製造屬性

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
It will be OK as it is, won't it?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
保持這樣也沒問題，對吧？

scripts.text: I already know all of them.
scripts.translation: 這些我都知道

scripts.text: Please make another explanation.
scripts.translation: 請再講一遍

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes, you are {0} I am pleased to meet a quick-to-learn student like you. It also saves my time.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
沒錯，你就是{0}。能遇到像你這樣一點就通的學生真好，也省了我的時間。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Aha~ I think I got you wrong. Let's start the lecture again.
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
啊～看來我誤會你了。那我們重新開始講吧。
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好，這堂課就到這裡。
還想了解商人的話，歡迎再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Being in a trader role, the stats affecting the figure of battle power are two ^4d4fffSTR & DEX^000000.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
商人的戰鬥能力主要受兩項屬性影響：^4d4fff力量（STR）和靈巧（DEX）^000000。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
STR is related to the basic attacking power, DEX is to hit ratio and recovery from damage.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
力量（STR）影響基礎攻擊力，靈巧（DEX）則影響命中率和受傷後的恢復速度。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
In you future, according to the 2nd and 3rd jobs you choose, you can learn additional attacking stats such ^4d4fffINT or AGI^000000.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
以後選擇二轉或三轉職業後，還可以根據職業需求提升^4d4fff智力（INT）或敏捷（AGI）^000000等屬性。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
To back up your shortage, you can increase LUK a little.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
也可以稍微提高一點幸運（LUK），彌補其他方面的不足。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Rather than worry yourself, it may be a good idea to learn from other Merchants. You know ask others for advice.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
別一個人悶頭苦想，多向其他商人請教就好。遇到問題可以找人商量嘛。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Any other questions?
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
還有其他問題嗎？
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好，這堂課就到這裡。
還想了解商人的話，歡迎再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
The stats concerning crafting is simpler than that concerning battle. Only difficulty is how to cultivate it.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
製造型商人的屬性配點比戰鬥型簡單，難點只在於怎麼培養。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
It is common that you increase ^4d4fffDEX & LUK^000000 as the base and, if you have surplus, you invest the rest in ^4d4fffINT^000000.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
通常以^4d4fff靈巧（DEX）和幸運（LUK）^000000為主，有剩餘點數的話，再投到^4d4fff智力（INT）^000000上。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Of course, the allocation of the portion should be properly adjusted in accordance with your equipments and the status you are in.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
當然，具體怎麼分配，還得看你的裝備和當前狀況。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
One thing you should keep in mind is it may be a very boring and ascetic way to grow alone as Merchant specializing in crafting.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
有一點要記住：專精製造的商人若是單打獨鬥，成長過程可能會很枯燥，也很艱苦。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
If possible, make use of your friends and their items if you can.
This is my personal opinion only.
It is absolutely not the official standpoint of the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
有需要的話，不妨請朋友幫忙，也借用一下他們的物品。
這只是我的個人意見，
絕不代表克里圖拉學院的官方立場。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Any other questions?
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
還有其他問題嗎？
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好，這堂課就到這裡。
還想了解商人的話，歡迎再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好，這堂課就到這裡。
還想了解商人的話，歡迎再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
You came back again. {0} this time, shall we have a practical training by doing a simple errand?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
你又回來啦。{0}，這次要不要做個簡單的跑腿任務，來練習實戰？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Can you see the noisy vending machine at the corner of this classroom? It was originally a soft drink vending machine but swallows coin very much...
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
看到教室角落那臺吵鬧的自動販賣機了嗎？它原本賣飲料，不過特別會吞硬幣...

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Anyway, due to this reason, it is now being used for the trainees' practice of skills. Please check the prices for Garlet and Zargon.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
總之，現在學員會用它來練習技能。去查查加勒結晶和剎勒空結晶的價格吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
But! You should come back wit the information about ^4d4fffthe discounted prices equipped with the merchant's manual and applied with the discount rate^000000.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
不過！記得裝備商人手冊、使用折扣技能後，再把^4d4ffft折扣後的價格^000000帶回來。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Don't buy them. Just come back with the checked prices only. Can you do it?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
別買，只要查好價格回來告訴我就行。辦得到嗎？

scripts.text: I will do it next time.
scripts.translation: 我下次再做

scripts.text: I will do it.
scripts.translation: 我這就去

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
OK. Then you challenge it next time.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好，那下次再來挑戰吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Good~ I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好～回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes. Let's see the prices you checked.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好，給我看看你查到的價格。

scripts.text: I will come back after rechecking them.
scripts.translation: 我再核對一遍就回來

scripts.text: Garlet 39z Zargon 450z
scripts.translation: 加勒結晶 39z／剎勒空結晶 450z

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
OK. You come back after rechecking them in detail.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
好，仔細核對完再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
OK~ You correctly checked the prices equipped with Merchant's Manual.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
不錯～你查到的是裝備商人手冊後的正確價格。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Perhaps, if you become a Merchant and use the high level of discount skill, you can buy what you want at much cheaper prices.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
等你成為商人後，把低價買進技能練高些，就能用更便宜的價格買到想要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
The practice of overcharge will be the same.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
高價賣出也是同樣的道理。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
You don't need to practice the overcharge as well. You experience it while selling items earned during the other courses.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
高價賣出不用特意練習。上其他課程時，把獲得的物品賣掉就能體驗了。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now the Merchant training at the Academy is finished.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
學院的商人訓練到此結束。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Did you correctly check them?
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
價格都查對了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Hahaha. {0} you have completed the Merchant theory course at the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
哈哈。{0}，你已經完成克里圖拉學院的商人理論課程了。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
When you want to test the other battle skills in the Merchant's Manual,
visit <NAVI>[Battle Trainer Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI> on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
想體驗商人手冊裡的其他戰鬥技能，就去一樓找<NAVI>[戰鬥訓練師 蘇比諾]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
You can fully experience the battle related practice through him.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
你可以跟他充分練習戰鬥相關的內容。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
The guide for the next course {0} will be serviced when you reach job level 10. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[薩利姆·哈米德]
達到職業等級10後，就能參加下一門課程了，{0}。祝你好運。

scripts.text: - As you are overloaded with so many items, quest can't be proceeded.
scripts.translation: - 背包超重，無法繼續任務。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Mr. Hamid sent you here. Nice to meet you. Being busy in organizing the account book, I will make time for you.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
哈米德先生讓你來找我吧？幸會。我正忙著整理賬簿，不過還是能抽空接待你。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
There are many ways to make margin on trading.. A threat, a concillation, black-market dealings, etc.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
做生意賺錢的手段可多了...威脅、和解、黑市交易，等等。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
If necessary, even various violent and bloody shortcuts (wow this guy is serious!)
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
必要時，還能走各種暴力血腥的捷徑。（哇，這傢伙還真敢說！）

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
OH wait, what did I tell you?
These are legally prohibited behaviors. So, Merchants will be given two skills. Those are ^4d4fffOvercharge and Discount^000000..
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
啊，等等，我剛才說了什麼？
這些手段都違法。所以商人有兩項技能：^4d4fff高價賣出和低價買進^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Besides, there are some other helpful skills such as ^4d4fffPush Cart Vending, Item Appraisal^000000 etc.. Which are not related directly to them though.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
此外還有一些實用技能，比如^4d4fff手推車、露天商店和物品鑑定^000000，不過它們和這兩項技能沒有直接關係。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Any questions among them?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
這些技能有什麼想問的嗎？

scripts.text: I already know all of them.
scripts.translation: 這些我都知道

scripts.text: Overcharge & Discount
scripts.translation: 高價賣出和低價買進

scripts.text: Other skills
scripts.translation: 其他技能

scripts.text: Item Appraisal
scripts.translation: 物品鑑定

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Really are you OK with it?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
你真的都清楚了嗎？

scripts.text: Wait I know it all.
scripts.translation: 等等，我全都知道

scripts.text: No, please explain them again.
scripts.translation: 不，請再解釋一遍

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Ho O~ You don't have any questions?
OK. You are a person of practice rather than of theory.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
哦～你沒有問題嗎？
好吧，看來你是重實踐、輕理論的人。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
The additional lecture will be provided by Mr. Salim Hamid. Ah. I have something to give you.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
接下來的課程由薩利姆·哈米德先生負責。對了，我有樣東西要給你。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
This is a box containing the defective equipments leaving from the inventory organization here.
Please practice the Item Appraisal skill in the Merchant Manual with it.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
這是整理庫存時清出來的一箱瑕疵裝備。
用它來練習商人入門手冊裡的物品鑑定技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
I anticipate to see you next time in a good shape.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
希望下次見面時，你已經練得身手矯健。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Ho O~ Sorry but I got you wrong.
Let's start the class.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
哦～抱歉，是我誤會你了。
那我們開始上課吧。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
It is simple to use Overcharge and Discount.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
高價賣出和低價買進都很容易使用。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
These two skills are passive skills. If you become familiar with these, {0} these will automatically perform in trading with merchant NPC without your operation.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
這兩項都是被動技能。熟悉之後，{0}，和商人 NPC 交易時它們會自動生效，無需手動操作。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Once you've learned Overcharge, when selling commodities to a merchant NPC, you can gain the sales money composed of the regular sales price plus additional money as per the Overcharge skill level.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
學會高價賣出後，把商品賣給商人 NPC 時，除了正常售價，還能根據技能等級獲得額外收入。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Oppositely, Discount is the skill, on your buying commodities from a merchant NPC, you can purchase it at the price discounted on the regular selling price as per the skill level.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
低價買進則相反：從商人 NPC 購買商品時，可以根據技能等級享受折扣。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Be carefult that these two skills are to be used only in trading with usual merchant's NPC, not with other manufacturing NPC or among adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
要注意，這兩項技能只對普通商人 NPC 的交易有效，不能用於其他製造類 NPC，也不能用於冒險者之間的交易。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Do you have more questions?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Enlarge Weight Limit, Push Cart, Vending. These three skills have close relationships.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
負重量上升、手推車和露天商店這三項技能彼此密切相關。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
First talking about ^4d4fffEnlarge Weight Limit^000000 skill, is the skill to increase th character's basic earned points. It is an automatic operational passive skill when you learn it.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
先說說^4d4fff負重量上升^000000。這個技能可以提高角色的負重上限，學會後會自動生效。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
This earned point skill reaching a certain level, you can use the skill called ^4d4fffPush Cart^000000
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
負重量上升達到一定等級後，就能使用^4d4fff手推車^000000技能。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
But this Push Cart skill has the disadvantage of the slowdown of moving speed, though the advantage of high loading capacity.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
手推車技能的缺點是會降低移動速度，不過好處是負重能力大幅提升。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
When this Push Cart skill reaches at a certain level, you can use the skill called ^4d4fffVending^000000. This is used to sell your own items to other players.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
手推車達到一定等級後，就能使用^4d4fff露天商店^000000技能，把自己的物品賣給其他玩家。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Besides these, is there any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
除此之外，還有什麼想問的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Item Appraisal skill is a supplementary skill rather than the essential one.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
物品鑑定屬於輔助技能，並非必學技能。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
If you learn this skill you can identify items without having to use a Magnifying Glass Item.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
學會這項技能後，不用放大鏡也能鑑定物品。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Besides these, is there any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
除此之外，還有什麼想問的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
I am very busy clearing an account book, so how about talking next time?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
我正忙著整理賬簿，下次再聊吧？

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
背包已滿，無法繼續任務。
整理好物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.......... Then

[Mayssel]
I see, Lu make it as you want.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我知道了，盧，隨你的意思吧。

scripts.text: Uh, hi...
scripts.translation: 呃，你好...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I am sorry...
Are you a student of Criatura Academy?
I didn't intend to ignore you.
He is also one of the students in this class.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
抱歉...
你是克里圖拉學院的學生吧？
我不是故意不理你的。
他也是這堂課的學生。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Hello {0}
I am Mayssel  the section chief of the Veins section of the Assassin Guild.
I came here to give you some information about the Thief class.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你好，{0}。
我是梅塞爾，刺客公會伯仁斯分部的主管。
我來向你介紹盜賊職業。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Do you want to know about the Thief class?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
想了解盜賊這個職業嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好啊，麻煩你了。

scripts.text: No, I won't be a Thief.
scripts.translation: 不用了，我不打算當盜賊。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you want it....
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你要是願意的話...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Well a thief is commonly thought of as a criminal.
But our guild is not about taking from those that are in need of it.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
人們通常覺得盜賊就是罪犯。
不過，我們公會不會去偷生活困難之人的東西。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
First, we should make it clear.
We don't steal other's belongings.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
首先得說清楚：
我們不偷別人的財物。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
How about monsters?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
那魔物呢？

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Now monsters...
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
至於魔物嘛...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Hey, take it easy.
You said it was a mission for something important. But only a place like this...
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
嘿，別激動。
你說是為了重要的任務才來的，可這裡卻只有這種地方...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I was upset...
Let me continue.
A Thief uses techniques that common thieves use to be fast and nimble.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我剛才有點激動...
讓我接著說。
盜賊擅長運用各種技巧，行動迅速又靈活。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
We use stealth to blend into our surroundings and strike our foes.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我們會隱匿身形、融入周圍環境，再伺機襲擊敵人。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Our primary weapon is a dagger and we compensate their attack strength by adding poison property to our attacks.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我們的主要武器是短劍，並會給攻擊附加毒屬性，以彌補攻擊力的不足。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
The higher class jobs in Thief class are Assassin and Rogue.
Verkhasel is a Guillotine Cross which is the third class of the Assassin Job.
and......
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
盜賊系的高階職業有刺客和流氓。
維爾卡塞爾是十字斬首者，也就是刺客系的三轉職業。
還有...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Mr. Vicente... I called Dumk..
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
維森特先生...我剛才叫的是鄧克...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah, that is... Mayssel..
As you know well about Master.
I can explain about Rogues to you.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
啊，這個嘛...梅塞爾...
你也知道師父的情況。
我來給你介紹一下流氓職業吧。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I see...
{0} Sorry but you can learn about the Shadow Chaser class from them.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我明白了...
{0}，抱歉，關於逐影獵人這個職業，你可以向他們請教。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Anyway, these two gentlemen will help you.
^4d4dffCome back to me after speaking to Verkhasel and Vicente.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
總之，這兩位先生會幫你。
^4d4dff和維爾卡塞爾、維森特談過之後，再回來找我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Have you learned something about Thief, Assassin and Rogue?
You don't need to understand everything right now.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
盜賊、刺客和流氓這幾種職業，你都瞭解了嗎？
現在不用什麼都弄明白。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I only play the role to inform you of there is this one that one...
The next course is how to use the experience guide... Let's skim it over.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我只是負責讓你知道還有這些職業...
下一堂課會教你怎麼使用技能體驗手冊，我們先大致看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
The guide for skill experience provided by the academy can be used up to level 12.
Regretfully, only the explanation is available for you.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
學院提供的技能體驗指南可以使用到12級。
遺憾的是，眼下只能給你講解。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you want to be a Thief, you just come back here.
I can help you with the 1st step of the job change.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
想成為盜賊的話，就回來找我。
我可以幫你辦理轉職的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
辛苦了，謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I only play the role to inform you of there is this one that one...
Then, let's talk about the Thief's skills.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我只是負責讓你知道還有這些職業...
接下來，我們來聊聊盜賊的技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I will give you the guide to borrow the thief's skill temporarily.
Organize the guide items, you can see the useful skills on the 'ETC' skill window.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我借你一本手冊，讓你暫時體驗盜賊技能。
裝備手冊後，就能在技能視窗的“雜項”標籤頁裡看到實用技能。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
By making use of the guide, you may take the missions being asked by Verkhasel and Vicente.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
使用這本手冊，就能接取維爾卡塞爾和維森特委託的任務。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Verkhasel and Vicente will give you various information related to the higher class jobs.
So, come back to me after listening to them.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
維爾卡塞爾和維森特會告訴你各種高階職業的相關知識。
聽完他們的介紹後，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Preparation for real battle is next.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
接下來要準備實戰了。

scripts.text: I see...
scripts.translation: 我明白了...

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不參加。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I will compensate for you when your mission is completed.
Come back to me after speaking to Verkhasel and Vicente.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
完成任務後，我會給你獎勵。
和維爾卡塞爾、維森特談過之後，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I see..
This course is now cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我明白了...
那這門課就取消了。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Have you learned something about Thief, Assassin and Rogue?
You don't need to understand everything right now.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
盜賊、刺客和流氓這幾種職業，你都瞭解了嗎？
現在不用什麼都弄明白。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I only play the role to inform you of there is this one that one...?
The next course is how to use the experience guide... Let's skim it over.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我只是負責向你介紹各種職業...？
下一堂課會教你怎麼使用技能體驗指南，我們先大致看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
The  guide for skill experience provided by the academy can be used up to level 12.
Regretfully, only the explanation is available for you.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
學院提供的技能體驗指南可以使用到12級。
遺憾的是，目前只能給你講解。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you want to be a Thief, you just come back here.
I can help you with the 1st step of the job change.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
想成為盜賊的話，就回來找我。
我可以幫你辦理轉職的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You've worked hard.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
辛苦了。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I only play the role to inform you of there is this one that one...
Then, let's talk about the Thief's skills.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我只是負責向你介紹各種職業...
接下來，我們來談談盜賊的技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I will give you the guide to borrow the thief's skill temporarily.
Organize the guide items, you can see the useful skills on the 'ETC' skill window.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我借你一本指南，讓你暫時體驗盜賊的技能。
裝備指南後，就能在技能視窗的“雜項”裡看到實用技能。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
By making use of the guide, you may take the missions being asked by Verkhasel and Vicente.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
利用這本指南，就能接取維爾卡塞爾和維森特委託的任務。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Have you got a sense what it is to be a Thief?
If you want to use the skill like double attack, visit ^4d4dffMr. Subino on the 1st floor^000000.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你有沒有體會到當盜賊是什麼感覺？
想體驗二刀連擊等技能的話，就去^4d4dff一樓找蘇比諾先生^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
<NAVI>[Battle Trainer Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI> will give you several battle missions.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
<NAVI>[戰鬥訓練師 蘇比諾]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>會給你安排幾項戰鬥任務。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I hope you experience other skills with battle Quests.
Double attack is somewhat an exciting skill.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
希望你通過戰鬥任務體驗其他技能。
二刀連擊可是個很刺激的技能。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Make a decision after you've at least experienced it.
You still have a long way and enough time before you make a decision... Think of it deeply.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
至少親自體驗之後再做決定吧。
離你做決定還早著呢，時間也充裕...好好想清楚。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you want to be a Thief, you just come back here.
I can help you with the 1st step of the job change.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
想成為盜賊的話，就回來找我。
我可以幫你辦理轉職的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Thank you for you hard work.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
辛苦了，謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
In the battle training, the actual fighting is more important than theory.
To use the skill once is better than all this talking.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
戰鬥訓練重在實戰，理論沒那麼重要。
親自用一次技能，勝過聽我說半天。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you carry out the mission asked by Verkhasel and Vicente, I will go to the next class.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
完成維爾卡塞爾和維森特委託的任務後，我就帶你上下一堂課。

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不參加。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I will compensate for you when your mission is complete.
Come back to me after listening to Verkhasel and Vicente.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
任務完成後，我會給你獎勵。
聽完維爾卡塞爾和維森特的介紹後，再回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I see.
This course is now cancelled.
The ongoing lower courses are cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我明白了。
這門課現在取消。
目前正在進行的初級課程也會一併取消。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes, cancel the course.
scripts.translation: 是，取消課程

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Fortunately...
Good to see you have patience.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
幸好...
很高興你願意耐心聽下去。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
All the ongoing courses are cancelled.
These are not your aptitude.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
所有正在進行的課程都已取消。
看來這些課程不適合你。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
What are you curious about?
If you want to know about battle, visit <NAVI>[Battle Trainer Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01_c,59,83</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你想了解什麼？
想了解戰鬥的話，就去找<NAVI>[戰鬥訓練師 蘇比諾]<INFO>iz_ac01_c,59,83</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: Change job to Thief.
scripts.translation: 轉職為盜賊

scripts.text: Thief Stat Explanation
scripts.translation: 盜賊屬性介紹

scripts.text: Thief Skill Explanation
scripts.translation: 盜賊技能介紹

scripts.text: Not curious about it.
scripts.translation: 沒興趣

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You made up your mind.
Welcome to the world of shadows.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你已經決定了。
歡迎來到暗影世界。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you are ready, I will send you to the deserts of Morocc to embrace the shadows.
The journey will be both strange and challenging.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
準備好後，我就送你去夢羅克沙漠，投入暗影的懷抱。
這段旅程既陌生又充滿挑戰。

scripts.text: At once please.
scripts.translation: 現在就出發

scripts.text: I need more time.
scripts.translation: 我還需要些時間

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Yes, after a sufficient survey of other jobs, you may make a decision.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
沒錯，多瞭解其他職業之後，再做決定也不遲。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffFind the Pyramid^000000 in the ^4d4dffNorthwest^000000 of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
前往摩洛克的^4d4dff西北方^000000尋找^4d4dff金字塔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I'm sorry but you are short of job levels to change your job.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
很抱歉，你的職業等級還不夠，暫時無法轉職。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Level composes of Base level and Job level.
Job level is what determines your current job.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
等級分為基礎等級和職業等級。
職業等級決定你當前的職業。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffThe 1st job condition condition is job level 10.^000000
You need more experience so fight more and level up first.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
^4d4dff一轉的條件是職業等級達到10級。^000000
你還需要積累經驗，先多打些魔物、提升等級吧。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You want to know more about stats?
As Vicente already told you, stats don't have a fixed answer.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
想多瞭解一些屬性嗎？
正如維森特說的，屬性配點沒有固定答案。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If I choose one among them,
^4d4dffAGI is related to flee ability^000000,
^4d4dffDex is related with hit ratio
STR raises physical attacking power^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
如果要挑一項的話，
^4d4dff敏捷（AGI）影響閃避能力^000000，
^4d4dff靈巧（DEX）影響命中率，
力量（STR）提高物理攻擊力^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Vit, Luk, Int are valued according your target chosen.
For your reference, Verkhasel has high level of Luk.
A weapon called Katar is good for Critical.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
體質、幸運和智力的作用，得看你選擇的發展方向。
比如，維爾卡塞爾的幸運就很高。
拳刃很適合打出暴擊。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
But thief's primary weapon is a dagger.
In the end, you have only to supplement your weak point, after evaluating you and your enemy.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
不過，盜賊主要使用短劍。
評估自己和敵人的情況後，想辦法彌補自己的弱點就行。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If your attack doesn't hit the enemy, you come to think of the hit ratio.
Hope you find the right stats that are suitable to your fighting style.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
攻擊打不中敵人時，就該考慮提高命中率了。
希望你能找到適合自己戰鬥風格的屬性配點。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Which skill are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你想了解哪個技能？

scripts.text: Improve Dodge
scripts.translation: 殘影

scripts.text: Double attack
scripts.translation: 二刀連擊

scripts.text: Hiding and Steal
scripts.translation: 隱匿和偷竊

scripts.text: Envenom and Detoxify
scripts.translation: 施毒和解毒

scripts.text: Not curious about it.
scripts.translation: 沒興趣

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
As the name implies, ^4d4dffthis skill increases a certain amount of evasion ratio^000000
You want to avoid taking damage from enemy attack, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
顧名思義，^4d4dff這個技能可以提高一定的閃避率^000000。
你也想避開敵人的攻擊吧？

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffThis skill allows you to deal two damages with only one attack.^000000
Even though this dagger looks poor, it can damage your enemy severely by the fast two attacks.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
^4d4dff這個技能能讓你一次攻擊造成兩次傷害。^000000
這把短劍雖然不起眼，但迅速的連擊能讓敵人傷得不輕。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffHiding means exactly that... to hide.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
^4d4dff隱匿，顧名思義，就是把自己藏起來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffSteal is the skill of stealing enemy's items^000000.
You can steal one item from one enemy.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
^4d4dff偷竊就是從敵人身上竊取物品的技能^000000。
每個敵人身上只能偷到一件物品。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffEnvenom is used to poison your enemy.^000000
If poisoned, it can make a physical attacks slowly eat away at your foe.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
^4d4dff施毒可以讓敵人中毒。^000000
敵人中毒後，生命值會逐漸減少。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Oppositely, the name implies, Detoxify removes poison status.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
反過來說，解毒顧名思義就是解除中毒狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
It is good you have enough knowledge.
Supplementary the field experiences will make you perfect.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你已經掌握了不少理論知識。
再加上實戰經驗，就能熟能生巧。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Is that so?
Like other job guilds, there is a limit learned through theory.
I would like to recommend you to experience battle first-hand.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
是嗎？
和其他職業公會一樣，光靠理論能學到的東西有限。
我建議你先親自體驗戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You are a stranger.
Excuse me but I was invited to explain about the jobs for the students,
I have no words to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你是位陌生人。
抱歉，我受邀來為學員介紹職業，
沒什麼能告訴你的。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
It is almost miracle to meet you and me living far away from the light of ground.
We should abide by the regulations.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
能在遠離地面的地下世界相遇，簡直是奇蹟。
我們還是得遵守規定。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Attending the class, first you may be a student of Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
想參加課程，首先得是克里圖拉學院的學生。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
However, if you want the information about the thief job itself, I will let you know.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
不過，如果你想了解盜賊職業本身，我可以給你介紹。

scripts.text: About the useful stats for a Thief
scripts.translation: 盜賊適合哪些屬性

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
After you register as a student, you can take lessons and gain more experience.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
註冊成為學員後，就能參加課程、積累更多經驗。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You are on the way of thief.
Thief is the 1st job.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你正走在成為盜賊的路上。
盜賊是一轉職業。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Someday, you would transfer to the 2nd job.
It would be better to think of whether becoming  a Log or an Assassin now.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
總有一天你會轉職為二轉職業。
現在就可以想想要成為流氓還是刺客。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You don't look familiar.
In order to attend this class, you must first become a student of Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
我看你面生。
想上這門課，得先成為克里圖拉學院的學員。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
What information would you like to know about the Thief job?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你想了解盜賊職業的哪方面？

scripts.text: About the useful stats for a Thief
scripts.translation: 盜賊適合哪些屬性

scripts.text: About Thief's primary skills

[Mayssel]
^4d4dffEnvenom is used to poison your enemy.^000000
If poisoned, it can make a physical attacks slowly eat away at your foe.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
^4d4dff施毒可以讓敵人中毒。^000000
敵人中毒後，生命值會逐漸減少。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Oppositely, the name implies, Detoxify removes poison status.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
反過來說，解毒顧名思義就是解除中毒狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
It is good you have enough knwledge.
Supplementary the field experiences will make you perfect.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
你已經掌握了不少理論知識。
再加上實戰經驗，就能熟能生巧。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
After you register as a student, you can take lessons and gain more experience.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
註冊成為學員後，就能參加課程、積累更多經驗。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Are you curious about the thief job?
Mayssel will give you the details about it.
But, you must be a student of Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
想了解盜賊職業嗎？
梅塞爾會詳細介紹。
不過，你得先成為克里圖拉學院的學員。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmm. Thief.... Then, I need to explain to you about stats, too.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
嗯，盜賊啊...那我也得給你講講屬性。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
First, ^4d4dffStr power, Agi agility, Dex hit,^000000 these theree elements are all good for a Thief.
Supplementary elements are Int intelligence, Vit vitality, Luk luck.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
首先，^4d4dff力量提升攻擊力，敏捷提高閃避，靈巧提高命中，^000000這些屬性都適合盜賊。
其他可考慮的屬性還有智力、體質和幸運。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
As ^4d4dffStr raises the physical attacking power, it will be your tool to raises your attacking power against a Thief and Rogue who primarily use daggers^000000.
And, I will raise your limit of carrying items, which means you can load more items.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
^4d4dff力量（STR）會提高物理攻擊力，盜賊和流氓主要使用短劍，因此也能借此提升攻擊力。^000000
力量還會提高負重上限，讓你能攜帶更多物品。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
^4d4dffAgi is to raise your evasion ratio and Aspd attacking speed.^000000 Simply speaking, you become nimble.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
^4d4dff敏捷（AGI）可以提高閃避率和攻擊速度。^000000簡單來說，就是讓你行動更靈活。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Agi is one of the very important figures as you- a thief wearing a light armor have to evade the enemy's attack rather than facing it head on.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
敏捷對盜賊來說非常重要。盜賊穿著輕甲，得靠閃避敵人的攻擊，而不是正面硬扛。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
And ^4d4dffDex to hit your attack^000000 is unforgettable.
You can do anything once your attack succeeds.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
^4d4dff靈巧（DEX）決定攻擊命中率^000000，這一點可別忘了。
攻擊只要命中，後續就好辦了。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
In addition, there are those who are fighting in the War of Emperium with ^4d4dffthe raised VIT energy level to increase their HP vitality^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
此外，有些人在攻城戰中會提高^4d4dff體質（VIT），增加生命值上限^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Among the Rogue skills, there is a skill called 'Intimidate' with which you can learn and use other's skills,
there are some who^4d4dffinvest to Intelligence to use the learned magic from this spell^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
流氓有一項名為“抄襲”的技能，可以學會並使用他人的技能。
有些人會^4d4dff提升智力（INT），以施展通過這項技能學來的魔法^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
We I can tell which one is the right choice.
According to the individual tastes and purposes, you have to split your ability.
But...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
我沒法告訴你哪種配點才是正確答案。
你得根據個人喜好和目標分配屬性。
不過...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Rogues are for ^4d4dffdisarming the enemy's armor^000000 or ^4d4dffstealing better than a thief^000000.
or ^4d4dfffall back after suddenly being attacked^000000
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
流氓可以^4d4dff卸除敵人的護甲^000000，或^4d4dff比盜賊更擅長偷竊^000000，
也可以^4d4dff在遭到突襲後迅速撤退^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmhmmm. It may look cowardish but it is upgraded from a thief.
As it can have a better eyesight and do the art.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
嗯...看起來或許有些怯懦，但流氓是盜賊的進階職業，
視野更好，也能施展獨門技巧。

scripts.text: Haaaaam...
Is that so?
scripts.translation: 是這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
.........you were boring.
Among the thief's skills, there is an item called 'Improve Dodge'.
The stats related to evasion ratio is..
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
...你可真無趣。
盜賊有個技能叫“殘影”，
那麼，影響閃避率的屬性是...

scripts.text: Dex !!
scripts.translation: 靈巧！！

scripts.text: Agi !!
scripts.translation: 敏捷！！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Don't mess around with me too much.
It's Agi.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
別逗我了。
是敏捷。

scripts.text: Ah, yes...

[Lumin]
Compensation is?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
那我的補償呢？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ahhh, yes...
I will give a gift for Lumin.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
啊，對...
我會送盧敏一份禮物。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Now I will finish my class.
Important thing is not theory like what we are talking about.
Actual fighting!! Actual fighting is key!!
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
我的課就講到這裡。
重要的不是剛才那些理論，
而是實戰！！實戰才是關鍵！！

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh, fortunately you have been in the class.
I didn't feel easy as your face look very boring.
Now, shall we keep going on?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哦，幸好你有來上課。
看你一臉無聊，我還真有點過意不去。
我們繼續吧？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
...... Compensation is?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
...那我的補償呢？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah,,, thank you for your pointout.
Be successful!
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
啊...多謝提醒。
祝你一切順利！

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Important thing is not theory but actual fighting.
Do you agree?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
重要的不是理論，而是實戰。
你也這麼認為吧？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Talking about Rogue,
It is not a cowardish job as the others complain.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
說到流氓，
他們可不像別人說的那麼膽小。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.....Don't you have a strange hobby?
Taking off other's clothings.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
...你的興趣可真奇怪。
居然喜歡脫別人的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
What.. What a thing to say!
Lu, you shouldn't say such things!
Rogue is the upper level to a thief.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
什...你在說什麼呢！
盧，別說這種話！
流氓可是盜賊的進階職業。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Eummm. I won't be a Log.
How about you?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
嗯...我才不要當流氓呢。
你呢？

scripts.text: Eh? Me? I don't want to be.
scripts.translation: 咦？我？我才不想當。

scripts.text: Me.. I like... Rogue...
scripts.translation: 我...我喜歡...流氓...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Ok. Then you take the bloody way with me.
Becoming a shadow in the dark....
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
好吧，那就和我一起走上血腥之路吧。
化作黑暗中的影子...

scripts.text: I don't want to be a thief.
scripts.translation: 我不想當盜賊。

scripts.text: .... I'm scared!
scripts.translation: ...我害怕！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
... a headache.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
...真頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hahahaha.  Stop talking about the scary story.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哈哈哈，別再講恐怖故事了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.. Hng..

[Lumin]
Is that so?
It is an astonishing fighting skill to make the enemy disarmed and disabled.
I thumb up the skill.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
是嗎？
能卸除敵人的武裝、讓他們失去戰鬥能力，真是了不起的技巧。
我給這招點個贊。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Will you say a different story from what you told before?
Haha.. To me, Master is good enough, doing the same thing to me.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你要說的和之前不一樣嗎？
哈哈...只要師父也對我做同樣的事，我就滿足了。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Keung....
I am losing my excitement.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
咳...
我都沒興致了。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
If you wish to continue along the path of the Thief, speak to Mayssel.
Her information should be helpful.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
想繼續走盜賊這條路，就去找梅塞爾談談。
她會告訴你不少有用的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmm. It is about the thief's skill using the manual.
By the way, this manual is only available for experience up to level 12.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
嗯，這是關於如何使用盜賊技能手冊的說明。
順便說一下，這本手冊只能讓你體驗到12級的技能。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
The actual exercise of ^4d4dffstealing from monster's items^000000 skill was planned but
you may need to know what it is... No need to do the actual exercise.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
原本還安排了^4d4dff從魔物身上偷取物品^000000的實戰練習，
不過你只要先了解一下就行，不必真的練習。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I will regard my course as completed.
By the way, what is stealing all about?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
我的課程就算結束了。
對了，偷竊到底是怎麼回事？

scripts.text: Stealing other's items!
scripts.translation: 偷別人的物品！

scripts.text: Stealing monster's items!
scripts.translation: 偷魔物的物品！

scripts.text: Stealing other's enemy!
scripts.translation: 偷別人的敵人！

scripts.text: Don't know.
scripts.translation: 不知道

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Wrong! That would be a terrible thing to do.
You can't go around stealing people's things.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
答錯了！那樣做可就太過分了。
不能到處偷別人的東西。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Correct!
You have a good memory.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
答對了！
記性不錯。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You like doing that?
That is a terrible thing to do.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你喜歡這麼做嗎？
那可是很糟糕的行為。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Yes, we steal monster items.
the higher your skill level and the higher your hit ratio is, the success ratio also becomes higher.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
沒錯，我們偷的是魔物身上的物品。
技能等級和命中率越高，成功率也越高。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Anyway, here I will finish my class.
If you want to continue, there is no way as your level is too high.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
總之，這堂課就到這裡。
你的等級太高，沒法繼續這項課程了。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh, excellent!
Keep the stone as a souvenir.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哦，太好了！
這塊石頭就留作紀念吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Anyway, you seem to be skilled enough to continue.
Go speak to Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
總之，你已經學得夠多，可以繼續了。
去找梅塞爾談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmm. It is about the thief's skill using the manual.
By the way, this manual is only available for experience up to level 12.
scripts.translation:

嗯，這是關於如何使用盜賊技能手冊的說明。
順便說一下，這本手冊只能讓你體驗到12級的技能。

不過你只要先了解一下就行，不必真的練習。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
I will regard my course as completed.
By the way, what is stealing all about?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
我的課程就算結束了。
對了，偷竊究竟是怎麼回事？

scripts.text: Stealing other's items!
scripts.translation: 偷別人的物品！

scripts.text: Stealing monster's items!
scripts.translation: 偷魔物的物品！

scripts.text: Stealing other's enemy!
scripts.translation: 偷別人的敵人！

scripts.text: Don't know.
scripts.translation: 不知道

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Wrong! That would be a terrible thing to do.
You can't go around stealing people's things.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
答錯了！那樣做可就太過分了。
不能到處偷別人的東西。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Correct!
You have a good memory.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
答對了！
記性不錯。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You like doing that?
That is a terrible thing to do.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你喜歡這麼做嗎？
那可是很糟糕的行為。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Yes, we steal monster items.
the higher your skill level and the higher your hit ratio is, the success ratio also becomes higher.
scripts.translation:
