沒錯，我們偷的是魔物身上的物品。
技能等級和命中率越高，成功率也越高。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Anyway, here I will finish my class.
If you want to continue, there is no way as your level is too high.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
總之，這堂課就到這裡。
你的等級太高，沒法繼續這項課程了。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmm. What?
You are talking about the use of thief skills by using the manual?
First, equip the Thief Manual.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
嗯？什麼？
你是想問怎麼用手冊體驗盜賊技能嗎？
先裝備盜賊入門手冊。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You can either double click ^4d4dffthe items to be equipped^000000 or drag it to the equipment window.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你可以雙擊^4d4dff要裝備的物品^000000，也可以把它拖進裝備視窗。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Then, open the skill window, you can find the added skills in the 'Misc' tab.
You can even set the skills in the shortcut bar.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
接著開啟技能視窗，在“雜項”標籤頁裡就能找到新增技能。
還可以把技能設到快捷欄上。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Now, out of them, there is a skill called ^4d4dffSteal^000000.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
其中有個技能叫作^4d4dff偷竊^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Here is an assignment.
Can you see the ornamental Poring cage?
Steal ^4d4dffone Stone from Poring by using the Steal skill.^000000
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
這是個小任務。
看到裝飾用的波利籠了嗎？
用偷竊技能從波利身上偷一塊^4d4dff石頭^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Steal has a possibility to fail so don't quit.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
偷竊有可能失敗，別輕易放棄。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh, excellent!
Keep the stone as a souvenir.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哦，太好了！
這塊石頭就留作紀念吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Anyway, it is good enough for your skill experience purpose, let's finish the class here.
If you haven't finished Mr. Verkhasel's assignment, keep going with it.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
總之，已經足夠讓你體驗這項技能了，這堂課就到這裡。
還沒完成維爾卡塞爾委託的話，就繼續去完成吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Steal one Stone from a Poring.
Wasn't it fun?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
從波利身上偷一塊石頭。
挺有意思吧？

scripts.text: It didn't give me a stone.
scripts.translation: 沒偷到石頭

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不參加

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmm? All porings were stolen of their stones?
I will summon Porings again, and you, try it once again.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
嗯？波利身上的石頭都被偷光了嗎？
我再召喚幾隻波利，你再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmm. Is that so?
This is not your aptitude.
I see. This mission is now cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
嗯，是嗎？
看來這項任務不適合你。
好吧，那就取消吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ahhh. Boring, Boring...
Now I can understand why Master ran away.
I want to go home.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
啊...無聊死了...
現在我總算明白師父為什麼逃跑了。
我想回家。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
So do I.
Mayssel... what did she think of...
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
我也是。
梅塞爾...她到底在想什麼...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Hmmm. Did she go AWOL?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
嗯...她擅離職守了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Are you kidding me?!
Would you rather be carrying out a fatal mission!?!
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你在開玩笑嗎？！
難道你寧願去執行送命的任務嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah... I don't like it.
I would rather evaluate jewelry sitting at the workshop as usual...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
啊...我不太喜歡這樣。
我還是更願意像平時那樣，坐在工作室裡鑑定珠寶...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
.... .. ..
I will accept Verkhassel's wish.
Don't worry hohoho...
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
...
我會答應維爾卡塞爾的請求。
別擔心，呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
The mood is becoming gloomy.
Should I get out of here?
scripts.translation:
氣氛越來越陰沉了。
我該離開這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You are doing well.
I hope to see you again someday.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你做得不錯。
希望以後還能再見到你。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah, for your reference, I am operating a small workshop in Lighthalzen.
Visit me there someday.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
對了，我在裡希塔樂鎮經營著一家小工作室。
有空來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Perhaps, I won't forget you...
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
也許我不會忘記你...
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You are not a student of Criatura Academy.
If you want more explanation about this job, you better register as a student of the Academy.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
你還不是克里圖拉學院的學員。
想進一步瞭解這個職業的話，最好先去學院登記。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Though only novices can register...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
不過，只有初心者才能登記...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh, you became a good thief.
Don't you want to be a shadow chaser in your future?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哦，你已經是個出色的盜賊了。
以後想不想成為逐影獵人？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
This is the higher class applied by the elite Rogues of good artistry.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
這是隻有技藝高超的精英流氓才能轉職的高階職業。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Above job level 40, any Thief can be transferred to a Rogue anytime.
Fortunately, the sailing service from Izlude wharf to Pharos lighthouse is available!!
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
職業等級達到40級後，盜賊隨時都能轉職為流氓。
而且，從依斯魯得島碼頭前往發樂斯燈塔島的航線也開通了！！

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
First, is it courteous to ask whether you can be a Rogue or not?
If it is an application for an Assassin, what happens to you?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你先問問自己能不能當流氓，這樣才算有禮貌吧？
那你要是申請成為刺客呢？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Haha. You like a bloody job?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哈哈，你喜歡血腥的職業嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Haha... Calm down...
Don't respond to every tiny matter..
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哈哈...冷靜點...
別為一點小事就反應過度...

scripts.text: The atmosphere became very tense.
scripts.translation: 氣氛頓時變得緊張起來。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Welcome to the Criatura Academy.
Here, I am teaching the basics to the people wishing to be a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
歡迎來到克里圖拉學院。
我在這裡教想成為盜賊的學員基礎知識。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
So, in other words, I am handling the Novices wanting to be thieves.
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
也就是說，我負責指導想成為盜賊的初心者。
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
What? It interrupts me.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
什麼？你打斷我說話？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Eheee, Eheee, It can't be a joke.
Mayssel's class...
Did you call upon me for this kind of nasty thing?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
呃...這可不是開玩笑。
梅塞爾的課...
你叫我來處理這種麻煩事？

scripts.text: ...Let's keep working?
scripts.translation: ...我們繼續？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
It's a pity. That man is scary.
But as long as I am with you, don't be afraid of him.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
真可惜，那個男人看起來好可怕。
不過有我陪著你，別怕。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
What are you talking about this time?
In the beginning, Lue.. You should not be here...
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你這次又在說什麼？
首先，盧敏...你本來就不該在這裡...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.........Who am I?
Assistant.... Trainer?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
...我是誰？
助理...訓練師？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Zt...
Well, which one are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
嘖...
好吧，你想了解什麼？

scripts.text: Double Attack
scripts.translation: 二刀連擊

scripts.text: Envenom
scripts.translation: 施毒

scripts.text: Improve Dodge and Hide
scripts.translation: 殘影和躲藏

scripts.text: About you
scripts.translation: 關於你

scripts.text: That's enough.
scripts.translation: 夠了

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You  may already know the primary weapon of a Thief is a dagger.
A Thief's specialty is the ^4d4dffDouble Attack^000000 by a dagger.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你應該知道，盜賊的主要武器是短劍。
盜賊擅長用短劍施展^4d4dff二刀連擊^000000。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
If you are short of attacking power, it can be covered at a certain degree.
Any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
攻擊力不足時，可以靠這招在一定程度上彌補。
還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
There is a skill called ^4d4dffEnvenom^000000 to intoxicate your enemy with poison and
the other skill called ^4d4dffDetoxify^000000 to remove the poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
^4d4dff施毒^000000可以讓敵人中毒，
而^4d4dff解毒^000000可以解除中毒狀態。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You can tell the poisoned status by its very pretty purple color.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
中毒時，身上會呈現很顯眼的紫色。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
In case, you are poisoned, venom will decrease your vitality rapidly,
you either detoxify right away or take the antidote potion.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
中毒後，毒素會迅速削弱你的體力。
記得立刻解毒，或者服用解毒劑。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
If you have more interest in poison, you may be an assassin.
They officially use poison.
Then next!
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
如果你對毒很感興趣，也許適合成為刺客。
刺客會正式使用毒藥。
接下來！

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Thiefs train the skill called ^4d4dffImprove Dodge^000000.
This makes the enemy powerless by evading its attack.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
盜賊會學習^4d4dff殘影^000000，
靠閃避敵人的攻擊讓對方無計可施。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Rather than being patient after being hit, it is more suitable for a less defensive thief to avoid from it fast.
Being this reason, agility [AGI] can't be neglected.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
防禦較弱的盜賊，與其捱打硬撐，不如迅速躲開攻擊。
因此，敏捷（AGI）不容忽視。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
^4d4dffHiding^000000 is the skill for refuge.
If successful, others can't see you.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
^4d4dff隱匿^000000是藏身的技能。
成功發動後，別人就看不到你。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Ah, as it is said you can't cheat a ghost.... You would be found by evil.
Also sensitive insects recognize it...
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
俗話說，幽靈可騙不了...邪惡的魔物仍會發現你。
有些感知敏銳的昆蟲也能看穿隱匿...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Other than these, it will be useful for avoiding emergency situations.
When you become higher jobs like Rogue or Assassin, you can learn more useful skills like Refuge.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
除此之外，隱匿也能幫你躲過緊急狀況。
轉職為流氓或刺客後，還能學到更多實用技能，例如藏身術。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Me? I am a chief of the Guillotine Cross.
......
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
我？我是十字斬首者的首領。
...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
As one of the assassins, I am in charge of punishing the law violators, as the member of the execution group.
For your reference, the primary weapon of Verkhasel is Katar.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
作為刺客，我是行刑小組的一員，負責懲治違法者。
順便告訴你，維爾卡塞爾主要使用拳刃。

scripts.text: How do you know that?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼知道的？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
That's my hope.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
我也是這麼希望的。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Oh.. Smart funk~~
That's enough, Lu.
Any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
哦...挺機靈嘛～～
好了，盧。
還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You can steal one item from one enemy.
I feel mortified at stopping here, but it's worse to be neglected...
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你可以從每個敵人身上偷一件物品。
我也不想就這麼停下來，但被你晾在一邊更難受...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
OK.
Considering your favor not to ignore me, let's finish it now.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
好吧。
看在你沒有無視我的份上，我們現在就結束這堂課。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Honestly, I don't think you need to know the details about the thief's skills.
Then, just be aware there is something like that..
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
老實說，盜賊技能沒必要了解得那麼詳細。
知道有這些技能就夠了...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
I mean it is good enough now.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
我的意思是，現在這樣就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Anything else you're curious about?
I will give you an answer after you finish Mayssel's class.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
還有什麼想問的嗎？
等你上完梅塞爾的課，我再回答你。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
I mean that she knows it.
Mayssel will do it for you.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
我的意思是，她知道該怎麼做。
梅塞爾會幫你的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Lazy boy.
Tell me the truth... You are annoying..
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
懶鬼。
說實話...你真煩人...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
.......You........
Zt.. I don't know the enemy..
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
...你...
嘖...我也不知道敵人在哪兒...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Actual experience assignments about the skill?
To do it, your level is too high.
I can't use the guide.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
想做技能實戰任務嗎？
不過你的等級太高了，我沒法使用手冊安排任務。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Originally, I will let you hunt porings with envenom.
No way, if I can't use the skill....
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
本來想讓你用施毒來獵殺波利。
可我沒法使用技能，就沒辦法了...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Envenom is the skill to poison.
If not poison him, you can damage to him due to the characteristic of venom.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
施毒可以讓敵人中毒。
即使沒能讓敵人中毒，毒性本身也會造成傷害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Keep in mind of these. That might be good enough for you.
As it is the class to let you know what you can do.
Let's finish the skill experience.
Check with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
記住這些就夠了。這堂課只是讓你瞭解自己能做什麼。
技能體驗就到這裡吧，去找梅塞爾確認一下。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are doing well.
Envenom has the poison effect and can damage from venom itself.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
做得不錯。
施毒能讓敵人中毒，毒性本身也會造成傷害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
The skill experience is now enough.
Check it with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
技能體驗到這裡就夠了。
去找梅塞爾確認一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You can't equip the Thief Manual?
Your level is too high.
There is no other way.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
盜賊入門手冊也裝備不了嗎？
你的等級太高了。
沒別的辦法了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Envenom is the skill to poison.
If not poison him, you can damage to him due to the characteristic of venom.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
施毒可以讓敵人中毒。
即使沒能讓敵人中毒，毒性本身也會造成傷害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Keep in mind of these. That might be good enough for you.
As it is the class to let you know what you can do.
Let's finish the skill experience.
Check with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
記住這些就夠了。這堂課只是讓你瞭解自己能做什麼。
技能體驗就到這裡吧，去找梅塞爾確認一下。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
This is about the use of skill.
Now if you were an assassin, shall I let you test the skills related to venom which you may continue to use?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
這是在介紹技能的用法。
如果你是刺客，我倒可以讓你體驗還能繼續使用的毒系技能。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Load the thief guide receved by Mayssel and open the skill window by pressing Alt+S key,
Register Envenom regisstered on the ETC compartment,  by pressing shortcut key^000000
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
裝備梅塞爾給你的盜賊手冊，按 Alt + S 開啟技能視窗。
在“雜項”欄找到施毒，將它設到快捷欄上。^000000

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Then, approach the Poring's cage in the center of this room and
Aim at Poring, and ^4d4dff' hunt one poring by using
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
然後走到房間中央的波利籠子旁，
瞄準波利，^4d4dff用施毒獵殺一隻波利

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
That's my assignment to you.
You definitely use envenom to Poring in this room.
don't go out faraway to find Porings.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
這就是交給你的任務。
必須在這個房間裡對波利使用施毒。
別跑到外面找波利。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Eummm.
It's sad..
Please accept my condolence in advance, as you can't experience envenom... hehehe...
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
嗯...
真可惜...
你沒法體驗施毒，我先提前向你表示哀悼...呵呵呵...

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
From now, I am going to hunt Poring..
...Don't misunderstand me for challenging you, as such I  want to make a bet with you.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
從現在起，我要去獵殺波利...
別誤會，我不是要挑戰你，只是想和你打個賭。

scripts.text: Lumin is betting win or loose.
scripts.translation: 盧敏正在下注，賭輸贏。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are doing well.
Envenom has the poison effect and can damage from venom itself.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
做得不錯。
施毒能讓敵人中毒，毒性本身也會造成傷害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
The skill experience is now enough.
Check it with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
技能體驗到這裡就夠了。
去找梅塞爾確認一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Come close to a poring cage and use envenom to poring.
You must do it only to porings in this room.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
走到波利籠子旁，對波利使用施毒。
只能對這個房間裡的波利使用。

scripts.text: I see..
scripts.translation: 我明白了...

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
OK. Until you kill all the porings in the cage, attack them with venom.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
用施毒攻擊波利，直到籠子裡的波利全被消滅為止。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
These are not your aptitude.
I will cancel my assignment, and the other assignments from Mayssel to be cancelled by her.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
看來這項任務不適合你。
我會取消自己的任務，梅塞爾也會取消她安排的其他任務。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: I will continue..
scripts.translation: 我會繼續...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Cancel the mission to hunt poring with envenom.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
取消用施毒獵殺波利的任務。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Have you changed your mind?
Then, until you kill all the poring in the cage, keep attacking them with envenom.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
改變主意了？
那就繼續用施毒攻擊籠子裡的波利，直到它們全被消滅為止。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Now you fully understand what skill venom is..
As you completed my assignment, go and check it with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
現在你應該完全明白施毒這個技能了...
既然完成了我的任務，就去找梅塞爾確認一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are the bung finished Mayssel's class complete.
Any more questions, ask Mayssel.
It is the end of my class.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你總算上完梅塞爾的課了。
還有問題就去問她。
我的課也到此結束。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
If you become a thief, we may meet together in far future..
If you become an assassin.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
如果你成為盜賊，也許很久以後我們還會再見...
如果你成為刺客，那就...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
There is no words to tell you guy not belonging to our academy.
In fact, I pulled out here unwillingly, I don't have mind to be kind of you...
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
不屬於本學院的人，我沒什麼好說的。
說實話，我是不情願被叫來的，沒心情對你們客氣...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Wait, Verkhasel.....
Don't get even with other innocent....
How about helping my class for me?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
等等，維爾卡塞爾...
別拿無辜的人出氣...
不如幫我代一下課？

scripts.text: ... everyone seems tense..
scripts.translation: ...大家好像都很緊張...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Yo~ You...
What do you want to be?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
喂～你...
想當什麼？

scripts.text: An Assassin!
scripts.translation: 刺客！

scripts.text: A Rogue!
scripts.translation: 流氓！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Welcome to your joining in the way of bloody darness.
My comrad.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
歡迎你加入這條血腥的黑暗之路。
我的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
..............
(Verkhasel glancing at sky)
...
... Ha...!
The mood is becoming strange.
scripts.translation: 氣氛變得有些詭異。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Go over there.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
過去吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh... Mr. Verkhasel...
Don't play like this among a family.
Why are you dividing us into teams?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哦...維爾卡塞爾先生...
我們同屬一個公會，別這樣嘛。
為什麼還要把我們分成兩隊？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
I've never been in your family.
Originally, you are not a Rogue.
You were only a merchant.
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
我可從來沒加入過你們那一夥。
再說，你本來就不是流氓，
你以前只是個商人。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh.. No.. What a dirty word.
Have I asked you for buying something from me?
scripts.translation:
[維森特]
哦...別說得那麼難聽。
我有求你買過我什麼東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
..........You look friendly.. Two of you...
scripts.translation:
[梅塞爾]
...你們兩個看起來關係真好...

scripts.text: The mood has become tense.
scripts.translation: 氣氛變得緊張起來。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are the guy knows everything you need.
Are you coming to watch only? Emmm?
Why don't you help the juniors without watch only?
scripts.translation:
[維爾卡塞爾]
你不是自稱什麼都懂嗎？
你打算只在旁邊看著？嗯？
何不幫幫後輩，別光看熱鬧？

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
背包已滿，無法繼續任務。
整理好物品後再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Your eagerness and efforst to complete mission moved me to offer something.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
你完成任務時的熱情和努力打動了我，我想給你點東西。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
^4d4dff It is to hunt all 4 Porings here within 30 seconds^000000.
If you do, I will yield to you all the earned item in my hand.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
^4d4dff在30秒內獵殺這裡的4只波利^000000。
做到了的話，我就把手裡的戰利品全給你。

scripts.text: If I fail?
scripts.translation: 如果我失敗了呢？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
It is our bet. You have to give up yours as you lost.
Emmm. As I am generous, I will receive ^4d4dff10 beginner's red potions^000000.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
這是我們打的賭。你輸了，就得交出賭注。
嗯，我很大方，就收你^4d4dff10瓶初心者紅色藥水^000000吧。

scripts.text: Give Up.
scripts.translation: 我認輸

scripts.text: I Accept.
scripts.translation: 我接受

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.... Eh...
Coward!
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
...呃...
膽小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.... Good!
Now, ^4d4dffspeak to me once you finish hunting 4 porings in 30 seconds.^000000
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
...很好！
現在，^4d4dff在30秒內獵殺4只波利，完成後再來找我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
The intoxicated enemies won't die only from poisoning.
They only come close to death.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
中毒不會直接殺死敵人，
只會讓它們瀕臨死亡。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.. Why do Porings turn their back?
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
...波利為什麼都背對著我？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
... 30 seconds have passed and you have not yet hunted 4 porings.
Then, it is not interesting.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
...30秒過去了，你還沒獵殺完4只波利。
這樣就沒意思了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
If you don't like do it... no way.
As I am generous, I disregard the bet this time.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
不想做就算了...沒辦法。
我大方一點，這次就不計較賭注了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
You may be too busy in^4d4dff hunting 4 porings in 30 seconds.^000000
Hey, time passes now...
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
你可能正忙著^4d4dff在30秒內獵殺4只波利。^000000
喂，時間可在流逝呢...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Oh... You are very powerful!
Now then, as agreed I will give you everything I have.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
哇...你真厲害！
那麼，按照約定，我把剛才得到的戰利品都給你。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I've had a lot of fun because of you!
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
和你一起玩得真開心！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Regretfully, 30 seconds has passed.
.....
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
真可惜，30秒已經過去了。
...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I will give them to you anyways.
Come on, take it.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
不管怎樣，我還是把東西給你。
來，拿著吧。

scripts.text: Why are you treating me like this?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼要這樣對我？

scripts.text: Didn't I loose?
scripts.translation: 我不是輸了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
You spent time with me.
Get it free. I stole them from Porings.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
你陪我一起度過了這段時光。
這個送給你，不收錢，是我從波利身上偷來的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
We may meet again.
Becoming familiar with others is pleasrue and sad.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
我們以後或許還會再見。
和別人熟悉起來，既令人開心，也難免傷感。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
... It may be in trouble if it dies upfront...
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
...要是它先死了，事情可能會變麻煩...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
At last, the day comes.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
終於等到這一天了。

scripts.text: Lumin changing clothes piece by piece.
scripts.translation: 盧敏開始一件件脫下衣服。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I was carrying out my mission.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
我剛才是在執行任務。

scripts.text: No need to make an excuse....
scripts.translation: 不用找藉口了...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
At least to you, I don't want to be a stranger.
Forget what you saw today, as I have to introduce to the way of Thief Guild as many people as possible.
scripts.translation:
[盧敏]
至少，我不想和你變成陌生人。
忘了今天看到的事吧。我還得儘可能多地向大家介紹盜賊公會的規矩。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Did you ^ff0000register with the Criatura Academy^000000?
You can register at ^ff0000information center of Criatura Academy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
你在^ff0000克里圖拉學院登記^000000了嗎？
可以去^ff0000克里圖拉學院的資訊中心^000000辦理登記。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
It is annoying... but you need to register so you can receive ^ff0000lots of education and service of Criatura Academy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
雖然手續有點麻煩...但登記後才能享受^ff0000克里圖拉學院提供的各項教育和服務^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
oh Odin!
Nice to meet you.
I am Alice Yisha ^ff0000in charge of Acolytes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
哦，奧丁！
很高興見到你。
我是愛麗絲·伊莎，^ff0000負責服事課程^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Welcome~
Glad to meet you again.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
歡迎～
很高興再次見到你。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
If you did not select Acolyte as a job, why don't you study more about it?
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
如果你還沒選服事，何不多瞭解一下這個職業？

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
I guess you do not need my help any more.
Do you have any questions about Acolytes?
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
看來你已經不需要我的幫助了。
關於服事還有什麼想問的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
An acolyte serves ^ff0000Odin^000000 so it can use ^ff0000Holy skills^000000 according to the will of Odin.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
服事侍奉^ff0000奧丁^000000，能遵循奧丁的旨意施展^ff0000神聖系技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Most skills are based on ^ff0000the purpose of treatment or aid^000000 so it is a very important job for ^ff0000party hunting^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
大多數技能都用於^ff0000治療或輔助^000000，因此服事在^ff0000組隊狩獵^000000中非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
It is a ^ff0000hybrid job^000000 which can change ^ff0000attack type^000000 depends on increased status, but the range of weapon is narrow because they don't use fatal killing weapons for religious reason.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
服事是^ff0000混合型職業^000000，所加屬性不同，^ff0000攻擊方式^000000也會改變。
但受宗教戒律影響，他們不使用致命武器，可選武器種類較少。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
An acolyte is categorized as ^ff0000support type^000000 and ^ff0000physical attack type^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
服事分為^ff0000輔助型^000000和^ff0000物理攻擊型^000000。

scripts.text: Support type
scripts.translation: 輔助型

scripts.text: Attack type
scripts.translation: 攻擊型

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000INT^000000 is important status for ^ff0000support type Acolytes^000000.
^ff0000INT^000000 enhances ^ff0000treatment function^000000 and increases ^ff0000SP^000000 which is necessary for using skills.
It also helps ^ff0000SP recovery^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
^ff0000智力（INT）^000000是^ff0000輔助型服事^000000的重要屬性。
^ff0000智力（INT）^000000能增強^ff0000治療效果^000000、提高使用技能所需的^ff0000SP^000000，
也有助於^ff0000恢復SP^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
But  aid type acolyte has a weakness point such as ^ff0000It is difficult to hunt alone^000000.
So it goes huning with ^ff0000party^000000 or use ^ff0000heal^000000 skill to monsters with ^ff0000fire-attribute^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
不過，輔助型服事不擅長^ff0000獨自狩獵^000000。
通常會加入^ff0000隊伍^000000，或用^ff0000治癒術^000000攻擊^ff0000火屬性魔物^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
It is like ^ff0000heal skill with holly power is fatal to undead with fire-attribute^000000.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
例如，帶有神聖力量的^ff0000治癒術對火屬性不死系魔物有致命效果^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
The important status FOR ^ff0000physical attack type^000000 acolyte is ^ff0000STR, VIT, AGI, DEX^000000.
The status seem to be complicated compare to support type but it is simple indeed.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
^ff0000物理攻擊型^000000服事的重要屬性是^ff0000力量（STR）、體質（VIT）、敏捷（AGI）和靈巧（DEX）^000000。
這些屬性看起來比輔助型複雜，其實很簡單。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000STR is the power, increases attack power, VIT is physical power, AGI is attack , speed and dodge, DEX increases hitting rate and skill casting speed.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
^ff0000力量（STR）能提高攻擊力；體質（VIT）增強體格；敏捷（AGI）提高攻擊速度和閃避率；靈巧（DEX）提高命中率和技能詠唱速度。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
For the character of ^ff0000Attack type^000000, ^ff0000DEX^000000 will be most important status...no?
If the attack does not hit the enemy, the attack is meaningless.
You may increase STR, VIT, AGI according to your style.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
對^ff0000攻擊型^000000服事來說，^ff0000靈巧（DEX）^000000最重要...對吧？
攻擊打不中敵人，就毫無意義。
力量、體質和敏捷則可按個人風格分配。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
You might think an Acolyte is not strong enough because it has no attack type skill, it enables use of sub essential skills which enhance the powers as much as you want. It helps your stable hunting.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
你可能覺得服事沒有攻擊技能，所以不夠強。其實服事可以用輔助技能強化自身能力，幫助你更穩定地狩獵。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask me anything if you have more questions.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
還有問題的話，儘管問我。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
An acolyte has lots of skills.
All those skills are useful.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
服事有很多技能，
而且每一項都很實用。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000Heal^000000 is for the wounds, It is also used to attack undead with opposite attribute.
Increase the power related to ^ff0000speed^000000 and ^ff0000[Increase Agi]^000000 to increase  ^ff0000movement speed^000000
^ff0000[Blessing]^000000 can ^ff0000enhance^000000 ^ff0000STR, INT, DEX^000000 at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
^ff0000治癒術^000000可以治療傷口，也能用來攻擊相剋屬性的不死系魔物。
提高^ff0000敏捷^000000並學習^ff0000[加速術]^000000，可以提升^ff0000移動速度^000000。
^ff0000[天使之賜福]^000000可以同時^ff0000提高^000000^ff0000力量（STR）、智力（INT）和靈巧（DEX）^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000[Teleport]^000000 is to ^ff0000move^000000 to other places.
^ff0000[Warp Portal]^000000 can open a gate to the ^ff0000Places saved in memory^000000.
There are still more skills as well.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
^ff0000[瞬間移動]^000000可以^ff0000前往^000000其他地點。
^ff0000[傳送之陣]^000000則能開啟通往^ff0000記憶中儲存地點^000000的傳送門。
服事還有很多其他技能。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask ^ff0000if you want to experience skills of an Acolyte, ask the sister next to you^000000.
Now I am reading an introductory skill.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
^ff0000想體驗服事技能的話，可以問問你旁邊的修女。^000000
我現在在看技能入門指南。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
oh my!
So.. you decided to be an Acolyte?
Odin welcomes you.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
哎呀！
這麼說...你決定成為服事了？
奧丁會歡迎你的。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Do you truly wish to become a servant of God?
Let's see whether you are ready for it or not... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
你真的願意成為神的侍從嗎？
讓我看看你準備好了沒有...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Please visit ^ff0000Father Mareusis^000000 at the church in the ^ff0000northeast corner^000000 of ^ff0000Prontera.^000000
At ^ff0000Job Level 10^000000 you can join the ministry.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
去^ff0000馬魯西斯神父^000000在^ff0000東北角^000000的^ff0000普隆德拉^000000教堂拜訪他。
達到^ff0000職業等級10級^000000後，就能加入教會。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Oh my?! You haven't accomplished the basic practice yet?! You have long way to go! Come again after increasing your job level!
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
哎呀！基礎訓練還沒完成嗎？！你還有很長的路要走呢！提升職業等級後再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Wonderful! I'll transfer you to the local ministry at Prontera.
^ff0000Please visit Father Mareusis at the church in the northeast corner of Prontera.^000000
At ^ff0000Job Level 10^000000 you can join the ministry.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
太好了！我會把你轉介給普隆德拉當地的教會。
^ff0000請前往普隆德拉東北角的教堂拜訪馬魯西斯神父。^000000
達到^ff0000職業等級10級^000000後，就能加入教會。

scripts.text: Go to the field south of Prontera
scripts.translation: 前往普隆德拉南邊的野外

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask me anything if you have more questions.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
還有問題的話，儘管問我。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Good, I wish you luck~
Let's go~
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
很好，祝你好運～
我們出發吧～

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask me anything if you have more questions.
scripts.translation:
[愛麗絲·伊莎]
還有問題的話，儘管問我。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Wow... this academy is amazing?
It was not like this when I used to train in the past.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
哇...學院真了不起！
我以前受訓時，可沒有這麼好的條件。

scripts.text: - You have too many items. Clear inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation: - 背包裡的物品太多了，請先整理後再試。 -

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Wow... this academy is amazing?
It was not like this when I used to train in the past.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
哇...學院真了不起！
我以前受訓時，可沒有這麼好的條件。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
You can ^ff0000register^000000 at the ^ff0000information center of the Criatura Academy^000000, it will be a great help.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
您可以先^ff0000登記^000000，再前往^ff0000克里圖拉學院的資訊中心^000000辦理，會方便很多。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Ahem..~
Who are you?
Are you interested in this ^ff0000introductory course^000000?
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
咳咳...～
你是誰？
對這門^ff0000入門課程^000000感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[A nun]
This introductory manual is mysterious! It enables the ^ff0000use a couple of an Acolyte's skill^000000.
Will you borrow it?
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
這本入門手冊很特別！可以讓你^ff0000體驗幾項服事技能^000000。
要借來看看嗎？

scripts.text: Take the Acolyte Course.
scripts.translation: 參加服事課程

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Well.. if you are not interested.. fine.
murmuring
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
嗯...既然你沒興趣...那就算了。
（低聲嘟囔）

scripts.text:
[A nun]
You already have one.
We do not give two.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
你已經有一本了。
我們不能再發給你第二本。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Then, use it for good.
^ff0000Equip (double click or drag to equipment window)^000000 and open the ^ff0000skill window(Alt+S)^000000 to see the skills in manual.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
那就好好利用吧。
^ff0000裝備手冊（雙擊或拖到裝備視窗）^000000，再開啟^ff0000技能視窗（Alt + S）^000000檢視裡面的技能。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I do not wish to speak to you. Leave now...
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
我不想和你說話。現在離開...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
If you want to be trained as a Ninja, just visit Hono O, who is at the room next to where you upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
想接受忍者訓練的話，就去找霍諾·歐。他在你轉職的房間隔壁。

scripts.text:
[Ko Ori]
If you want to be trained as a Ninja, just visit Hono O, who is at the room next to where you upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[小織]
想接受忍者訓練的話，就去找霍諾·歐。他在你轉職的房間隔壁。

scripts.text:
[Ko Ori]
How was it?
Although he is very blunt, he does care very deeply about newcomers.
scripts.translation:
[小織]
感覺怎麼樣？
他雖然說話很直，其實很關心新人。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I am the guide to the way of the Ninja for newcomers.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
我是為新人指引忍者之道的嚮導。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I am not interested in the people who are already on their path.
Take your leave now...
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
我不想和已經踏上忍者之路的人打交道。
請離開...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
A child cannot accept the life of the Ninja.
It is not easy to qualify for such a life, so do not feel sorry...
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
小孩子還無法承擔忍者的生活。
要達到這種資格並不容易，不必覺得遺憾...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
First of all, you must enroll in the Academy and visit me again.
Everything has to follow the correct procedures and being clumsy is no excuse.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
首先要先在學院登記，然後再來找我。
辦事必須遵守規矩，笨手笨腳可不是藉口。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Hmmm. So a new beginner has come eh?
Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
嗯...來了個剛入門的新人啊？
你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Explanation about the Ninja.
scripts.translation: 忍者職業介紹

scripts.text: I decided to be a Ninja.
scripts.translation: 我決定成為忍者

scripts.text: I don't have any business here.
scripts.translation: 我只是路過

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
A beginner wishing to be a Ninja....
Ask me what you are curious about.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
想成為忍者的新人...
有什麼好奇的就問我吧。

scripts.text: What can I do if I become a Ninja?
scripts.translation: 成為忍者後能做什麼？

scripts.text: What is required to become a Ninja?
scripts.translation: 成為忍者需要什麼條件？

scripts.text: I want to experience Ninja skills.
scripts.translation: 我想體驗忍者技能

scripts.text: I don't have any worries about Ninjas.
scripts.translation: 關於忍者，我沒什麼想問的

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Ninja is a profession that allows you to attack while sneaking for maximum damage.
As Ninja has various kinds of deception skills, which is good for soloing.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
忍者擅長潛行後發動攻擊，造成最大傷害。
忍者還有各種詭術技能，很適合單獨行動。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Not only can you learn Ninja technique similarly as magic, you can also make direct attacks, deal critical damage or throw knives at enemies.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
你不但能學習類似魔法的忍術，還可以直接攻擊、打出暴擊，或向敵人投擲飛刀。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
But you can't do all of these things perfectly without sufficient equipment.
You will take more damage than others if you are hit.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
不過，沒有合適的裝備，就無法充分發揮這些能力。
而且一旦被擊中，你會比其他職業承受更多傷害。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Therefore, if the person who is not completely weary of this world chooses this job, with no discretion, they will not fail.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
忍者有多種修行路線，每一種都有優缺點。
務必深思熟慮，再做決定。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Ninja can be trained in a variety of courses.
Everything has both one merit and one demerit.
You would better make your own decision after profound consideration.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
忍者有多種修行路線。
每種都有優點和缺點，最好仔細考慮後再決定。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
There are two major status which affect the degree of damages.
One is ^ff0000Power^000000, the other is ^ff0000Intelligence^000000,
Power affects the damages by^8E2323 physical attacks^000000 and^8E2323 throwing attacks^000000.
Intelligence affects the damage by ^8E2323Ninja's skill ^000000
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
有兩項主要屬性會影響傷害。
一項是^ff0000力量^000000，另一項是^ff0000智力^000000。
力量會影響^8E2323物理攻擊^000000和^8E2323投擲攻擊^000000的傷害。
智力則影響^8E2323忍者技能^000000的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
In addition to these, you can learn
other statuses not from the professional trainers like us
but from the trainers teaching the basic skills for battle.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
除此之外，你還可以學習其他屬性相關的知識。
這部分要向教授戰鬥基礎的訓練師請教，而不是找我們這些職業訓練師。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
For example, to raise up the hit rate,
What should you do?
To raise the defense, what do you wear? Etc...
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
比如，想提高命中率該怎麼做？
想提高防禦力又該穿什麼？諸如此類...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
You can equip this manual to experience some skills.
Open up your skill window by pressing <Alt+S> and find the skills in the Misc TAB.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
裝備這本手冊就能體驗一些技能。
按<Alt+S>開啟技能視窗，再到“雜項”標籤頁檢視。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
The Academy has a trainer downstairs who will give you battle field training. Meet him and train your skills.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
學院樓下有位訓練師，可以帶你進行戰鬥訓練。去找他練練技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
He will give you some quests to complete. Use the Manual to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
他會安排一些任務給你。戰鬥時可以使用手冊中的技能。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Make every useful moment count.
You can equip this manual to experience some skills.
Open up your skill window by pressing <Alt+S> and find the skills in the Misc TAB.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
把每一刻都用在有意義的事情上。
裝備這本手冊就能體驗一些技能。
按<Alt+S>開啟技能視窗，再到“雜項”標籤頁檢視。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
The Academy has a trainer downstairs who will give you battle field training. Meet him and train your skills.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
學院樓下有位訓練師，可以帶你進行戰鬥訓練。去找他練練技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
He will give you some quests to complete. Use the Manual to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
他會安排一些任務給你。戰鬥時可以使用手冊中的技能。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Do you understand everything I told you?
That's all... You don't have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
我說的這些你都明白了嗎？
就這些...沒有其他問題了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I appreciate your braveness but, first of all, you have to be familiar with the current profession.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
我欣賞你的勇氣，不過首先得熟悉自己現在的職業。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Before you decide to become a Ninja,
you need to come back after reaching the novice's job level 9. Then, I will accept you.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
想成為忍者，先把初心者職業等級升到9級，再回來找我。到時候我會接納你。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
This may be your last warning.
Becoming a Ninja means leading a difficult life.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
這也許是我最後一次提醒你。
忍者的生活可不好過。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
As Ninja don't belong to a guild, it is easily obtainable to Novices.
Make sure your decision is final!
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
忍者不隸屬於任何公會，初心者也能直接轉職。
一定要慎重考慮，確定自己想清楚了！

scripts.text: I will reconsider.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下。

scripts.text: I already made up my mind.
scripts.translation: 我已經決定了。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Well thought actions can often bring good results.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
三思而後行，往往會有好結果。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
If you're so assertive, I have no choice but to guide you there.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
既然你這麼堅決，我也只好帶你過去了。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I will send you close to where you can change your job.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
我會把你送到轉職地點附近。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I will give you a special hint.
Amatsu town is where you are going to arrive. Find the hidden tunnel in a vacant house.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
給你個特別提示：你會抵達櫻花城。去一棟空屋裡找隱藏的隧道。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
There you will meet a person who will guide you to becoming a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
在那裡，你會遇到一位能指引你成為忍者的人。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
If you get lost in the town, well there is no way... Being ninja requires a level of observation power.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
要是在城裡迷路了，我也幫不了你...成為忍者需要敏銳的觀察力。

scripts.text: -Select ^ff0000Confirm^000000 to go to Amatsu.
scripts.translation: -選擇^ff0000確認^000000前往櫻花城。

scripts.text: Confirm
scripts.translation: 確認

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
............

[Ninja Guide]
......
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I have no words to say, if you don't have any business with me.
scripts.translation:
[忍者嚮導]
沒事的話，我沒什麼可跟你說的。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with the dialogue because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 背包太滿，無法繼續對話。 -

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Hello? My name is Han to lead the next generation of refining culture in Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
你好！我叫韓，致力於引領盧恩-米德加茲的精煉文化邁向新一代。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Entering this market lately, if I don't have old customers, it is not easy to operate. So, I do the advertising by myself.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
剛入行時沒有老顧客，生意可不好做。所以我只好親自宣傳。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Are you interested in ^3E86C3refining^000000 to make your items strong?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
想用^3E86C3精煉^000000強化裝備嗎？

scripts.text: I have no interest.
scripts.translation: 沒興趣

scripts.text: refining? Is it edible?
scripts.translation: 精煉？能吃嗎？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Ah, I am sorry. I caught a busy man.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
啊，抱歉，打擾你了。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Refining means to strenghthen your equipments with  ^3E86C3rare metal^000000 obtainable from monsters and so on.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
精煉就是用從魔物身上等途徑獲得的^3E86C3稀有金屬^000000來強化裝備。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
If weapons are refined, their attacking power increases. If shields are refined, their defensive power increasesand helps to reduce pain against monster's hits on you.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
精煉武器能提高攻擊力，精煉盾牌能提高防禦力，減輕受到魔物攻擊時的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
So you kind of get the jist of it right?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
大概明白精煉是怎麼回事了吧？

scripts.text: Oh... refining...
scripts.translation: 哦...精煉啊...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Yes, that's it. Refining is good but it can get addicting.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
沒錯，就是這樣。精煉是好東西，不過也容易讓人上癮。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I don't usually do it, but will give you a special chance to experience refining.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
我平時不這麼做，不過這次破例讓你體驗一次精煉。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Whatever 1st level weapon level can be used it doesn't matter! If you use the ^3E86C3refining machine Wagjak^000000 over there!!
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
不管你拿的是哪種武器，都能拿來精煉！用那邊的^3E86C3精煉機瓦格傑克^000000就行！！

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
^I will give you ^FD4F02just! one refining service free of charge.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
^我可以給你^FD4F02一次免費的精煉服務^000000。

scripts.text: Only once?
scripts.translation: 只有一次？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Hey I need to make a living you know! Don't go telling everyone I'm doing this for free ok?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
喂，我也得養家餬口啊！別到處跟人說我免費幫你精煉，行嗎？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
You haven't used the refining machine Wagjak.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
你還沒用過“瓦格傑克”精煉機呢。

scripts.text: Refining Machine Wagjak
scripts.translation: 瓦格傑克精煉機

scripts.text: Why is it called Wagjak?
scripts.translation: 為什麼叫瓦格傑克？

scripts.text: Anything else I should know?
scripts.translation: 還有什麼要注意的嗎？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
The refining machine Wagjak is a machine I made after 8 years of research.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
這臺瓦格傑克精煉機是我花了八年研究製造出來的。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I made it for more precious refining. It is my personal refining machine. Well, thanks to it, I have made several contracts.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
我造它是為了進行更高階的精煉。這是我的私人精煉機，多虧了它，我還談成了好幾筆生意。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
The name doesn't mean anything it's just a name. Wagjak! What a weird name right?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
這個名字沒什麼特別意思，就是隨便取的。瓦格傑克！是不是很奇怪？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Absolutely!
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
當然！

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
But I subscribe to the idea that seeing is believing... You know what I mean? Try it out yourself instead of asking questions.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
我一直相信眼見為實...你懂我的意思吧？別光問，自己試試看。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Ohoh... as you don't have a service coupon.. You may have already used Wagjak...
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
哦哦...你沒有服務券啊...看來你可能已經用過瓦格傑克了...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I hope you have a brief understanding of refining.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
希望你已經對精煉有了初步瞭解。

scripts.text: Anything else I should know?
scripts.translation: 還有什麼要注意的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Yes, yes, we have... Safety refining indications and refining price... such small things...
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
對了，還有安全精煉規則和精煉價格之類的小事...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
For an explanation ^3E86C3weapon levels^000000 & ^3E86C3safety refining^000000...
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
關於^3E86C3武器等級^000000和^3E86C3安全精煉^000000的說明...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
You can learn from ^3E86C3Mr. Taddae^000000 selling Phracon and Emveteracon
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
可以向^3E86C3塔達埃先生^000000瞭解強化武器金屬-級數一和強化武器金屬-級數二，他負責出售這兩種材料。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I recommend you visit and listen to Mr. Tadde about weapon levels and safe refining.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
建議你去找塔德先生，聽聽他講解武器等級和安全精煉。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Did you get a good lesson? Did he explain it well enough?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
課聽得怎麼樣？他講清楚了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Just between us, there is a rumor that lots of employees complain about me.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
悄悄告訴你，聽說不少員工都在抱怨我。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I sent you there to monitor the situation.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
我讓你過去，就是想讓你打探一下情況。

scripts.text: So?
scripts.translation: 然後呢？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I will adopt it in the performance rating. By the way, how was Mr. Tadde's lesson?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
我會把這件事納入他的績效評估。對了，塔德先生講得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: It was excellent.
scripts.translation: 講得非常好

scripts.text: It was just OK.
scripts.translation: 還不錯

scripts.text: It was so-so.
scripts.translation: 一般般

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
He did a good job...
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
他做得不錯...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Hmm. Is that so? I see... I'll have to jot this down...
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
嗯，是嗎？我知道了...得把這件事記下來...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Hmm.. It was like that... I see.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
嗯...原來是這樣...我知道了。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Now! I'm done organizing..
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
好了！整理完了...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Next is the explanation about ^3E86C3refining effect^000000 and ^3E86C3refining price^000000.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
接下來要介紹^3E86C3精煉效果^000000和^3E86C3精煉價格^000000。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
^3E86C3Mr. Locas^000000 is in charge with refinement with Oridecon gemstones.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
^3E86C3洛卡斯先生^000000負責用神之金屬原石進行精煉。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Go speak with Mr. Locas's about the refining effect and refining price.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
去找洛卡斯先生，問問精煉效果和價格吧。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Ah!! I ask for your favor this time, either.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
啊！！這次又得麻煩你了。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Go and see ^3E86C3Mr. Locas^000000 in charge with refining Oridecon stone for the refining effect and refining price.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
去問負責精煉神之金屬原石的^3E86C3洛卡斯先生^000000，瞭解精煉效果和價格。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Did you get a good lesson? Did he explain it well enough?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
課聽得怎麼樣？他講清楚了嗎？

scripts.text: He was good great.
scripts.translation: 講得特別好

scripts.text: It was just OK.
scripts.translation: 還不錯

scripts.text: So-so..
scripts.translation: 一般般

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Mr. Locas explained it to you well.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
洛卡斯先生講得很清楚。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Just OK? Hmmm.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
只是還不錯？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Oh no.. You were not satisfied with his explanations...
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
糟了...看來他講得不夠好，讓你不滿意...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I see. I will jot that down.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
我知道了，會記下來的。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
By the way, I have finished all the explanations about refining. Any further questions?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
關於精煉的說明就到這裡。還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text: No questions at all.
scripts.translation: 沒問題了

scripts.text: I have some questions...
scripts.translation: 我還有些問題...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I see.. But just in case...
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
明白了...不過還是以防萬一...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Ah, is that so? Don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
啊，是嗎？別擔心。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
If you have any further questions, come and see me. I will give you full explanations again.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
還有問題的話，隨時來找我。我會再為你詳細說明。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
And this is a compensation for your lesson. I hope to see you frequently in the future.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
這是給你的聽課謝禮。希望以後常來。

scripts.text: Got a lesson about the refining and Kafra storage free coupon.
scripts.translation: 獲得了精煉教學說明和卡普拉倉庫免費利用券。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
How are you doing?
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Hi!!
How is the morale of the employees?
scripts.translation: 員工士氣怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Question is....
scripts.translation: 我想問的是...

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
How are you? Haven't seen you long time.. Please pay more frequent visits and do refining.
scripts.translation:
[精煉廠主 韓]
最近怎麼樣？好久不見了...多來光顧，順便多精煉幾次吧。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Just as before, labor-management consensus have achieved.

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Welcome. The owner told me to explain to you about ^3E86C3the weapon levels^000000 and ^3E86C3safety refining.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
歡迎。店主讓我向你說明^3E86C3武器等級^000000和^3E86C3安全精煉^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
In fact, it is better to get to know while questing yourself. But anyway if you have any questions, please ask to me.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
其實，自己做任務時慢慢了解會更好。不過有問題的話，儘管問我。

scripts.text: Weapon level
scripts.translation: 武器等級

scripts.text: Safety refining.
scripts.translation: 安全精煉

scripts.text: Finish the question.
scripts.translation: 結束提問

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Weapons have level, whereas Armors don't. The more ^3E86C3upscaled a weapon^000000 is, the higher the weapon level is.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
武器有等級，防具則沒有。武器^3E86C3精煉等級^000000越高，武器等級也越高。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
That means ^A20B09the upscaled weapons are more difficult to obtain.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
這也意味著，^A20B09高等級武器更難獲得^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Considering the customers coming to refine, the ones for refining level 1,2 weapons are more than those for level 3,4 weapons.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
來精煉的顧客中，拿1級、2級武器來的比拿3級、4級武器的多。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Safety refining differs from the levels of Armor or weapon, so basically each level has a ^3E86C3different safe upgrade level.^000000
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
安全精煉上限會因武器或防具的等級而異，每個等級都有^3E86C3不同的安全精煉上限^000000。

scripts.text: Level 1 Weapon
scripts.translation: 1級武器

scripts.text: Level 2 Weapon
scripts.translation: 2級武器

scripts.text: Level 3 Weapon
scripts.translation: 3級武器

scripts.text: Level 4 Weapon
scripts.translation: 4級武器

scripts.text: Armor
scripts.translation: 防具

scripts.text: Question finished
scripts.translation: 結束提問

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Level 1 weapons are safe when refined up to ^A20B09+7^000000. The lower the level of weapon is, the higher the figure of the refining is possible.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
1級武器精煉到^A20B09+7^000000都在安全範圍內。武器等級越低，安全精煉上限越高。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Of course, it has stronger effect than level 1 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
當然，等級更高的武器，效能也更強。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Level 2 weapons are safe when refined up to ^A20B09+6^000000, even though refining figure is lower than level 1 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
2級武器精煉到^A20B09+6^000000都在安全範圍內，比1級武器的安全上限低一些。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Of course, it has stronger effect than level 1 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
當然，等級更高的武器，效能也更強。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Level 3 weapons are safe when refined up to ^A20B09+5^000000. Simply speaking, it looks like the safety refining goes down by 1 according to each weapon level.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
3級武器精煉到^A20B09+5^000000都在安全範圍內。簡單來說，武器等級每提高一級，安全上限就降低1。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
The higher the weapon is, the increasing effect of +1 becomes higher as well.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
武器等級越高，每提升精煉等級+1，帶來的效果也越明顯。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Level 4 weapons are safe up to ^A20B09+4^000000. Numbers of level 4 weapons are so rare that not so many customers bring them here.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
4級武器精煉到^A20B09+4^000000都在安全範圍內。4級武器很稀有，拿來精煉的顧客不多。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
As it is one of the most luxurious weapons, the effect of refining is the strongest.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
這類武器十分珍貴，精煉帶來的效果也最強。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Armors are safe when refined up to^A20B09+4^000000, just like a level 4 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
防具和4級武器一樣，精煉到^A20B09+4^000000都在安全範圍內。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
As most refiners are used to making weapons it's hard for them to safely upgrade armors.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
大多數精煉師平時更常精煉武器，因此不太擅長安全地精煉防具。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
You look like you've had enough explanations about the safety refining.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
看來您已經瞭解了安全精煉的相關知識。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Your questions end. If you have more questions later, come to me any time.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
您的問題問完了。以後還有疑問的話，隨時可以來找我。

Level 3 weapon will add ^A20B095^000000 to the attacking power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
3級武器每精煉+1，攻擊力就會^A20B09增加5點^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Lastly, level 4 weapon will add ^A20B097^000000 to the attacking power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
最後，4級武器每精煉+1，攻擊力就會^A20B09增加7點^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Ah, I missed the Armor. The Armor can be add ^A20B091^000000 to the defense power per each refining level.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
啊，差點忘了防具。防具每精煉+1，防禦力就會^A20B09增加1點^000000。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Well, by now the explanations were only for the effect of the safe refining....
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
好了，剛才說明的都只是安全精煉的效果...

scripts.text:
[Locas]
You would better learn yourself ^A20B09the effect of over refining^000000 regardless of potential risk.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
不妨親自了解一下^A20B09超過安全上限精煉^000000的效果，不過要自行承擔風險。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
If I tell you all the details, it is likely you start reading an epic novel of 10,000 pages, I'll tell you the ending of it.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
要是把所有細節都告訴你，恐怕得講上一萬頁。我還是直接告訴你結論吧。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
One thing to be clear is you should be careful about destroying your equipment if you get over-eager.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
有一點要記住：精煉過頭的話，裝備可能會損壞，一定要小心。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Thank you for your listening to a long story. This is all I can explain you.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
謝謝你聽我講了這麼久。這就是我能說明的全部了。

scripts.text:
[Locas]
Regarding the levels of weapons and safety refining, consult with Mr. Tadde. He will kindly answer to you.
scripts.translation:
[洛卡斯]
關於武器等級和安全精煉，請向塔德先生請教。他會耐心為你解答。

scripts.text: - As you have too many items in your inventory, Quest can't be continued -
scripts.translation: - 您的物品欄中物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Welcome. Welcome to the enchant association. I am ^142CEBMounds^000000- head of Izlude branch of the Enchant association.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
歡迎，歡迎來到附魔協會。我是^142CEB蒙茲^000000，附魔協會依斯魯得島分部的負責人。

scripts.text: Oh... a cat can speak???
scripts.translation: 噢...貓居然會說話？？？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Have you never seen a talking cat?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
您沒見過會說話的貓嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
There is an island called ^FD4F02Malangdo^000000 where only cats live and I am from there.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
有座名叫^FD4F02綿綿島^000000的島，島上住的全是貓。我就來自那裡。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
There are cats like me who can speak the human language very well, but some cats speaking human and cat language are a mess.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
像我這樣能流利說人類語言的貓並不少見，不過有些貓說起話來會把人類語和貓語混在一起，聽著亂七八糟的。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Well, that can be checked in Malangdo later are you interested in ^FD4F02Enchantments^000000?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
這些事以後到了綿綿島再說吧。您對^FD4F02附魔^000000感興趣嗎？

scripts.text: Enchant Association?
scripts.translation: 附魔協會？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
The Enchant Association is the group made by those of us who can enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
附魔協會是由我們這些會附魔的人組成的組織。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
This association is composed of two divisions of ^FD4F02the socket enchant division^000000 and ^FD4F02the hidden enchant division^000000.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
協會分為兩個部門：^FD4F02插槽附魔部^000000和^FD4F02隱藏附魔部^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Maybe, are you curious about each division?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
您對這兩個部門感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Maybe, are you curious about each division?
[Mounds]
You don't have any further questions.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
您對這兩個部門感興趣嗎？
[蒙茲]
看來您沒有其他問題了。

scripts.text: Socket Enchant?
scripts.translation: 插槽附魔？

scripts.text: Hidden Enchant
scripts.translation: 隱藏附魔

scripts.text: Question finished
scripts.translation: 結束提問

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You are curious about the socket enchant.. Here is the explantion.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
您對插槽附魔很感興趣啊...那我來說明一下。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
From unknown reason, There has been existing ^FD4F02card slots^000000 on the equipments obtainable from monsters.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
不知為何，從魔物身上獲得的裝備上一直都有^FD4F02卡片插槽^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
People started to question, 'Can we make a device to insert cards to these?'
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
於是人們開始琢磨：“能不能製造一種裝置，把卡片裝進這些插槽裡呢？”

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
At last, one day a man called ^142CEBSeyablem^000000 showed up with the technology of socket enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
終於有一天，一位名叫^142CEB塞亞布勒姆^000000的人帶來了插槽附魔技術。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Nobody knew how he got the technology....
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
沒人知道他是怎麼掌握這項技術的...

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Someday later, a younger brother of Seyablem called ^142CEBLeyablem^000000 introduced a different device from his brother to socket enchant other equipments.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
後來，塞亞布勒姆的弟弟^142CEB雷亞布勒姆^000000也出現了。他帶來一種不同於哥哥的裝置，可以為其他裝備進行插槽附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Many people using the brothers' socket enchanting services, they stole the technology
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
許多人使用兄弟倆的插槽附魔服務後，竟然偷走了這項技術。

scripts.text: Ok seems simple enough...
scripts.translation: 嗯，聽起來挺簡單的...

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
The brothers happened to join the enchant association. And from time to time, they teach the technology to us in Malangdo.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
兄弟倆後來加入了附魔協會。他們偶爾會把這項技術傳授給綿綿島上的我們。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Learning the technology diligently, some day will come when others can do socket enchants.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
只要認真學習這項技術，總有一天其他人也能進行插槽附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Ah, my story went off topic.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
啊，我說得跑題了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Well, conclusion is this, socket enchant means to add a card socket to the common equipment being sold at any shops.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
簡單來說，插槽附魔就是給商店出售的普通裝備新增卡片插槽。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
It is called socket enchant. Are you curious about the other division?
[Mounds]
You don't have any further questions.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
這就是插槽附魔。您還想了解另一個部門嗎？
[蒙茲]
看來您沒有其他問題了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Ah ! Are you curious about the hidden enchant?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
啊！您想了解隱藏附魔嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
OK. First, I have to let you know how the hidden enchnat skill was born.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
好。首先，我得告訴您隱藏附魔技術是如何誕生的。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
The original inventor was looking for a way to unlock the 4th slot of a 3 slotted weapon.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
最初的發明者一直在尋找解鎖三插槽武器第4個插槽的方法。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
So he studied the technology to make use of the remaining slot.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
於是，他開始研究如何利用剩餘插槽。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
When the study was finally successful he taught it to his apprentices and was never heard from again.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
研究終於成功後，他把這項技術傳授給徒弟，之後便再也沒有訊息了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
His technology reinforced the equipment with a gem that had special properties similar to monster cards.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
他發明的技術可以用寶石強化裝備，而寶石具有類似魔物卡片的特殊屬性。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
That technology has been developed and improved to make the current ^FD4F02Enchant association ^000000
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
這項技術不斷發展改進，最終形成了現在的^FD4F02附魔協會^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Briefly speaking, to make a stronger equipment with a special enchantment is the hidden enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
簡單來說，隱藏附魔就是通過特殊附魔來打造更強大的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Are you curious about the other division?
[Mounds]
You don't have any further questions.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
您還想了解另一個部門嗎？
[蒙茲]
看來您沒有其他問題了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You don't have any further questions.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
看來您沒有其他問題了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Later, if you want to experience the hidden enchant or socket enchant, I will give you a hand.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
以後想體驗隱藏附魔或插槽附魔的話，我可以幫您。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Come to me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
隨時歡迎您來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Welcome.. Ah, we've met before right?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
歡迎...啊，我們以前見過吧？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Are you coming to experience the hidden enchant or the socket enchant?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
您是來體驗隱藏附魔，還是插槽附魔？

scripts.text: I am just passing by.
scripts.translation: 我只是路過。

scripts.text: Came to experience it.
scripts.translation: 來體驗一下

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You may be on the way to Prontera. Be careful and come back.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
您是要去普隆德拉吧？路上小心，記得再來。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You want an experience.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
您想體驗一下啊。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
The experience course starts from the experience of the simple socket enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
體驗課程會從簡單的插槽附魔開始。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
For this, you need material. Will you buy a cotton shirt at Izlude Armor shop?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
體驗需要用到材料。您願意去依斯魯得島的防具店買一件棉襯衫嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
When you bring the cotton shirt, we will immediately start ^FD4F02the socket enchnat experience^000000 course.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
帶來棉襯衫後，我們就馬上開始^FD4F02插槽附魔體驗課程^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Oh this is a socketed shirt already!
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
哎呀，這件襯衫已經有插槽了！

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
It must be a plain cotton shirt.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
需要一件普通的棉襯衫。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
When you bring the plain cotton shirt from the Armor shop, we will start the socket enchant experience.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
從防具店買一件普通的棉襯衫帶來，我們就開始插槽附魔體驗。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Bring us the normal shirt without holes.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
請帶一件沒有插槽的普通襯衫來。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Not like all other enchants, the socket enchant is being worked without items installed.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
插槽附魔和其他附魔不同，不需要先在裝備上鑲嵌物品。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Then, let's start the socket enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
那麼，我們開始插槽附魔吧。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
One!
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
一！

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
One! Two!
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
一！二！

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
One! Two! Three!
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
一！二！三！

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You have suceeded in socket enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
插槽附魔成功了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Have you checked the equipment? It now has an empty slot in it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
檢查過裝備了嗎？現在上面多了一個空插槽。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
But, like this time the success rate is not always ^FD4F02100%^000000 as you are still in the studying phase.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
不過，像這次這樣，成功率並不總是^FD4F02100%^000000。畢竟我們還在學習階段。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Please keep in mind that there always risks of failure and if failed, the equipment will be broken.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
請記住，附魔總有失敗的風險。一旦失敗，裝備就會損壞。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
If you want to know more about the socket enchant, go and consult with Leyablem or Seyablem who are working at Prontera or Payon.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
想進一步瞭解插槽附魔的話，可以去普隆德拉或斐揚，向在那裡工作的雷亞布勒姆或塞亞布勒姆請教。

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Now it's time for your experiencing the hidden enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
現在該體驗隱藏附魔了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Equipped with the just socket enchanted cotton shirt, get the hidden enchant from
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
穿上剛才完成插槽附魔的棉襯衫，去找那邊負責隱藏附魔的貓阿爾蒙德 J。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Almond J, the cat in charge with the hidden enchant over there.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
阿爾蒙德 J 就在那邊，是負責隱藏附魔的貓。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Get the hidden enchant from Almond J with wearing the cotton shirt socket enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
穿著完成插槽附魔的棉襯衫，去找阿爾蒙德 J 進行隱藏附魔。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Eh? You came earlier than expected? I though it might take time after listening to all the explanations.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
咦？你來得比預想中早啊。我還以為聽完所有說明後，你要花些時間才會回來。

scripts.text: Explain about the situation.
scripts.translation: 說明一下情況。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Keuh~~ It happened....
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
咳~~出事了...

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
I should beware of you, when you were making a big noise to do the hidden enchant.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
你當時嚷著要做隱藏附魔，我就該提防著你。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Anyway, I am sorry.. Though it is short, I will make the explanation for you.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
總之，很抱歉...雖然時間不多，我還是簡單說明一下。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Have you checked the hidden enchant?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
你檢查過隱藏附魔了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，檢查過了。

scripts.text: No. I haven't.
scripts.translation: 沒有，還沒檢查。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As you have checked it already, my explanation became easy.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
既然你已經檢查過了，我就好說明多了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Hmmm. Recommend you examine the condition of your cotton shirt, opening item window.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
嗯。建議你開啟物品欄，檢查一下棉襯衫的狀態。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As you have checked it already, my explanation became easy.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
既然你已經檢查過了，我就好說明多了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As I explained you just before, the hidden enchant is the work to insert to weapoon or Armor a gem with a special option into the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
正如剛才所說，隱藏附魔就是把帶有特殊效果的寶石附加到武器或防具上。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As you know it, if you checked, you may notice something new was at the no. 3 and 4 slots at the bottom of item information window.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
檢查之後，你應該會發現物品資訊視窗底部的第3和第4個插槽有了變化。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Hidden enchant is being proceeded with the similar equipment worn as Almond J's.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
隱藏附魔的操作方式和阿爾蒙德 J 那邊類似。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Of course, there are some other places to do the hidden enchants.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
當然，也有其他地方可以進行隱藏附魔。

scripts.text: Satisfied.
scripts.translation: 很滿意。

scripts.text: A little short.
scripts.translation: 還差一點。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
It is fortunate. Do you have any experience to be added? If so, please write it to me.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
那太好了。您還有什麼體驗感受想補充嗎？有的話請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Experience seems not be satisfactory with you. Can you write me what was it?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
看來這次體驗不太符合您的期待。能告訴我具體哪裡不滿意嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
I will refer it for planning the next experience.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
我會參考您的意見，安排下一次體驗。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Thank you for your valuable advice.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
感謝您提出寶貴建議。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Thank you for your patience listening to my boring explanation.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
感謝您耐心聽完我這些無聊的說明。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
This is a small gift hoping your continuous support for our enchant association.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
這是一份小禮物，希望您今後繼續支援附魔協會。

scripts.text: Received the explanation about the enchants, some experience and Kafra storage free coupon.
scripts.translation: 已收到附魔說明、一些經驗值和卡普拉倉庫免費利用券。

scripts.text: Received the explanation and Kafra free storage coupon.
scripts.translation: 已收到說明和卡普拉倉庫免費利用券。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Then, I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
那麼，回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Welcome to the enchant association. I am Mounds - head of Izlude branch of Enchant association.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
歡迎來到附魔協會。我是蒙茲，附魔協會依斯魯得島分部的負責人。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Eh? Your appreance is familiar. Have we met before?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
咦？您看起來很眼熟。我們以前見過嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
As I can't remember all the people I met as they are too many, strangely you have a face not to forget.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
我見過的人太多，記不住所有人。不過，不知為何，您的臉讓我過目難忘。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Perhaps, are you here to learn about enchanting? I will kindly explain you about it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
您是來了解附魔的嗎？我很樂意為您說明。

scripts.text: Socket enchant
scripts.translation: 插槽附魔

scripts.text: Hidden enchant
scripts.translation: 隱藏附魔

scripts.text: Give regards
scripts.translation: 打個招呼

scripts.text: No questions at all.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼想問的

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Socket enchant is the skill to make card slots appear in Weapon or Armor.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
插槽附魔可以為武器或防具新增卡片插槽。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
When you meet the Seyablem and Leyablem brothers around the towns of Rune-Midgarts they can help you with this service.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
在盧恩·米德加茲各城鎮遇到塞亞布勒姆和雷亞布勒姆兄弟的話，他們可以為您提供這項服務。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
If they fail to put a new slot in your item say farewell to it...
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
如果新增插槽失敗，裝備就會損壞...到時只能和它說再見了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
It's usually a good idea to have more than 1 item to add a slot to because it can fail a lot sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
最好多準備幾件要新增插槽的裝備，因為有時失敗率很高。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Hidden enchant means to put enchanted gems into the hidden slots of an item.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
隱藏附魔就是將附魔寶石鑲嵌到物品的隱藏插槽中。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
You have to be wearing the item that is being enchanted as it uses the wearers fortune as the success rate.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
進行隱藏附魔時，必須穿著要附魔的裝備，因為成功率取決於穿戴者的幸運。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Many places are providing the various hidden enchant service in different ways, if you have time, please visit one of them.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
許多地方都提供各式各樣的隱藏附魔服務，有空的話請去看看。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
News? Enchant association doesn't have a big issue going on.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
新聞？附魔協會最近沒發生什麼大事。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Ah!! I remember that Almond J sent with me from Izlude branch wanted to do advertising...
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
啊！我想起來了，阿爾蒙德 J 之前派人從依斯魯得島分部過來，說想做宣傳...

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
He drafted the initiative for the free service of hidden enchant to the beginner's weapons. I approved it as it looked a good idea.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
他提議為新手武器提供免費隱藏附魔服務。我覺得不錯，就批准了。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
What? If you have a beginners weapon, it may not hurt to try it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
什麼？如果你有新手武器，不妨來試試。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Come to me whenever you have a question about the enchant association.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
對附魔協會有疑問的話，隨時來找我。

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mounds]
Something strange must've happened. If this continues, please contact customer service.
scripts.translation:
[蒙茲]
好像出了什麼問題。如果一直這樣，請聯絡客服。

scripts.text: - As you have too many items in your inventory, Quest can't be continued -
scripts.translation: - 您的物品欄中物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Hello, I am Almon J of the enchant association.~
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
你好，我是附魔協會的阿爾蒙德 J。~

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
If you have anything to do with the enchant association, please consult with Mounds inside.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
如果有附魔協會相關的事情，請進來找蒙茲商量。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Welcome.. I have been waiting for you. Are you coming for the hidden enchant service on your cotton shirt?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
歡迎...我一直在等您。您是來為棉襯衫進行隱藏附魔的嗎？

scripts.text: Ench? Whatis?
scripts.translation: 附魔？那是什麼？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Eummm?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Oh... finally you came...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
哦...你終於來了...

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Has your ^142cebCotton Shirt[1]^000000 been equipped? Shall we start now? Ready?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
您裝備好^142ceb棉襯衫[1]^000000了嗎？現在開始嗎？準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: You look excited.
scripts.translation: 你看起來很興奮。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Heh... is that so? Frankly, it is my first time... I am really excited.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
嘿嘿...是嗎？說實話，這是我第一次...我真的很興奮。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Are you ready? Yes? Do it now. Now!!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
準備好了嗎？準備好了？那現在就開始吧！馬上！！

scripts.text: Hidden enchant start!!
scripts.translation: 開始隱藏附魔！！

scripts.text: Wait for a while.
scripts.translation: 等一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Heh? Eh? Hik?! Come here quick.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
咦？啊？呀？！快過來！

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Please come back after you have equipped the Cotton Shirt.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
請裝備好棉襯衫後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Hing, it is not a normal Cotton Shirt.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
嗯，這可不是普通的棉襯衫。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Now!! Start the first hidden enchant!! Start!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
現在！！開始第一次隱藏附魔！！開始！！！！

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Zzazanzn!! Completed!!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
滋啦滋啦！！完成了！！

scripts.text: Wow, that was quick.
scripts.translation: 哇，真快。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
How about it? Don't you think the hidden enchant is great? Any chance to do another hidden enchant?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
怎麼樣？隱藏附魔很棒吧？還想再做一次嗎？

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It's fun. I want to do it again. Hey, another trial Ok? Aaaaa!!! I want to do the hidden enchant again.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
真好玩，我還想再來一次。喂，再試一次好嗎？啊啊啊！！我還想做隱藏附魔！

scripts.text: Gradually you are getting into your own world. You better go back to Mounds.
scripts.translation: 你已經漸漸沉浸在自己的世界裡了。還是回蒙茲那裡去吧。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
How about it? Don't you think the hidden enchant is great? Any chance to do another hidden enchant?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
怎麼樣？隱藏附魔很棒吧？還想再做一次嗎？

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It's fun. I want to do it again. Hey, another trial Ok? Aaaaa!!! I want to do the hidden enchant again.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
真好玩，我還想再來一次。喂，再試一次好嗎？啊啊啊！！我還想做隱藏附魔！

scripts.text: Gradually you are getting into your own world. You better go back to Mounds.
scripts.translation: 你已經漸漸沉浸在自己的世界裡了。還是回蒙茲那裡去吧。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Heh heh... how are you? I am doing a ^142CEBservice of free hidden enchant for the beginner's weapon to advertise the enchant association.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
嘿嘿...最近怎麼樣？我正在為新手武器提供^142CEB免費隱藏附魔服務，藉此宣傳附魔協會。^000000

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Something strange must've happened. If this continues, please contact customer service.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
好像出了什麼問題。如果一直這樣，請聯絡客服。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
As you are still a beginner, you don't have a very, very, very functional jewelry, but soon you will have.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
你還是個新手，還沒有特別特別特別厲害的飾品，不過很快就會有了。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
How about it? Will you try the hidden enchant for the beginner's weapon free of charge?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
怎麼樣？要免費體驗一次新手武器的隱藏附魔嗎？

scripts.text: Hidden enchant start!!
scripts.translation: 開始隱藏附魔！！

scripts.text: What weapons are you enchanting?
scripts.translation: 你要為哪些武器附魔？

scripts.text: Just passing by.
scripts.translation: 只是路過

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Ah!! Weapons? Hehehe.. I didn't explain it to you enough.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
啊！！武器？嘿嘿...我還沒跟你解釋清楚呢。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
The weapon to be serviced with the free hidden enchant has the ^FD4F02Novice^000000 name in front of the weapon.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
可以免費進行隱藏附魔的武器，名稱前會帶有^FD4F02“初心者”^000000字樣。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
^FD4F02For Novices-
Cutter, Mace, Rod, Axe, Etc.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
^FD4F02初心者武器：
短劍、鈍器、手杖、斧頭等。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Ye?!?!?!?!?!
Where are you going? You should do the hidden enchant before going.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
咦！！！！！！
你要去哪兒？應該先做完隱藏附魔再走啊。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Hehehe... hidden enchant makes me excited. But you should come back with your weapon armed.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
嘿嘿...隱藏附魔讓我好興奮。不過，你得帶著武器回來才行。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It is!! ^142cebthe Novice Knife^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
就是它！！^142ceb初心者短劍^000000。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It is!! The ^142ceb{0}^000000.

[Almond J]
Ehee.. It is not a Novice Weapon. Leaving this expensive weapon to us and if broken... I'm not taking that chance.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
呃...這不是初心者武器。把這麼貴的武器交給我們，萬一弄壞了...我可擔不起這個責任。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
But this weapon might be strange to add a hidden enchant? Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
不過，這把武器好像不適合進行隱藏附魔？抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
It is a good weapon Then!! Let's start the hidden enchant!!
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
這把武器不錯！那麼！！開始隱藏附魔！！

scripts.text:
[Almond J]
Zzazanzn!! Completed!!
As I'm too excited, I can't check the options. Please check it yourself.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾蒙德 J]
滋啦滋啦！！完成了！！
我太興奮了，沒檢查附加效果。請您自己確認一下。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
Repairing broken equipment!! If you have broken equipment, bring it to me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
裝備損壞了就來修理！有壞掉的裝備，隨時拿來找我。

scripts.text: Repair it.
scripts.translation: 修理

scripts.text: Nothing to be repaired now.
scripts.translation: 現在沒有需要修理的裝備。

scripts.text: What is repairing?
scripts.translation: 什麼是修理？

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
You must treat your equipment carefully... as you don't have anything to be repaired.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
您沒有需要修理的裝備...平時可要好好愛惜裝備啊。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
Hmmm... let's see... oh.. hmm...

[Repair Man]
------------------------
Damaged Equipment Estimate
Damaged Equipment: ^FF0000{0}^000000
Fee: ^0000FF{1} Zeny^000000
------------------------
Would you like to proceed with the repair?
Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
Well, I don't care. After all, it's not my equipment. However, leaving equipment unchecked is not a wise choice.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
好吧，我無所謂，反正這又不是我的裝備。不過，放著裝備不管可不明智。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
The repair cost is 5000 Zeny per damaged equipment. You do not have enough money.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
每件破損裝備的修理費是5,000 Zeny。您的錢不夠。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
The repair has been completed. Be sure to take good care of your equipment.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
修理完成了。記得好好愛惜裝備。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
If you don't have any equipment to be repaired, you may not have something to talk with me about.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
如果沒有需要修理的裝備，您應該也沒什麼事要找我。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
A specific skill or boss monster could break your equipment frequently.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
某些特定技能或頭目魔物可能會頻繁損壞您的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
This doesn't mean that your equipment is gone forever like what happens during refining.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
這和精煉時裝備損壞不同，您的裝備不會就此消失。

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
When your item breaks this way, they won't perform normally...
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
裝備這樣損壞後，就無法正常使用了...

scripts.text:
[Repair Man]
In this case, bring it to me, and I will repair it back to new at the cost of 5000 zeny for each equipment.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
遇到這種情況，把裝備拿來找我吧。我可以幫您修復如新，每件收費5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Training Instructor]
The training grounds have been revised.
I will send you to Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[訓練指導員]
訓練場已經翻新。
我送您去依斯魯得島。
